===== FILE: packages\cache\src\index.ts =====
import Redis from "ioredis";

const globalForRedis = globalThis as unknown as {
  redis: Redis | undefined;
};

function createClient(): Redis {
  const url = process.env.REDIS_URL ?? "redis://localhost:6379";

  const client = new Redis(url, {
    maxRetriesPerRequest: 3,
    retryStrategy(times: number) {
      return Math.min(times * 200, 5000);
    },
    lazyConnect: true,
    enableReadyCheck: true,
  });

  client.on("error", (err) => {
    console.error("[Redis] Connection error:", err.message);
  });

  client.on("connect", () => {
    console.log("[Redis] Connected");
  });

  return client;
}

export const redis = globalForRedis.redis ?? createClient();

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
  globalForRedis.redis = redis;
}

// ─── Typed cache helpers ─────────────────────────────────

export const cache = {
  async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
    const raw = await redis.get(key);
    if (!raw) return null;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },

  async set(key: string, value: unknown, ttlSeconds: number): Promise<void> {
    await redis.set(key, JSON.stringify(value), "EX", ttlSeconds);
  },

  async del(key: string): Promise<void> {
    await redis.del(key);
  },

  async delPattern(pattern: string): Promise<void> {
    const stream = redis.scanStream({ match: pattern, count: 100 });
    const keys: string[] = [];
    stream.on("data", (result: string[]) => keys.push(...result));
    stream.on("end", async () => {
      if (keys.length > 0) await redis.del(...keys);
    });
  },

  async flush(): Promise<void> {
    await redis.flushdb();
  },
};

/**
 * Read-through cache pattern.
 * Checks cache first, falls back to `fn`, stores result with TTL.
 */
export async function cached<T>(
  key: string,
  fn: () => Promise<T>,
  ttlSeconds: number,
): Promise<T> {
  const existing = await cache.get<T>(key);
  if (existing !== null) return existing;

  const result = await fn();
  await cache.set(key, result, ttlSeconds);
  return result;
}

// ─── Common key patterns ─────────────────────────────────

export const CacheKeys = {
  userById: (id: string) => `user:${id}`,
  userByEmail: (email: string) => `user:email:${email}`,
  toolById: (id: string) => `tool:${id}`,
  toolBySlug: (slug: string) => `tool:slug:${slug}`,
  toolsList: (page: number, perPage: number) => `tools:list:${page}:${perPage}`,
  toolsFeatured: () => "tools:featured",
  categoriesTree: () => "categories:tree",
  blogBySlug: (slug: string) => `blog:slug:${slug}`,
  blogList: (page: number, perPage: number) => `blog:list:${page}:${perPage}`,
  rateLimit: (ip: string) => `rate:${ip}`,
} as const;

// ─── Default TTLs (seconds) ──────────────────────────────

export const CacheTTL = {
  SHORT: 60, // 1 minute
  MEDIUM: 300, // 5 minutes
  LONG: 900, // 15 minutes
  DAY: 86400, // 24 hours
} as const;

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\dist\src\types.d.ts =====
export interface CalculatorResult {
    success: boolean;
    error?: string;
}
export interface BMIResult extends CalculatorResult {
    bmi: number;
    category: string;
    color: 'blue' | 'green' | 'yellow' | 'red';
    healthyRange: {
        min: number;
        max: number;
    };
}
export interface TaxResult extends CalculatorResult {
    totalTax: number;
    effectiveRate: number;
    marginalRate: number;
    afterTax: number;
    monthlyTax: number;
    breakdown: TaxBracket[];
}
export interface TaxBracket {
    bracket: string;
    tax: number;
    rate: number;
}
export interface MortgageResult extends CalculatorResult {
    monthlyPayment: number;
    principal: number;
    totalPayment: number;
    totalInterest: number;
    downPaymentPercent: number;
    loanTerm: number;
}
export interface LoanResult extends CalculatorResult {
    monthlyPayment: number;
    totalPayment: number;
    totalInterest: number;
    principal: number;
}
export interface ROIResult extends CalculatorResult {
    roi: number;
    profit: number;
    totalReturn: number;
    annualizedROI: number;
}
export interface SavingsResult extends CalculatorResult {
    finalAmount: number;
    totalContributions: number;
    totalInterest: number;
    monthlyBreakdown: SavingsMonth[];
}
export interface SavingsMonth {
    month: number;
    balance: number;
    interest: number;
    contribution: number;
}
export interface CalorieResult extends CalculatorResult {
    bmr: number;
    tdee: number;
    weightLoss: number;
    weightGain: number;
    maintain: number;
}
export interface MacroResult extends CalculatorResult {
    protein: number;
    carbs: number;
    fat: number;
    calories: number;

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\src\age-calculator\logic.ts =====
import type { AgeCalculatorInput, AgeCalculatorOutput } from './schema'

export function calculateAgeCalculator(input: AgeCalculatorInput): AgeCalculatorOutput {
  const birth  = new Date(input.birthDate)
  const target = input.toDate ? new Date(input.toDate) : new Date()

  let years  = target.getFullYear() - birth.getFullYear()
  let months = target.getMonth()    - birth.getMonth()
  let days   = target.getDate()     - birth.getDate()

  if (days < 0) {
    months--
    const prevMonth = new Date(target.getFullYear(), target.getMonth(), 0)
    days += prevMonth.getDate()
  }

  if (months < 0) {
    years--
    months += 12
  }

  const totalDays   = Math.floor((target.getTime() - birth.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24))
  const totalMonths = years * 12 + months

  // Days until next birthday
  const nextBday = new Date(target.getFullYear(), birth.getMonth(), birth.getDate())
  if (nextBday <= target) nextBday.setFullYear(target.getFullYear() + 1)
  const nextBirthday = Math.ceil((nextBday.getTime() - target.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24))

  return { years, months, days, totalDays, totalMonths, nextBirthday }
}

import type { BMIInput, BMIOutput } from './schema'

function getCategory(bmi: number): BMIOutput['category'] {
  if (bmi < 18.5) return 'Underweight'
  if (bmi < 25)   return 'Normal weight'
  if (bmi < 30)   return 'Overweight'
  return 'Obese'
}

export function calculateBMI(input: BMIInput): BMIOutput {
  let weightKg = input.weight
  let heightM  = input.height

  if (input.unit === 'imperial') {
    weightKg = input.weight * 0.453592      // lbs → kg
    heightM  = input.height * 0.0254        // inches → m
  }

  const bmi = weightKg / (heightM * heightM)

  // Healthy range back-converted to user's unit
  const minKg = 18.5 * heightM * heightM
  const maxKg = 24.9 * heightM * heightM

  const [min, max] = input.unit === 'imperial'
    ? [minKg / 0.453592, maxKg / 0.453592]
    : [minKg, maxKg]

  return {
    bmi: Math.round(bmi * 10) / 10,
    category: getCategory(bmi),
    healthyWeightRange: {
      min: Math.round(min * 10) / 10,
      max: Math.round(max * 10) / 10,
    },
  }
}

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\src\compound-interest\logic.ts =====
import type { CompoundInterestInput, CompoundInterestOutput } from './schema'

const FREQUENCY_MAP = {
  'annually':      1,
  'semi-annually': 2,
  'quarterly':     4,
  'monthly':       12,
  'daily':         365,
}

export function calculateCompoundInterest(input: CompoundInterestInput): CompoundInterestOutput {
  const n = FREQUENCY_MAP[input.compoundFrequency]
  const r = input.annualRate / 100
  const t = input.years

  // Principal growth: P(1 + r/n)^(nt)
  const principalGrowth = input.principal * Math.pow(1 + r / n, n * t)

  // Monthly contribution growth (future value of series)
  const monthlyRate = r / 12
  const months      = t * 12
  const contributionGrowth = input.monthlyContribution > 0
    ? input.monthlyContribution * ((Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, months) - 1) / monthlyRate)
    : 0

  const finalAmount        = principalGrowth + contributionGrowth
  const totalContributions = input.principal + (input.monthlyContribution * months)
  const totalInterest      = finalAmount - totalContributions
  const effectiveRate      = (Math.pow(1 + r / n, n) - 1) * 100

  return {
    finalAmount:        Math.round(finalAmount * 100) / 100,
    totalContributions: Math.round(totalContributions * 100) / 100,
    totalInterest:      Math.round(totalInterest * 100) / 100,
    effectiveRate:      Math.round(effectiveRate * 1000) / 10,
  }
}

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\src\days-between-dates\logic.ts =====
import type { DaysBetweenDatesInput, DaysBetweenDatesOutput } from './schema'

export function calculateDaysBetweenDates(input: DaysBetweenDatesInput): DaysBetweenDatesOutput {
  const start = new Date(input.startDate)
  const end   = new Date(input.endDate)

  const msPerDay = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24
  const days     = Math.round(Math.abs(end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / msPerDay)
  const weeks    = Math.floor(days / 7)
  const months   = Math.round(days / 30.44)
  const years    = Math.round(days / 365.25)

  // Count weekdays and weekends
  let weekdays = 0
  let weekends = 0
  const from   = start < end ? start : end
  const to     = start < end ? end   : start

  const current = new Date(from)
  while (current <= to) {
    const day = current.getDay()
    if (day === 0 || day === 6) weekends++
    else weekdays++
    current.setDate(current.getDate() + 1)
  }

  return { days, weeks, months, years, weekdays, weekends }
}

import { BMIResult } from '../types'

interface BMIInput {
  weight: number
  height: number
  unit?: 'metric' | 'imperial'
}

export function calculateBMI({ weight, height, unit = 'metric' }: BMIInput): BMIResult {
  try {
    let weightKg = weight
    let heightM = height

    if (unit === 'imperial') {
      weightKg = weight * 0.453592
      heightM = height * 0.0254
    } else {
      heightM = height / 100
    }

    if (weightKg <= 0 || heightM <= 0) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Weight and height must be positive numbers', bmi: 0, category: '', color: 'green', healthyRange: { min: 18.5, max: 24.9 } }
    }

    const bmi = Math.round((weightKg / (heightM * heightM)) * 10) / 10

    let category: string
    let color: 'blue' | 'green' | 'yellow' | 'red'

    if (bmi < 18.5)      { category = 'Underweight';  color = 'blue' }
    else if (bmi < 25)   { category = 'Normal weight'; color = 'green' }
    else if (bmi < 30)   { category = 'Overweight';   color = 'yellow' }
    else                 { category = 'Obese';         color = 'red' }

    return {
      success: true,
      bmi,
      category,
      color,
      healthyRange: { min: 18.5, max: 24.9 },
    }
  } catch {
    return { success: false, error: 'Calculation failed', bmi: 0, category: '', color: 'green', healthyRange: { min: 18.5, max: 24.9 } }
  }
}

import { LoanResult } from '../types'

interface LoanInput {
  loanAmount: number
  interestRate: number
  loanTerm: number
}

export function calculateLoan({ loanAmount, interestRate, loanTerm }: LoanInput): LoanResult {
  try {
    const monthlyRate = interestRate / 100 / 12
    const numPayments = loanTerm * 12

    const monthlyPayment =
      (loanAmount * monthlyRate * Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, numPayments)) /
      (Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, numPayments) - 1)

    const totalPayment = monthlyPayment * numPayments

    return {
      success: true,
      monthlyPayment: Math.round(monthlyPayment * 100) / 100,
      totalPayment: Math.round(totalPayment * 100) / 100,
      totalInterest: Math.round((totalPayment - loanAmount) * 100) / 100,
      principal: loanAmount,
    }
  } catch {
    return { success: false, error: 'Calculation failed', monthlyPayment: 0, totalPayment: 0, totalInterest: 0, principal: 0 }
  }
}

interface MortgageInput {

  downPayment: number
  interestRate: number
  loanTerm?: number
}

export function calculateMortgage({
  homePrice, downPayment, interestRate, loanTerm = 30
}: MortgageInput): MortgageResult {
  try {
    const principal = homePrice - downPayment
    const monthlyRate = interestRate / 100 / 12
    const numPayments = loanTerm * 12

    const monthlyPayment =
      (principal * monthlyRate * Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, numPayments)) /
      (Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, numPayments) - 1)

    const totalPayment = monthlyPayment * numPayments

    return {
      success: true,
      monthlyPayment: Math.round(monthlyPayment * 100) / 100,
      principal: Math.round(principal * 100) / 100,
      totalPayment: Math.round(totalPayment * 100) / 100,
      totalInterest: Math.round((totalPayment - principal) * 100) / 100,
      downPaymentPercent: Math.round((downPayment / homePrice) * 1000) / 10,
      loanTerm,
    }
  } catch {
    return { success: false, error: 'Calculation failed', monthlyPayment: 0, principal: 0, totalPayment: 0, totalInterest: 0, downPaymentPercent: 0, loanTerm }
  }
}

interface ROIInput {
  initialInvestment: number
  finalValue: number
  years?: number
}

export function calculateROI({ initialInvestment, finalValue, years = 1 }: ROIInput): ROIResult {
  try {
    const profit = finalValue - initialInvestment
    const roi = (profit / initialInvestment) * 100
    const annualizedROI = (Math.pow(finalValue / initialInvestment, 1 / years) - 1) * 100

    return {
      success: true,
      roi: Math.round(roi * 100) / 100,
      profit: Math.round(profit * 100) / 100,
      totalReturn: Math.round(finalValue * 100) / 100,
      annualizedROI: Math.round(annualizedROI * 100) / 100,
    }
  } catch {
    return { success: false, error: 'Calculation failed', roi: 0, profit: 0, totalReturn: 0, annualizedROI: 0 }
  }
}

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\src\financial\savings.ts =====
import { SavingsResult } from '../types'

interface SavingsInput {
  initialAmount: number
  monthlyContribution: number
  annualInterestRate: number
  years: number
}

export function calculateSavings({
  initialAmount, monthlyContribution, annualInterestRate, years
}: SavingsInput): SavingsResult {
  try {
    const monthlyRate = annualInterestRate / 100 / 12
    const totalMonths = years * 12
    let balance = initialAmount
    let totalInterest = 0
    const monthlyBreakdown = []

    for (let month = 1; month <= totalMonths; month++) {
      const interest = balance * monthlyRate
      balance += interest + monthlyContribution
      totalInterest += interest
      if (month % 12 === 0 || month === totalMonths) {
        monthlyBreakdown.push({
          month,
          balance: Math.round(balance * 100) / 100,
          interest: Math.round(interest * 100) / 100,
          contribution: monthlyContribution,
        })
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      finalAmount: Math.round(balance * 100) / 100,
      totalContributions: Math.round((initialAmount + monthlyContribution * totalMonths) * 100) / 100,
      totalInterest: Math.round(totalInterest * 100) / 100,
      monthlyBreakdown,
    }
  } catch {
    return { success: false, error: 'Calculation failed', finalAmount: 0, totalContributions: 0, totalInterest: 0, monthlyBreakdown: [] }
  }
}

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\src\financial\tax.ts =====
import { TaxResult } from "../types";

interface TaxInput {
  income: number;
  filingStatus?:
    | "single"
    | "married_joint"
    | "married_separate"
    | "head_of_household";
  year?: number;
}

const TAX_BRACKETS_2024 = {
  single: [
    { min: 0, max: 11600, rate: 0.1 },
    { min: 11600, max: 47150, rate: 0.12 },
    { min: 47150, max: 100525, rate: 0.22 },
    { min: 100525, max: 191950, rate: 0.24 },
    { min: 191950, max: 243725, rate: 0.32 },
    { min: 243725, max: 609350, rate: 0.35 },
    { min: 609350, max: Infinity, rate: 0.37 },
  ],
  married_joint: [
    { min: 0, max: 23200, rate: 0.1 },
    { min: 23200, max: 94300, rate: 0.12 },
    { min: 94300, max: 201050, rate: 0.22 },
    { min: 201050, max: 383900, rate: 0.24 },
    { min: 383900, max: 487450, rate: 0.32 },
    { min: 487450, max: 731200, rate: 0.35 },
    { min: 731200, max: Infinity, rate: 0.37 },
  ],
};

export function calculateTax({
  income,
  filingStatus = "single",
}: TaxInput): TaxResult {
  try {
    if (income < 0)
      return {
        success: false,
        error: "Income must be positive",
        totalTax: 0,
        effectiveRate: 0,
        marginalRate: 0,
        afterTax: 0,
        monthlyTax: 0,
        breakdown: [],
      };

    const brackets =
      TAX_BRACKETS_2024[filingStatus as keyof typeof TAX_BRACKETS_2024] ||
      TAX_BRACKETS_2024.single;
    let totalTax = 0;
    const breakdown = [];

    for (const bracket of brackets) {
      if (income > bracket.min) {
        const taxableInBracket = Math.min(income, bracket.max) - bracket.min;
        const taxInBracket = taxableInBracket * bracket.rate;
        totalTax += taxInBracket;
        if (taxInBracket > 0) {
          breakdown.push({
            bracket: `$${bracket.min.toLocaleString()} – ${bracket.max === Infinity ? "∞" : "$" + bracket.max.toLocaleString()}`,
            tax: Math.round(taxInBracket * 100) / 100,
            rate: bracket.rate * 100,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    const marginalBracket =
      brackets.find((b: (typeof brackets)[0]) => income <= b.max) ??
      brackets[brackets.length - 1];

    return {
      success: true,
      totalTax: Math.round(totalTax * 100) / 100,
      effectiveRate: Math.round((totalTax / income) * 1000) / 10,
      marginalRate: marginalBracket.rate,
      afterTax: Math.round((income - totalTax) * 100) / 100,
      monthlyTax: Math.round((totalTax / 12) * 100) / 100,
      breakdown,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "Calculation failed",
      totalTax: 0,
      effectiveRate: 0,
      marginalRate: 0,
      afterTax: 0,
      monthlyTax: 0,
      breakdown: [],
    };
  }
}

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\src\health\calories.ts =====
import { CalorieResult } from '../types'

interface CalorieInput {
  weight: number
  height: number
  age: number
  gender: 'male' | 'female'
  activityLevel: 'sedentary' | 'light' | 'moderate' | 'active' | 'very_active'
  unit?: 'metric' | 'imperial'
}

const ACTIVITY_MULTIPLIERS = {
  sedentary:   1.2,
  light:       1.375,
  moderate:    1.55,
  active:      1.725,
  very_active: 1.9,
}

export function calculateCalories({
  weight, height, age, gender, activityLevel, unit = 'metric'
}: CalorieInput): CalorieResult {
  try {
    let weightKg = weight
    let heightCm = height

    if (unit === 'imperial') {
      weightKg = weight * 0.453592
      heightCm = height * 2.54
    }

    // Mifflin-St Jeor equation
    let bmr: number
    if (gender === 'male') {
      bmr = 10 * weightKg + 6.25 * heightCm - 5 * age + 5
    } else {
      bmr = 10 * weightKg + 6.25 * heightCm - 5 * age - 161
    }

    const multiplier = ACTIVITY_MULTIPLIERS[activityLevel]
    const tdee = bmr * multiplier

    return {
      success: true,
      bmr: Math.round(bmr),
      tdee: Math.round(tdee),
      weightLoss: Math.round(tdee - 500),
      weightGain: Math.round(tdee + 500),
      maintain: Math.round(tdee),
    }
  } catch {
    return { success: false, error: 'Calculation failed', bmr: 0, tdee: 0, weightLoss: 0, weightGain: 0, maintain: 0 }
  }
}

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\src\health\macro.ts =====
import { MacroResult } from '../types'

interface MacroInput {
  calories: number
  goal: 'lose' | 'maintain' | 'gain'
  unit?: 'metric' | 'imperial'
}

const MACRO_RATIOS = {
  lose:     { protein: 0.40, carbs: 0.30, fat: 0.30 },
  maintain: { protein: 0.30, carbs: 0.40, fat: 0.30 },
  gain:     { protein: 0.25, carbs: 0.50, fat: 0.25 },
}

export function calculateMacros({ calories, goal }: MacroInput): MacroResult {
  try {
    const ratios = MACRO_RATIOS[goal]
    const protein = Math.round((calories * ratios.protein) / 4)
    const carbs   = Math.round((calories * ratios.carbs)   / 4)
    const fat     = Math.round((calories * ratios.fat)     / 9)

    return { success: true, protein, carbs, fat, calories }
  } catch {
    return { success: false, error: 'Calculation failed', protein: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0, calories: 0 }
  }
}

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\src\percentage\logic.ts =====
import type { PercentageInput, PercentageOutput } from './schema'

export function calculatePercentage(input: PercentageInput): PercentageOutput {
  const { mode, valueA, valueB } = input
  let result: number
  let explanation: string

  if (mode === 'what-percent-of') {
    // What is A% of B?
    result      = (valueA / 100) * valueB
    explanation = `${valueA}% of ${valueB} = ${round(result)}`
  } else if (mode === 'percent-change') {
    // Percentage change from A to B
    result      = ((valueB - valueA) / valueA) * 100
    explanation = `Change from ${valueA} to ${valueB} = ${round(result)}%`
  } else {
    // A is what percent of B?
    result      = (valueA / valueB) * 100
    explanation = `${valueA} is ${round(result)}% of ${valueB}`
  }

  return {
    result:      round(result),
    explanation,
  }
}

function round(n: number) {
  return Math.round(n * 100) / 100
}

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\src\roi\logic.ts =====
import type { RoiInput, RoiOutput } from './schema'

export function calculateRoi(input: RoiInput): RoiOutput {
  const profit      = input.finalValue - input.initialInvestment
  const roi         = (profit / input.initialInvestment) * 100
  const totalReturn = input.finalValue / input.initialInvestment

  let annualizedRoi = 0
  if (input.years) {
    annualizedRoi = (Math.pow(totalReturn, 1 / input.years) - 1) * 100
  }

  return {
    roi:           Math.round(roi * 100) / 100,
    profit:        Math.round(profit * 100) / 100,
    totalReturn:   Math.round(totalReturn * 100) / 100,
    annualizedRoi: Math.round(annualizedRoi * 100) / 100,
  }
}

import type { TaxInput, TaxOutput } from './schema'

const BRACKETS = {
  single: [
    { min: 0,      max: 11600,    rate: 0.10 },
    { min: 11600,  max: 47150,    rate: 0.12 },
    { min: 47150,  max: 100525,   rate: 0.22 },
    { min: 100525, max: 191950,   rate: 0.24 },
    { min: 191950, max: 243725,   rate: 0.32 },
    { min: 243725, max: 609350,   rate: 0.35 },
    { min: 609350, max: Infinity, rate: 0.37 },
  ],
  married_joint: [
    { min: 0,      max: 23200,    rate: 0.10 },
    { min: 23200,  max: 94300,    rate: 0.12 },
    { min: 94300,  max: 201050,   rate: 0.22 },
    { min: 201050, max: 383900,   rate: 0.24 },
    { min: 383900, max: 487450,   rate: 0.32 },
    { min: 487450, max: 731200,   rate: 0.35 },
    { min: 731200, max: Infinity, rate: 0.37 },
  ],
  married_separate: [
    { min: 0,      max: 11600,    rate: 0.10 },
    { min: 11600,  max: 47150,    rate: 0.12 },
    { min: 47150,  max: 100525,   rate: 0.22 },
    { min: 100525, max: 191950,   rate: 0.24 },
    { min: 191950, max: 243725,   rate: 0.32 },
    { min: 243725, max: 365600,   rate: 0.35 },
    { min: 365600, max: Infinity, rate: 0.37 },
  ],
  head_of_household: [
    { min: 0,      max: 16550,    rate: 0.10 },
    { min: 16550,  max: 63100,    rate: 0.12 },
    { min: 63100,  max: 100500,   rate: 0.22 },
    { min: 100500, max: 191950,   rate: 0.24 },
    { min: 191950, max: 243700,   rate: 0.32 },
    { min: 243700, max: 609350,   rate: 0.35 },
    { min: 609350, max: Infinity, rate: 0.37 },
  ],
}

export function calculateTax(input: TaxInput): TaxOutput {
  const brackets = BRACKETS[input.filingStatus]
  let totalTax = 0
  const breakdown: TaxOutput['breakdown'] = []

  for (const bracket of brackets) {
    if (input.income > bracket.min) {
      const taxable = Math.min(input.income, bracket.max) - bracket.min
      const tax     = taxable * bracket.rate
      totalTax     += tax
      if (tax > 0) {
        breakdown.push({
          bracket: `$${bracket.min.toLocaleString()} – ${bracket.max === Infinity ? '∞' : '$' + bracket.max.toLocaleString()}`,
          tax:  Math.round(tax * 100) / 100,
          rate: bracket.rate * 100,
        })
      }
    }
  }

  const marginal = brackets.find(b => input.income <= b.max) ?? brackets[brackets.length - 1]

  return {
    totalTax:      Math.round(totalTax * 100) / 100,
    effectiveRate: Math.round((totalTax / input.income) * 1000) / 10,
    marginalRate:  marginal.rate * 100,
    afterTax:      Math.round((input.income - totalTax) * 100) / 100,
    monthlyTax:    Math.round((totalTax / 12) * 100) / 100,
    breakdown,
  }
}

import type { TipCalculatorInput, TipCalculatorOutput } from './schema'

export function calculateTipCalculator(input: TipCalculatorInput): TipCalculatorOutput {
  const tipAmount    = (input.billAmount * input.tipPercent) / 100
  const totalAmount  = input.billAmount + tipAmount
  const perPerson    = totalAmount / input.splitBetween
  const tipPerPerson = tipAmount   / input.splitBetween

  return {
    tipAmount:    round(tipAmount),
    totalAmount:  round(totalAmount),
    perPerson:    round(perPerson),
    tipPerPerson: round(tipPerPerson),
  }
}

function round(n: number) {
  return Math.round(n * 100) / 100
}

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\src\utility\unit-converter.ts =====
import { UnitResult } from '../types'

const CONVERSIONS: Record<string, Record<string, number>> = {
  length: {
    meter: 1, kilometer: 1000, mile: 1609.34,
    foot: 0.3048, inch: 0.0254, yard: 0.9144, centimeter: 0.01,
  },
  weight: {
    kilogram: 1, gram: 0.001, pound: 0.453592,
    ounce: 0.0283495, ton: 1000, stone: 6.35029,
  },
  volume: {
    liter: 1, milliliter: 0.001, gallon: 3.78541,
    quart: 0.946353, pint: 0.473176, cup: 0.236588, fluid_ounce: 0.0295735,
  },
  speed: {
    meter_per_second: 1, kilometer_per_hour: 0.277778,
    mile_per_hour: 0.44704, knot: 0.514444, foot_per_second: 0.3048,
  },
}

export function convertUnit(
  value: number,
  fromUnit: string,
  toUnit: string,
  category: string
): UnitResult {
  try {
    if (category === 'temperature') {
      return convertTemperature(value, fromUnit, toUnit)
    }

    const cat = CONVERSIONS[category]
    if (!cat) return { success: false, error: 'Unknown category', value: 0, fromUnit, toUnit, category: category as any }

    const fromFactor = cat[fromUnit]
    const toFactor = cat[toUnit]
    if (!fromFactor || !toFactor) return { success: false, error: 'Unknown unit', value: 0, fromUnit, toUnit, category: category as any }

    const result = (value * fromFactor) / toFactor

    return {
      success: true,
      value: Math.round(result * 10000) / 10000,
      fromUnit,
      toUnit,
      category: category as any,
    }
  } catch {
    return { success: false, error: 'Conversion failed', value: 0, fromUnit, toUnit, category: category as any }
  }
}

function convertTemperature(value: number, from: string, to: string): UnitResult {
  let celsius: number

  if (from === 'celsius')    celsius = value
  else if (from === 'fahrenheit') celsius = (value - 32) * 5/9
  else if (from === 'kelvin')    celsius = value - 273.15
  else return { success: false, error: 'Unknown temperature unit', value: 0, fromUnit: from, toUnit: to, category: 'temperature' }

  let result: number
  if (to === 'celsius')      result = celsius
  else if (to === 'fahrenheit') result = celsius * 9/5 + 32
  else if (to === 'kelvin')    result = celsius + 273.15
  else return { success: false, error: 'Unknown temperature unit', value: 0, fromUnit: from, toUnit: to, category: 'temperature' }

  return {
    success: true,
    value: Math.round(result * 100) / 100,
    fromUnit: from,
    toUnit: to,
    category: 'temperature',
  }
}

// ─── Inline BMI logic (mirrors packages/calculators-core/src/bmi/logic.ts) ───

function calculateBMI(weightKg: number, heightCm: number): number {
  const heightM = heightCm / 100;
  return parseFloat((weightKg / (heightM * heightM)).toFixed(2));
}

function getBMICategory(bmi: number): string {
  if (bmi < 18.5) return 'Underweight';
  if (bmi < 25)   return 'Normal weight';
  if (bmi < 30)   return 'Overweight';
  return 'Obese';
}

function calculateBMIImperial(weightLbs: number, heightInches: number): number {
  return parseFloat(((weightLbs / (heightInches * heightInches)) * 703).toFixed(2));
}

// ─── Tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('BMI Calculator', () => {

  describe('calculateBMI (metric)', () => {
    it('calculates correct BMI for normal weight person', () => {
      // 70kg, 175cm → BMI ~22.86
      expect(calculateBMI(70, 175)).toBe(22.86);
    });

    it('calculates correct BMI for underweight person', () => {
      // 45kg, 170cm → BMI ~15.57
      expect(calculateBMI(45, 170)).toBe(15.57);
    });

    it('calculates correct BMI for overweight person', () => {
      // 90kg, 175cm → BMI ~29.39
      expect(calculateBMI(90, 175)).toBe(29.39);
    });

    it('calculates correct BMI for obese person', () => {
      // 120kg, 170cm → BMI ~41.52
      expect(calculateBMI(120, 170)).toBe(41.52);
    });

    it('returns a number with max 2 decimal places', () => {
      const result = calculateBMI(73, 178);
      expect(result.toString().split('.')[1]?.length ?? 0).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);
    });
  });

  describe('calculateBMI (imperial)', () => {
    it('calculates BMI from pounds and inches', () => {
      // 154 lbs, 68 inches → BMI ~23.4
      const result = calculateBMIImperial(154, 68);
      expect(result).toBeGreaterThan(23);
      expect(result).toBeLessThan(24);
    });
  });

  describe('getBMICategory', () => {
    it('returns Underweight for BMI below 18.5', () => {
      expect(getBMICategory(17.0)).toBe('Underweight');
      expect(getBMICategory(18.4)).toBe('Underweight');
    });

    it('returns Normal weight for BMI 18.5–24.9', () => {
      expect(getBMICategory(18.5)).toBe('Normal weight');
      expect(getBMICategory(22.0)).toBe('Normal weight');
      expect(getBMICategory(24.9)).toBe('Normal weight');
    });

    it('returns Overweight for BMI 25–29.9', () => {
      expect(getBMICategory(25.0)).toBe('Overweight');
      expect(getBMICategory(27.5)).toBe('Overweight');
      expect(getBMICategory(29.9)).toBe('Overweight');
    });

    it('returns Obese for BMI 30 and above', () => {
      expect(getBMICategory(30.0)).toBe('Obese');
      expect(getBMICategory(40.0)).toBe('Obese');
    });

    it('handles exact boundary values correctly', () => {
      expect(getBMICategory(18.5)).toBe('Normal weight');
      expect(getBMICategory(25.0)).toBe('Overweight');
      expect(getBMICategory(30.0)).toBe('Obese');
    });
  });

  describe('Edge cases', () => {
    it('handles very tall person', () => {
      const bmi = calculateBMI(80, 210);
      expect(bmi).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(bmi).toBeLessThan(30);
    });

    it('handles very short person', () => {
      const bmi = calculateBMI(50, 140);
      expect(bmi).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
  });
});

===== FILE: packages\calculators-core\src\__tests__\loan.test.ts =====
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';

// ─── Inline loan logic (mirrors packages/calculators-core/src/loan/logic.ts) ─
// If exported, replace with: import { calculateMonthlyPayment, calculateTotalInterest } from '../loan/logic';

function calculateMonthlyPayment(
  principal: number,
  annualRatePercent: number,
  termMonths: number,
): number {
  if (annualRatePercent === 0) {
    return parseFloat((principal / termMonths).toFixed(2));
  }
  const r = annualRatePercent / 100 / 12;
  const payment = (principal * r * Math.pow(1 + r, termMonths)) /
                  (Math.pow(1 + r, termMonths) - 1);
  return parseFloat(payment.toFixed(2));
}

function calculateTotalPayment(monthly: number, termMonths: number): number {
  return parseFloat((monthly * termMonths).toFixed(2));
}

function calculateTotalInterest(totalPayment: number, principal: number): number {
  return parseFloat((totalPayment - principal).toFixed(2));
}

function calculateAmortizationSchedule(
  principal: number,
  annualRatePercent: number,
  termMonths: number,
): { month: number; payment: number; principal: number; interest: number; balance: number }[] {
  const monthly = calculateMonthlyPayment(principal, annualRatePercent, termMonths);
  const r = annualRatePercent / 100 / 12;
  let balance = principal;
  const schedule = [];

  for (let month = 1; month <= termMonths; month++) {
    const interestPayment = parseFloat((balance * r).toFixed(2));
    const principalPayment = parseFloat((monthly - interestPayment).toFixed(2));
    balance = parseFloat((balance - principalPayment).toFixed(2));
    schedule.push({ month, payment: monthly, principal: principalPayment, interest: interestPayment, balance: Math.max(0, balance) });
  }
  return schedule;
}

// ─── Tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('Loan Calculator', () => {

  describe('calculateMonthlyPayment', () => {
    it('calculates correct monthly payment for standard loan', () => {
      // $10,000 at 5% for 36 months → ~$299.71
      const result = calculateMonthlyPayment(10000, 5, 36);
      expect(result).toBeCloseTo(299.71, 1);
    });

    it('calculates correct monthly payment for mortgage-size loan', () => {
      // $300,000 at 6.5% for 360 months → ~$1896.20
      const result = calculateMonthlyPayment(300000, 6.5, 360);
      expect(result).toBeCloseTo(1896.20, 0);
    });

    it('handles 0% interest rate correctly', () => {
      // $12,000 at 0% for 12 months → $1,000/month
      const result = calculateMonthlyPayment(12000, 0, 12);
      expect(result).toBe(1000.00);
    });

    it('returns a positive number', () => {
      expect(calculateMonthlyPayment(5000, 4, 24)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });

    it('higher interest rate produces higher payment', () => {
      const low  = calculateMonthlyPayment(10000, 3, 36);
      const high = calculateMonthlyPayment(10000, 8, 36);
      expect(high).toBeGreaterThan(low);
    });

    it('longer term produces lower monthly payment', () => {
      const short = calculateMonthlyPayment(10000, 5, 24);
      const long  = calculateMonthlyPayment(10000, 5, 60);
      expect(long).toBeLessThan(short);
    });
  });

  describe('calculateTotalPayment', () => {
    it('calculates total payment correctly', () => {
      expect(calculateTotalPayment(299.71, 36)).toBeCloseTo(10789.56, 0);
    });
  });

  describe('calculateTotalInterest', () => {
    it('calculates total interest correctly', () => {
      const total = calculateTotalPayment(299.71, 36);
      expect(calculateTotalInterest(total, 10000)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });

    it('interest is zero for 0% rate', () => {
      const monthly = calculateMonthlyPayment(12000, 0, 12);
      const total   = calculateTotalPayment(monthly, 12);
      expect(calculateTotalInterest(total, 12000)).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  describe('calculateAmortizationSchedule', () => {
    it('returns correct number of months', () => {
      const schedule = calculateAmortizationSchedule(10000, 5, 36);
      expect(schedule.length).toBe(36);
    });

    it('first month has highest interest', () => {
      const schedule = calculateAmortizationSchedule(10000, 5, 36);
      expect(schedule[0].interest).toBeGreaterThan(schedule[35].interest);
    });

    it('balance reaches zero at end', () => {
      const schedule = calculateAmortizationSchedule(10000, 5, 36);
      expect(schedule[35].balance).toBe(0);
    });

    it('each month payment equals principal + interest', () => {
      const schedule = calculateAmortizationSchedule(10000, 5, 36);
      const first = schedule[0];
      expect(first.principal + first.interest).toBeCloseTo(first.payment, 0);
    });
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';

// ─── Inline mortgage logic (mirrors calculators-core/src/mortgage/logic.ts) ──
// If exported, replace with: import { ... } from '../mortgage/logic';

function calculateMonthlyMortgage(
  homePrice: number,
  downPaymentPercent: number,
  annualRatePercent: number,
  termYears: number,
): number {
  const principal = homePrice * (1 - downPaymentPercent / 100);
  const r = annualRatePercent / 100 / 12;
  const n = termYears * 12;
  if (r === 0) return parseFloat((principal / n).toFixed(2));
  const payment = (principal * r * Math.pow(1 + r, n)) / (Math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1);
  return parseFloat(payment.toFixed(2));
}

function calculateDownPayment(homePrice: number, downPaymentPercent: number): number {
  return parseFloat((homePrice * (downPaymentPercent / 100)).toFixed(2));
}

function calculateLoanAmount(homePrice: number, downPaymentPercent: number): number {
  return parseFloat((homePrice * (1 - downPaymentPercent / 100)).toFixed(2));
}

function calculateTotalMortgageCost(
  homePrice: number,
  downPaymentPercent: number,
  annualRatePercent: number,
  termYears: number,
): { monthly: number; totalPayment: number; totalInterest: number; loanAmount: number } {
  const monthly    = calculateMonthlyMortgage(homePrice, downPaymentPercent, annualRatePercent, termYears);
  const loanAmount = calculateLoanAmount(homePrice, downPaymentPercent);
  const totalPayment  = parseFloat((monthly * termYears * 12).toFixed(2));
  const totalInterest = parseFloat((totalPayment - loanAmount).toFixed(2));
  return { monthly, totalPayment, totalInterest, loanAmount };
}

function requiresPMI(downPaymentPercent: number): boolean {
  return downPaymentPercent < 20;
}

function estimatePMI(loanAmount: number, annualPMIRatePercent = 0.5): number {
  return parseFloat(((loanAmount * (annualPMIRatePercent / 100)) / 12).toFixed(2));
}

// ─── Tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('Mortgage Calculator', () => {

  describe('calculateMonthlyMortgage', () => {
    it('calculates correct payment for typical 30-year mortgage', () => {
      // $400,000 home, 20% down, 7% rate, 30 years → ~$2129

      expect(result).toBeGreaterThan(2100);
      expect(result).toBeLessThan(2200);
    });

    it('calculates correct payment for 15-year mortgage', () => {
      // $300,000 home, 20% down, 6% rate, 15 years → ~$2025
      const result = calculateMonthlyMortgage(300000, 20, 6, 15);
      expect(result).toBeGreaterThan(2000);
      expect(result).toBeLessThan(2100);
    });

    it('15-year payment is higher than 30-year payment', () => {
      const monthly30 = calculateMonthlyMortgage(300000, 20, 6, 30);
      const monthly15 = calculateMonthlyMortgage(300000, 20, 6, 15);
      expect(monthly15).toBeGreaterThan(monthly30);
    });

    it('higher down payment reduces monthly payment', () => {
      const low  = calculateMonthlyMortgage(400000, 10, 6.5, 30);
      const high = calculateMonthlyMortgage(400000, 30, 6.5, 30);

      expect(result.totalPayment).toBeCloseTo(result.monthly * 360, 0);
    });

    it('30-year costs more total interest than 15-year', () => {
      const r30 = calculateTotalMortgageCost(400000, 20, 6, 30);
      const r15 = calculateTotalMortgageCost(400000, 20, 6, 15);
      expect(r30.totalInterest).toBeGreaterThan(r15.totalInterest);
    });
  });

  describe('PMI', () => {
    it('requires PMI when down payment is less than 20%', () => {

      expect(requiresPMI(10)).toBe(true);

      expect(requiresPMI(25)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('calculates monthly PMI correctly', () => {
      // $320,000 loan at 0.5% annual = $133.33/mo
      expect(estimatePMI(320000)).toBeCloseTo(133.33, 1);
    });
  });
});

===== FILE: packages\config\src\index.ts =====
// ============================================================
// @platform/config — Environment variable readers
// ============================================================
// IMPORTANT: Never hardcode secrets in this file or any file.
// Always read from process.env. These functions provide type-safe
// access with validation and defaults.
// ============================================================

// --- Environment ---

export type NodeEnvironment = 'development' | 'staging' | 'production' | 'test';

/**
 * Get the current Node environment
 */
export function getNodeEnv(): NodeEnvironment {
  const env = process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development';
  if (!['development', 'staging', 'production', 'test'].includes(env)) {
    return 'development';
  }
  return env as NodeEnvironment;
}

/**
 * Check if running in development mode
 */
export function isDevelopment(): boolean {
  return getNodeEnv() === 'development';
}

/**
 * Check if running in production mode
 */
export function isProduction(): boolean {
  return getNodeEnv() === 'production';
}

/**
 * Check if running in test mode
 */
export function isTest(): boolean {
  return getNodeEnv() === 'test';
}

// --- Generic Env Readers ---

/**
 * Read a required environment variable. Throws if missing.
 */
export function requireEnv(key: string): string {
  const value = process.env[key];
  if (!value || value.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error(
      `Missing required environment variable: ${key}. ` +
      `Check your .env file and ensure ${key} is set.`
    );
  }
  return value.trim();
}

/**
 * Read an optional environment variable with a default value
 */
export function getEnv(key: string, defaultValue: string = ''): string {
  const value = process.env[key];
  if (!value || value.trim() === '') {
    return defaultValue;
  }
  return value.trim();
}

/**
 * Read an environment variable as a number
 */
export function getEnvNumber(key: string, defaultValue: number): number {
  const value = process.env[key];
  if (!value || value.trim() === '') {
    return defaultValue;
  }
  const parsed = Number(value);
  if (isNaN(parsed) || !isFinite(parsed)) {
    throw new Error(
      `Environment variable ${key} must be a valid number, got: "${value}"`
    );
  }
  return parsed;
}

/**
 * Read an environment variable as a boolean
 * Accepts: true, 1, yes, on (case-insensitive) as true
 * Everything else is false
 */
export function getEnvBoolean(key: string, defaultValue: boolean): boolean {
  const value = process.env[key];
  if (!value || value.trim() === '') {
    return defaultValue;
  }
  return ['true', '1', 'yes', 'on'].includes(value.toLowerCase().trim());
}

// --- Application Config ---

export interface AppConfig {
  nodeEnv: NodeEnvironment;
  port: number;
  host: string;
  appName: string;
  appUrl: string;
  apiVersion: string;
}

/**
 * Get application configuration from environment
 */
export function getAppConfig(): AppConfig {
  return {
    nodeEnv: getNodeEnv(),
    port: getEnvNumber('PORT', 3001),
    host: getEnv('HOST', '0.0.0.0'),
    appName: getEnv('APP_NAME', 'Toolverse'),
    appUrl: getEnv('APP_URL', 'http://localhost:3000'),
    apiVersion: getEnv('API_VERSION', 'v1'),
  };
}

// --- Database Config ---

export interface DatabaseConfig {
  url: string;
  poolSize: number;
  ssl: boolean;
}

/**
 * Get database configuration from environment
 * IMPORTANT: DATABASE_URL must be set before running the API
 */
export function getDatabaseConfig(): DatabaseConfig {
  return {
    url: getEnv('DATABASE_URL', 'postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/toolverse?schema=public'),
    poolSize: getEnvNumber('DB_POOL_SIZE', 10),
    ssl: getEnvBoolean('DB_SSL', false),
  };
}

// --- Redis Config ---

export interface RedisConfig {
  url: string;
  ttl: number;
  enabled: boolean;
}

/**
 * Get Redis configuration from environment
 */
export function getRedisConfig(): RedisConfig {
  return {
    url: getEnv('REDIS_URL', 'redis://localhost:6379'),
    ttl: getEnvNumber('REDIS_TTL', 3600), // Default 1 hour
    enabled: getEnvBoolean('REDIS_ENABLED', true),
  };
}

// --- Security Config ---

export interface SecurityConfig {
  jwtSecret: string;
  jwtExpiry: string;
  bcryptRounds: number;
  corsOrigin: string;
  rateLimitWindowMs: number;
  rateLimitMax: number;
}

/**
 * Get security configuration from environment
 * IMPORTANT: JWT_SECRET must be set in production
 */
export function getSecurityConfig(): SecurityConfig {
  const nodeEnv = getNodeEnv();
  return {
    jwtSecret: getEnv(
      'JWT_SECRET',
      nodeEnv === 'production' ? '' : 'dev-only-jwt-secret-change-in-production'
    ),
    jwtExpiry: getEnv('JWT_EXPIRY', '24h'),
    bcryptRounds: getEnvNumber('BCRYPT_ROUNDS', 12),
    corsOrigin: getEnv('CORS_ORIGIN', 'http://localhost:3000'),
    rateLimitWindowMs: getEnvNumber('RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS', 15 * 60 * 1000), // 15 minutes
    rateLimitMax: getEnvNumber('RATE_LIMIT_MAX', 100), // 100 requests per window
  };
}

// --- Logging Config ---

export interface LoggingConfig {
  level: string;
  format: 'json' | 'text';
  redactFields: string[];
}

/**
 * Get logging configuration from environment
 * IMPORTANT: Never log request bodies in production (contains passwords, PII)
 */
export function getLoggingConfig(): LoggingConfig {
  return {
    level: getEnv('LOG_LEVEL', isProduction() ? 'info' : 'debug'),
    format: getEnv('LOG_FORMAT', isProduction() ? 'json' : 'text') as 'json' | 'text',
    redactFields: ['password', 'token', 'authorization', 'creditCard', 'ssn'],
  };
}

// --- Full Config ---

export interface FullConfig {
  app: AppConfig;
  database: DatabaseConfig;
  redis: RedisConfig;
  security: SecurityConfig;
  logging: LoggingConfig;
}

/**
 * Get all configuration at once
 * Validates required values in production
 */
export function getFullConfig(): FullConfig {
  const config: FullConfig = {
    app: getAppConfig(),
    database: getDatabaseConfig(),
    redis: getRedisConfig(),
    security: getSecurityConfig(),
    logging: getLoggingConfig(),
  };

  // Production validation — fail fast if required values are missing
  if (isProduction()) {
    if (!config.security.jwtSecret) {
      throw new Error('JWT_SECRET must be set in production');
    }
    if (config.database.url.includes('localhost')) {
      throw new Error('DATABASE_URL should not point to localhost in production');
    }
  }

  return config;
}

/**
 * Print current config (redacts sensitive values)
 * Useful for debugging at startup
 */
export function printConfig(config: FullConfig): void {
  console.log('=== Application Configuration ===');
  console.log(`  Environment: ${config.app.nodeEnv}`);
  console.log(`  Port: ${config.app.port}`);
  console.log(`  App URL: ${config.app.appUrl}`);
  console.log(`  Database: ${config.database.url.replace(/\/\/[^:]+:[^@]+@/, '//***:***@')}`);
  console.log(`  Redis: ${config.redis.enabled ? config.redis.url : 'disabled'}`);
  console.log(`  CORS Origin: ${config.security.corsOrigin}`);
  console.log(`  Rate Limit: ${config.security.rateLimitMax} per ${config.security.rateLimitWindowMs / 1000}s`);
  console.log(`  Log Level: ${config.logging.level}`);
  console.log('=================================');
}

  prisma: PrismaClient | undefined;

      process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"

===== FILE: packages\db\src\index.ts =====
// ============================================================
// @platform/db — Prisma client singleton
// ============================================================
// IMPORTANT: In development, Next.js hot reloads modules constantly.
// Without this singleton pattern, you will create dozens of Prisma
// client connections and exhaust your database connection pool.
// ============================================================

import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';

const globalForPrisma = globalThis as unknown as {
  prisma: PrismaClient | undefined;
};

/**
 * Get the Prisma client instance (singleton pattern)
 */
export function getPrismaClient(): PrismaClient {
  if (globalForPrisma.prisma) {
    return globalForPrisma.prisma;
  }

  const prisma = new PrismaClient({
    log: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'
      ? ['query', 'error', 'warn']
      : ['error'],
  });

  globalForPrisma.prisma = prisma;

  return prisma;
}

/**
 * Default Prisma client instance
 */
export const prisma = getPrismaClient();

/**
 * Gracefully disconnect from the database
 */
export async function disconnectDatabase(): Promise<void> {
  if (globalForPrisma.prisma) {
    await globalForPrisma.prisma.$disconnect();
    globalForPrisma.prisma = undefined;
  }
}

/**
 * Check if the database connection is healthy
 */
export async function isDatabaseHealthy(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

// Re-export Prisma types for convenience
export type { PrismaClient };

export const db = prisma;
export type { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

import "dotenv/config";
import { db } from "./src/client.js";
import { hash } from "bcryptjs";
import { faker } from "@faker-js/faker";

const ROLES = ["ADMIN", "EDITOR", "MEMBER"] as const;
const STATUSES_TOOL = ["DRAFT", "PUBLISHED", "ARCHIVED"] as const;
const STATUSES_POST = ["DRAFT", "PUBLISHED", "ARCHIVED"] as const;
const CATEGORIES = [
  "Development",
  "Design",
  "AI & Machine Learning",
  "DevOps",
  "Security",
  "Analytics",
  "Productivity",
  "Communication",
  "Marketing",
  "Finance",
  "Education",
  "Health",
];
const TAGS = [
  "open-source",
  "free",
  "paid",
  "saas",
  "self-hosted",
  "ai-powered",
  "api",
  "cli",
  "no-code",
  "mobile",
  "collaboration",
  "automation",
  "privacy",
  "enterprise",
  "startup",
  "react",
  "nodejs",
  "python",
  "rust",
  "typescript",
  "docker",
  "kubernetes",
  "serverless",
  "real-time",
  "offline-first",
];

async function seed() {
  console.log("⏳ Seeding database...");

  // ─── 1. Users ───────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("  Creating users...");
  const rounds = parseInt(process.env.BCRYPT_ROUNDS ?? "12");
  const users: { id: string }[] = [];

  // Ensure one known admin for dev login
  users.push(
    await db.user.create({
      data: {
        email: "admin@toolverse.dev",
        name: "Admin User",
        password: await hash("password123", rounds),
        role: "ADMIN",
        avatar: faker.image.avatar(),
        emailVerified: new Date(),
      },
    }),
  );

  for (let i = 0; i < 49; i++) {
    users.push(
      await db.user.create({
        data: {
          email: faker.internet.email(),
          name: faker.person.fullName(),
          password: await hash("password123", rounds),
          role: faker.helpers.arrayElement(ROLES),
          avatar: faker.image.avatar(),
          emailVerified: faker.date.past(),
          bio: faker.lorem.sentence(),
        },
      }),
    );
  }
  console.log(`  ✅ ${users.length} users`);

  // ─── 2. Categories ──────────────────────────────────
  console.log("  Creating categories...");
  const categories: { id: string; slug: string }[] = [];

  for (const [i, name] of CATEGORIES.entries()) {
    categories.push(
      await db.category.create({
        data: {
          name,
          slug: faker.helpers.slugify(name).toLowerCase(),
          description: faker.lorem.sentence(),
          sortOrder: i,
        },
      }),
    );
  }
  console.log(`  ✅ ${categories.length} categories`);

  // ─── 3. Tags ────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("  Creating tags...");
  const tags: { id: string }[] = [];

  for (const name of TAGS) {
    tags.push(
      await db.tag.create({
        data: {
          name,
          slug: name.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").toLowerCase(),
        },
      }),
    );
  }
  console.log(`  ✅ ${tags.length} tags`);

  // ─── 4. Tools ───────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("  Creating tools...");
  const tools: { id: string }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
    const status = faker.helpers.arrayElement(STATUSES_TOOL);
    tools.push(
      await db.tool.create({
        data: {
          name: faker.commerce.productName(),
          slug: faker.helpers
            .slugify(faker.commerce.productName() + "-" + i)
            .toLowerCase(),
          description: faker.lorem.paragraphs(2),
          categoryId: faker.helpers.arrayElement(categories).id,
          authorId: faker.helpers.arrayElement(users).id,
          status,
          features: {
            pricing: faker.helpers.arrayElement([
              "free",
              "freemium",
              "paid",
              "enterprise",
            ]),
            hasApi: faker.datatype.boolean(),
            hasCli: faker.datatype.boolean(),
          },
          githubUrl: faker.datatype.boolean() ? faker.internet.url() : null,
          demoUrl: faker.datatype.boolean() ? faker.internet.url() : null,
          viewCount: faker.number.int({ min: 0, max: 50000 }),
          likeCount: faker.number.int({ min: 0, max: 2000 }),
          createdAt: faker.date.past({ years: 2 }),
        },
      }),
    );

    // Attach 1-5 random tags per tool
    const toolTags = faker.helpers.arrayElements(tags, {
      min: 1,
      max: 5,
    });
    for (const tag of toolTags) {
      await db.toolTag.create({
        data: { toolId: tools[tools.length - 1].id, tagId: tag.id },
      });
    }
  }
  console.log(`  ✅ ${tools.length} tools + tag relations`);

  // ─── 5. Blog Posts ──────────────────────────────────
  console.log("  Creating blog posts...");
  let postCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
    const status = faker.helpers.arrayElement(STATUSES_POST);
    const publishedAt =
      status === "PUBLISHED" ? faker.date.past({ years: 1 }) : null;

    await db.blogPost.create({
      data: {
        title: faker.lorem.sentence().replace(/\.$/, ""),
        slug: faker.helpers
          .slugify(faker.lorem.words(5) + "-" + i)
          .toLowerCase(),
        content: faker.lorem.paragraphs(8),
        excerpt: faker.lorem.sentence(),
        coverImage: faker.datatype.boolean()
          ? `https://picsum.photos/seed/${i}/1200/600`
          : null,
        authorId: faker.helpers.arrayElement(users).id,
        status,
        publishedAt,
        createdAt: publishedAt ?? faker.date.recent({ days: 30 }),
      },
    });
    postCount++;
  }
  console.log(`  ✅ ${postCount} blog posts`);

  // ─── 6. API Keys ────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("  Creating API keys...");
  const keyUsers = faker.helpers.arrayElements(users, { min: 5, max: 10 });

  for (const user of keyUsers) {
    await db.apiKey.create({
      data: {
        userId: user.id,
        key: `tvk_${faker.string.alphanumeric(32)}`,
        name: faker.helpers.arrayElement([
          "CLI Key",
          "Web Client",
          "Mobile App",
          "CI/CD",
        ]),
        permissions: {
          read: true,
          write: faker.datatype.boolean(),
          admin: faker.datatype.boolean({ probability: 0.1 }),
        },
        expiresAt: faker.date.future({ years: 1 }),
      },
    });
  }
  console.log(`  ✅ ${keyUsers.length} API keys`);

  // ─── 7. Comments ────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("  Creating comments...");
  let commentCount = 0;
  const publishedTools = tools; // comment on all tools for variety

  for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
    await db.comment.create({
      data: {
        content: faker.lorem.sentences(2),
        toolId: faker.helpers.arrayElement(publishedTools).id,
        authorId: faker.helpers.arrayElement(users).id,
        parentId: faker.datatype.boolean({ probability: 0.2 })
          ? undefined
          : undefined, // top-level only for simplicity
        createdAt: faker.date.recent({ days: 60 }),
      },
    });
    commentCount++;
  }
  console.log(`  ✅ ${commentCount} comments`);

  // ─── 8. Audit Logs ──────────────────────────────────
  console.log("  Creating audit logs...");
  const actions = [
    "user.login",
    "user.register",
    "tool.create",
    "tool.update",
    "tool.delete",
    "tool.publish",
    "blog.create",
    "blog.update",
    "blog.publish",
    "category.create",
    "tag.create",
    "apikey.create",
  ];
  const entities = ["User", "Tool", "BlogPost", "Category", "Tag", "ApiKey"];

  for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
    const entity = faker.helpers.arrayElement(entities);
    await db.auditLog.create({
      data: {
        userId: faker.datatype.boolean()
          ? faker.helpers.arrayElement(users).id
          : null,
        action: faker.helpers.arrayElement(actions),
        entity,
        entityId: faker.string.alphanumeric(20),
        ip: faker.internet.ipv4(),
        metadata: faker.datatype.boolean()
          ? { userAgent: faker.internet.userAgent() }
          : null,
        createdAt: faker.date.past({ years: 1 }),
      },
    });
  }
  console.log("  ✅ 150 audit logs");

  console.log("\n✅ Seed complete — 427+ records created");
}

seed()
  .catch((e) => {
    console.error("❌ Seed failed:", e);
    process.exit(1);
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await db.$disconnect();
  });

// Core calculation engine - Placeholder
export interface CalculationResult {
  value: number;
  unit?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

export const calculateBMI = (weight: number, height: number): CalculationResult => {
  const bmi = weight / (height * height);
  return { value: bmi };
};

export const calculateCompoundInterest = (
  principal: number,
  rate: number,
  years: number,
  compounds: number = 12
): CalculationResult => {
  const amount = principal * Math.pow(1 + rate / 100 / compounds, compounds * years);
  return { value: amount };
};

===== FILE: packages\errors\src\index.ts =====
// ============================================================
// @platform/errors — Structured error classes
// ============================================================

/**
 * Base application error. All custom errors extend this.
 * This ensures every error has a consistent shape for API responses.
 */
export class AppError extends Error {
  public readonly statusCode: number;
  public readonly code: string;
  public readonly isOperational: boolean;
  public readonly details?: unknown;

  constructor(
    message: string,
    statusCode: number = 500,
    code: string = 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
    isOperational: boolean = true,
    details?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = this.constructor.name;
    this.statusCode = statusCode;
    this.code = code;
    this.isOperational = isOperational;
    this.details = details;

    // Maintains proper stack trace in V8 environments (Node.js)
    Error.captureStackTrace(this, this.constructor);
  }

  /**
   * Convert to a plain object for JSON API responses
   * IMPORTANT: Never include the stack trace in API responses
   */
  toJSON(): Record<string, unknown> {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: this.code,
        message: this.message,
        ...(this.details ? { details: this.details } : {}),
      },
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 400 Bad Request — Input validation failed
 */
export class ValidationError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Validation failed', details?: unknown) {
    super(message, 400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', true, details);
  }
}

/**
 * 401 Unauthorized — Missing or invalid authentication
 */
export class AuthenticationError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Authentication required') {
    super(message, 401, 'AUTHENTICATION_ERROR', true);
  }
}

/**
 * 403 Forbidden — Authenticated but not authorized
 */
export class ForbiddenError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Access denied') {
    super(message, 403, 'FORBIDDEN_ERROR', true);
  }
}

/**
 * 404 Not Found — Resource does not exist
 */
export class NotFoundError extends AppError {
  constructor(resource: string = 'Resource') {
    super(`${resource} not found`, 404, 'NOT_FOUND', true);
  }
}

/**
 * 409 Conflict — Resource already exists or state conflict
 */
export class ConflictError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Resource conflict') {
    super(message, 409, 'CONFLICT_ERROR', true);
  }
}

/**
 * 422 Unprocessable Entity — Semantic validation failed
 */
export class UnprocessableEntityError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Unprocessable entity', details?: unknown) {
    super(message, 422, 'UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY', true, details);
  }
}

/**
 * 429 Too Many Requests — Rate limit exceeded
 */
export class RateLimitError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Too many requests, please try again later') {
    super(message, 429, 'RATE_LIMIT_ERROR', true);
  }
}

/**
 * 500 Internal Server Error — Unexpected failure
 */
export class InternalServerError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Internal server error') {
    super(message, 500, 'INTERNAL_ERROR', false);
  }
}

/**
 * 502 Bad Gateway — Upstream service returned an invalid response
 */
export class BadGatewayError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Bad gateway') {
    super(message, 502, 'BAD_GATEWAY', true);
  }
}

/**
 * 503 Service Unavailable — Upstream service is down
 */
export class ServiceUnavailableError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Service temporarily unavailable') {
    super(message, 503, 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', true);
  }
}

/**
 * Type guard to check if an error is an AppError
 */
export function isAppError(error: unknown): error is AppError {
  return error instanceof AppError;
}

/**
 * Convert any unknown error into an AppError
 * Use this in catch blocks to ensure you always have a structured error
 */
export function normalizeError(error: unknown): AppError {
  if (isAppError(error)) {
    return error;
  }

  if (error instanceof Error) {
    return new InternalServerError(error.message);
  }

  if (typeof error === 'string') {
    return new InternalServerError(error);
  }

  return new InternalServerError('An unknown error occurred');
}

/**
 * Format a success response (companion to AppError.toJSON)
 * Use this everywhere for consistent API responses
 */
export function successResponse<T>(data: T, message?: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    success: true,
    data,
    ...(message ? { message } : {}),
  };
}

/**
 * GDPR/CCPA-compliant cookie consent manager.
 * Stores consent in localStorage, exposes helpers for
 * conditional ad/script loading based on user choice.
 */
export type ConsentCategory = "necessary" | "analytics" | "advertising" | "functional";
export interface ConsentState {
    necessary: boolean;
    analytics: boolean;
    advertising: boolean;
    functional: boolean;
    timestamp: string;
    version: number;
}
export declare const CONSENT_VERSION = 1;
/**
 * Read current consent from localStorage.
 * Returns null if no consent stored (show banner).
 */
export declare function getConsent(): ConsentState | null;
/**
 * Save consent choice and fire consent update events.
 */
export declare function saveConsent(categories: {
    analytics?: boolean;
    advertising?: boolean;
    functional?: boolean;
}): ConsentState;
/**
 * Check if a specific category is consented.
 */
export declare function hasConsent(category: ConsentCategory): boolean;
/**
 * Revoke all optional consent (user opts out).
 */
export declare function revokeConsent(): ConsentState;
/**
 * Grant all consent (user accepts all).
 */
export declare function grantAllConsent(): ConsentState;

    interface Window {
        gtag: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
        dataLayer: unknown[];
    }

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useAdContext } from "./ad-provider.js";

interface AdAnchorProps {
  adSlot: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Anchor/overlay ad — fixed to bottom of viewport.
 * Includes a dismiss button per Google policy.
 */
export function AdAnchor({ adSlot, className = "" }: AdAnchorProps) {
  const { loadAd, adConsent } = useAdContext();
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState(false);
  const loaded = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!adConsent || dismissed || loaded.current) return;
    loaded.current = true;

    // Small delay so the anchor doesn't block initial page view
    const timer = setTimeout(() => loadAd(adSlot), 3000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [adSlot, adConsent, dismissed, loadAd]);

  if (!adConsent || dismissed) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 z-40 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 shadow-2xl ${className}`}
      role="complementary"
      aria-label="Advertisement"
    >
      {/* Dismiss button — required by Google */}
      <button
        onClick={() => setDismissed(true)}
        className="absolute top-2 right-3 z-10 w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 dark:hover:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
        aria-label="Dismiss advertisement"
      >
        <svg
          className="w-4 h-4"
          fill="none"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth={2}
        >
          <path
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
          />
        </svg>
      </button>

      <div className="flex justify-center py-2">
        <ins
          className="adsbygoogle"
          style={{ display: "block", width: "100%", maxHeight: "100px" }}
          data-ad-client="ca-pub-XXXXX"
          data-ad-slot={adSlot}
          data-ad-format="auto"
          data-full-width-responsive="true"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: packages\legal\src\ads\ad-provider.tsx =====
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { hasConsent } from "../consent/consent-manager.js";

/**
 * Ad context — provides lazy loading helpers and consent gating.
 * Wrap your app in <AdProvider> once.
 */

interface AdContextValue {
  /** Load an ad unit by slot ID. No-op if ads not consented. */
  loadAd: (slotId: string) => void;
  /** Whether advertising consent has been granted */
  adConsent: boolean;
}

const AdContext = createContext<AdContextValue | null>(null);

export function useAdContext(): AdContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(AdContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useAdContext must be used within <AdProvider>");
  return ctx;
}

interface AdProviderProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  /** Google AdSense publisher ID (ca-pub-XXXXX) */
  publisherId: string;
}

export function AdProvider({ children, publisherId }: AdProviderProps) {
  const [adConsent, setAdConsent] = useState(() => hasConsent("advertising"));
  const [scriptLoaded, setScriptLoaded] = useState(false);
  const pendingSlots = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // Listen for consent changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (e as CustomEvent).detail;
      if (detail?.advertising !== undefined) {
        setAdConsent(detail.advertising);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("consent:update", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("consent:update", handler);
  }, []);

  // Load AdSense script lazily — only when first ad is requested AND consent given
  const loadScript = useCallback(() => {
    if (scriptLoaded || !adConsent) return;

    // Set publisher ID for auto-ads
    (window as unknown as Record<string, string>).adsbygoogle = publisherId;

    const script = document.createElement("script");
    script.async = true;
    script.src = `https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=${publisherId}`;
    script.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
    script.onload = () => setScriptLoaded(true);
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  }, [publisherId, adConsent, scriptLoaded]);

  const loadAd = useCallback(
    (slotId: string) => {
      if (!adConsent) return;

      if (!scriptLoaded) {
        pendingSlots.current.add(slotId);
        loadScript();
        return;
      }

      // Push ad unit to Google's queue
      try {
        ((window as unknown as Record<string, unknown[]>).adsbygoogle ??=
          []).push({});
      } catch {
        // Ad blocked or script failed — silent fail
      }
    },
    [adConsent, scriptLoaded, loadScript],
  );

  // When script finishes loading, push any pending slots
  useEffect(() => {
    if (scriptLoaded && pendingSlots.current.size > 0) {
      for (const slotId of pendingSlots.current) {
        loadAd(slotId);
      }
      pendingSlots.current.clear();
    }
  }, [scriptLoaded, loadAd]);

  return (
    <AdContext.Provider value={{ loadAd, adConsent }}>
      {children}
    </AdContext.Provider>
  );
}

===== FILE: packages\legal\src\consent\consent-manager.ts =====
/**
 * GDPR/CCPA-compliant cookie consent manager.
 * Stores consent in localStorage, exposes helpers for
 * conditional ad/script loading based on user choice.
 */

const STORAGE_KEY = "toolverse-consent";

export type ConsentCategory =
  | "necessary"
  | "analytics"
  | "advertising"
  | "functional";

export interface ConsentState {
  necessary: boolean; // Always true — cannot be disabled
  analytics: boolean; // Google Analytics, etc.
  advertising: boolean; // AdSense, third-party ads
  functional: boolean; // Preferences, theme, etc.
  timestamp: string; // ISO 8601
  version: number; // Policy version — bump to re-prompt
}

export const CONSENT_VERSION = 1;

const DEFAULT_CONSENT: ConsentState = {
  necessary: true,
  analytics: false,
  advertising: false,
  functional: false,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  version: CONSENT_VERSION,
};

/**
 * Read current consent from localStorage.
 * Returns null if no consent stored (show banner).
 */
export function getConsent(): ConsentState | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as ConsentState;
    // Re-prompt if policy version changed
    if (parsed.version !== CONSENT_VERSION) return null;
    return parsed;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Save consent choice and fire consent update events.
 */
export function saveConsent(categories: {
  analytics?: boolean;
  advertising?: boolean;
  functional?: boolean;
}): ConsentState {
  const consent: ConsentState = {
    ...DEFAULT_CONSENT,
    ...categories,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(consent));

  // Fire a custom event so other parts of the app can react
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("consent:update", { detail: consent }));

  // Google Consent Mode v2 update
  if (typeof window.gtag === "function") {
    window.gtag("consent", "update", {
      analytics_storage: consent.analytics ? "granted" : "denied",
      ad_storage: consent.advertising ? "granted" : "denied",
      ad_user_data: consent.advertising ? "granted" : "denied",
      ad_personalization: consent.advertising ? "granted" : "denied",
      functionality_storage: consent.functional ? "granted" : "denied",
    });
  }

  return consent;
}

/**
 * Check if a specific category is consented.
 */
export function hasConsent(category: ConsentCategory): boolean {
  const consent = getConsent();
  if (category === "necessary") return true;
  return consent?.[category] ?? false;
}

/**
 * Revoke all optional consent (user opts out).
 */
export function revokeConsent(): ConsentState {
  return saveConsent({
    analytics: false,
    advertising: false,
    functional: false,
  });
}

/**
 * Grant all consent (user accepts all).
 */
export function grantAllConsent(): ConsentState {
  return saveConsent({
    analytics: true,
    advertising: true,
    functional: true,
  });
}

// Extend Window for gtag
declare global {
  interface Window {
    gtag: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
    dataLayer: unknown[];
  }
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  getConsent,
  saveConsent,
  grantAllConsent,
  revokeConsent,
  type ConsentState,
} from "./consent-manager.js";

type BannerView = "default" | "details";

export function CookieBanner() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [view, setView] = useState<BannerView>("default");
  const [prefs, setPrefs] = useState<
    Omit<ConsentState, "timestamp" | "version" | "necessary">
  >({
    analytics: false,
    advertising: false,
    functional: false,
  });

  // Show banner only if no valid consent
  useEffect(() => {
    const existing = getConsent();
    if (!existing) setVisible(true);
  }, []);

  // Set default consent mode (deny all) on mount — required by Google
  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible && typeof window.gtag === "function") {
      window.gtag("consent", "default", {
        analytics_storage: "denied",
        ad_storage: "denied",
        ad_user_data: "denied",
        ad_personalization: "denied",
        functionality_storage: "denied",
      });
    }
  }, [visible]);

  const handleAcceptAll = useCallback(() => {
    grantAllConsent();
    setVisible(false);
  }, []);

  const handleRejectAll = useCallback(() => {
    revokeConsent();
    setVisible(false);
  }, []);

  const handleSave = useCallback(() => {
    saveConsent(prefs);
    setVisible(false);
  }, [prefs]);

  if (!visible) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-label="Cookie consent"
      aria-modal="false"
      className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-50 p-4 sm:p-6"
    >
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        {view === "default" ? (
          <div className="p-5 sm:p-6">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <div
                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <svg
                  className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth={1.5}
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    d="M12 9v3.75m-9.303 3.376c-.866 1.5.217 3.374 1.948 3.374h14.71c1.73 0 2.813-1.874 1.948-3.374L13.949 3.378c-.866-1.5-3.032-1.5-3.898 0L2.697 16.126zM12 15.75h.007v.008H12v-.008z"
                  />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
                  We use cookies
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">
                  We use cookies and similar technologies to serve ads, analyze
                  traffic, and improve your experience. You can choose which
                  categories to allow.{" "}
                  <a
                    href="/privacy"
                    className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 underline hover:no-underline"
                  >
                    Learn more
                  </a>
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-3 mt-5">
              <button
                onClick={handleRejectAll}
                className="order-2 sm:order-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2 dark:focus:ring-offset-gray-900"
              >

              </button>
              <button

              >
                Customize
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleAcceptAll}
                className="order-1 sm:order-3 rounded-lg bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2 dark:focus:ring-offset-gray-900"
              >
                Accept all

            </div>

        ) : (

                >

              </div>
            </div>

        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Toggle row sub-component ────────────────────────────

interface ToggleRowProps {
  label: string;
  description: string;
  checked: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
}

function ToggleRow({
  label,
  description,
  checked,
  disabled,
  onChange,
}: ToggleRowProps) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
      <button
        role="switch"
        aria-checked={checked}
        aria-label={label}
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => onChange?.(!checked)}
        className={[
          "relative mt-0.5 inline-flex h-6 w-11 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full transition-colors",
          "focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2 dark:focus:ring-offset-gray-900",
          checked ? "bg-blue-600" : "bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700",
          disabled ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed" : "cursor-pointer",
        ].join(" ")}
      >
        <span
          className={[
            "inline-block h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-transform",
            checked ? "translate-x-6" : "translate-x-1",
          ].join(" ")}
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      </button>
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
          {label}
          {disabled && (
            <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 font-normal">
              (Always active)
            </span>
          )}
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
          {description}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Queue, type Job } from "bullmq";
export type JobType = "generate-pdf" | "send-email" | "sync-data" | "build-report";
export interface JobPayloads {
    "generate-pdf": {
        toolId: string;
        format: "pdf" | "html";
    };
    "send-email": {
        to: string;
        subject: string;
        template: string;
        data: Record<string, unknown>;
    };
    "sync-data": {
        source: string;
        entity: string;
    };
    "build-report": {
        type: "analytics" | "usage" | "revenue";
        dateRange: [string, string];
    };
}
export declare const jobQueue: Queue<any, unknown, string, any, unknown, string>;
export declare function registerProcessor<T extends JobType>(type: T, handler: (job: Job<JobPayloads[T]>) => Promise<unknown>): void;
export declare function startWorkers(concurrency?: number): void;
export declare function stopWorkers(): void;
export declare function enqueuePdf(toolId: string, format?: "pdf" | "html"): Promise<Job<any, unknown, string>>;
export declare function enqueueEmail(to: string, subject: string, template: string, data: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Job<any, unknown, string>>;
export declare function enqueueSync(source: string, entity: string): Promise<Job<any, unknown, string>>;
export declare function enqueueReport(type: "analytics" | "usage" | "revenue", dateRange: [string, string]): Promise<Job<any, unknown, string>>;
