import { Queue, Worker, type Job, type Processor } from "bullmq";
import { Redis } from "ioredis";

const connection = new Redis(
  process.env.REDIS_URL ?? "redis://localhost:6379",
  { maxRetriesPerRequest: null }, // Required by BullMQ
);

// ─── Type-safe job definitions ───────────────────────────

export type JobType =
  | "generate-pdf"
  | "send-email"
  | "sync-data"
  | "build-report";

export interface JobPayloads {
  "generate-pdf": { toolId: string; format: "pdf" | "html" };
  "send-email": {
    to: string;
    subject: string;
    template: string;
    data: Record<string, unknown>;
  };
  "sync-data": { source: string; entity: string };
  "build-report": {
    type: "analytics" | "usage" | "revenue";
    dateRange: [string, string];
  };
}

// ─── Queue ───────────────────────────────────────────────

export const jobQueue = new Queue<any, unknown, string>("toolverse-jobs", {
  connection,
  defaultJobOptions: {
    attempts: 3,
    backoff: { type: "exponential", delay: 2000 },
    removeOnComplete: { count: 200 },
    removeOnFail: { count: 100 },
  },
});

// ─── Processor registry ──────────────────────────────────

const processors = new Map<JobType, Processor>();

export function registerProcessor<T extends JobType>(
  type: T,
  handler: (job: Job<JobPayloads[T]>) => Promise<unknown>,
) {
  processors.set(type, handler as Processor);
}

// ─── Worker lifecycle ────────────────────────────────────

let workers: Worker[] = [];

export function startWorkers(concurrency: number = 3) {
  stopWorkers();

  const worker = new Worker<any, unknown, string>(
    "toolverse-jobs",
    async (job) => {
      const handler = processors.get(job.name as JobType);
      if (!handler) {
        throw new Error(`No processor registered for: ${job.name}`);
      }
      return handler(job as Job<JobPayloads[JobType]>);
    },
    { connection, concurrency },
  );

  worker.on("completed", (job) => {
    console.log(`[Queue] ✅ ${job.id} (${job.name}) completed`);
  });

  worker.on("failed", (job, err) => {
    console.error(`[Queue] ❌ ${job?.id} (${job?.name}) failed:`, err.message);
  });

  workers = [worker];
}

export function stopWorkers() {
  for (const w of workers) w.close();
  workers = [];
}

// ─── Enqueue helpers ─────────────────────────────────────

export async function enqueuePdf(
  toolId: string,
  format: "pdf" | "html" = "pdf",
) {
  return jobQueue.add(
    "generate-pdf",
    { toolId, format },
    {
      jobId: `pdf:${toolId}:${Date.now()}`,
      priority: 1,
    },
  );
}

export async function enqueueEmail(
  to: string,
  subject: string,
  template: string,
  data: Record<string, unknown>,
) {
  return jobQueue.add(
    "send-email",
    { to, subject, template, data },
    {
      jobId: `email:${to}:${Date.now()}`,
      priority: 5,
    },
  );
}

export async function enqueueSync(source: string, entity: string) {
  return jobQueue.add(
    "sync-data",
    { source, entity },
    {
      jobId: `sync:${source}:${entity}:${Date.now()}`,
      priority: 3,
    },
  );
}

export async function enqueueReport(
  type: "analytics" | "usage" | "revenue",
  dateRange: [string, string],
) {
  return jobQueue.add(
    "build-report",
    { type, dateRange },
    {
      jobId: `report:${type}:${dateRange[0]}:${Date.now()}`,
      priority: 2,
    },
  );
}

===== FILE: packages\seo\src\content.ts =====
import type { ContentAnalysis } from "./types.js";

/**
 * Analyze HTML content for SEO quality.
 * Call this before saving a tool page to enforce minimum content standards.
 */
export function analyzeContent(html: string): ContentAnalysis {
  const issues: string[] = [];
  let score = 100;

  // ─── Word count ─────────────────────────────────────
  const textContent = stripHtml(html);
  const words = textContent.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const wordCount = words.length;
  const MINIMUM_WORDS = 500;

  if (wordCount < MINIMUM_WORDS) {
    issues.push(
      `Content has ${wordCount} words, minimum ${MINIMUM_WORDS} required for SEO`,
    );
    score -= 40;
  } else if (wordCount < 800) {
    issues.push("Content is acceptable but consider expanding to 800+ words");
    score -= 10;
  }

  // ─── Headings ───────────────────────────────────────
  const headingRegex = /<(h[1-6])[^>]*>(.*?)<\/\1>/gi;
  const headings: { level: number; text: string }[] = [];
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = headingRegex.exec(html)) !== null) {
    headings.push({
      level: parseInt(match[1][1]),
      text: stripHtml(match[2]).trim(),
    });
  }

  const hasH1 = headings.some((h) => h.level === 1);
  const hasH2 = headings.some((h) => h.level === 2);

  if (!hasH1) {
    issues.push("Missing H1 heading — every page needs exactly one H1");
    score -= 15;
  } else if (headings.filter((h) => h.level === 1).length > 1) {
    issues.push("Multiple H1 headings found — use only one H1 per page");
    score -= 10;
  }

  if (!hasH2) {
    issues.push("No H2 headings found — add H2s to structure content");
    score -= 10;
  }

  // ─── Images ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const imgRegex = /<img[^>]*>/gi;
  const images = html.match(imgRegex) ?? [];
  const imageCount = images.length;

  const imagesWithoutAlt = images.filter(
    (img) => !/alt\s*=\s*["'][^"']+["']/i.test(img),
  );

  if (imageCount === 0) {
    issues.push("No images found — add at least one relevant image");
    score -= 5;
  }

  if (imagesWithoutAlt.length > 0) {
    issues.push(`${imagesWithoutAlt.length} image(s) missing alt text`);
    score -= imagesWithoutAlt.length * 3;
  }

  // ─── Links ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const internalLinkRegex = /<a[^>]*href=["']\/[^"']*["'][^>]*>/gi;
  const externalLinkRegex = /<a[^>]*href=["']https?:\/\/[^"']*["'][^>]*>/gi;

  const internalLinkCount = (html.match(internalLinkRegex) ?? []).length;
  const externalLinkCount = (html.match(externalLinkRegex) ?? []).length;

  if (internalLinkCount === 0) {
    issues.push(
      "No internal links found — link to related tools and categories",
    );
    score -= 10;
  } else if (internalLinkCount < 3) {
    issues.push("Few internal links — aim for at least 3 internal links");
    score -= 5;
  }

  // ─── Title length in H1 ─────────────────────────────
  const h1Text = headings.find((h) => h.level === 1)?.text;
  if (h1Text && h1Text.length > 70) {
    issues.push(
      "H1 is too long — keep under 70 characters for optimal display",
    );
    score -= 5;
  }

  // ─── Paragraph length ───────────────────────────────
  const paragraphs = html.match(/<p[^>]*>(.*?)<\/p>/gi) ?? [];
  const longParagraphs = paragraphs.filter((p) => {
    const words = stripHtml(p).split(/\s+/).length;
    return words > 150;
  });
  if (longParagraphs.length > 0) {
    issues.push(
      `${longParagraphs.length} paragraph(s) exceed 150 words — break into shorter paragraphs`,
    );
    score -= longParagraphs.length * 2;
  }

  // Clamp score
  score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));

  return {
    wordCount,
    passesMinimum: wordCount >= MINIMUM_WORDS,
    minimumRequired: MINIMUM_WORDS,
    headings,
    hasH1,
    hasH2,
    imageCount,
    internalLinkCount,
    externalLinkCount,
    issues,
    score,
  };
}

/**
 * Extract a meaningful description from HTML content.
 * Used for auto-generating meta descriptions when none provided.
 */
export function extractDescription(
  html: string,
  maxLength: number = 160,
): string {
  const text = stripHtml(html).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

  if (text.length <= maxLength) return text;

  // Try to break at sentence boundary
  const truncated = text.slice(0, maxLength);
  const lastPeriod = truncated.lastIndexOf(".");
  const lastSpace = truncated.lastIndexOf(" ");

  if (lastPeriod > maxLength * 0.5) {
    return truncated.slice(0, lastPeriod + 1);
  }
  if (lastSpace > 0) {
    return truncated.slice(0, lastSpace) + "...";
  }

  return truncated + "...";
}

function stripHtml(html: string): string {
  return html
    .replace(/<script[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, "")
    .replace(/<style[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, "")
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/&nbsp;/g, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .replace(/&lt;/g, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/g, ">")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#039;/g, "'")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

import type { WebApplicationJsonLd, BreadcrumbItem, FaqItem } from "./types.js";

/**
 * Build JSON-LD for WebApplication schema.
 * Use on every tool page.
 */
export function buildWebApplicationJsonLd(tool: WebApplicationJsonLd): object {
  return {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "WebApplication",
    name: tool.name,
    description: tool.description,
    url: tool.url,
    applicationCategory: tool.applicationCategory,
    operatingSystem: tool.operatingSystem,
    ...(tool.image && { image: tool.image }),
    ...(tool.screenshot && { screenshot: tool.screenshot }),
    ...(tool.featureList && { featureList: tool.featureList }),
    ...(tool.offers && {
      offers: {
        "@type": "Offer",
        price: tool.offers.price,
        priceCurrency: tool.offers.priceCurrency,
        ...(tool.offers.category && { category: tool.offers.category }),
      },
    }),
    ...(tool.aggregateRating && {
      aggregateRating: {
        "@type": "AggregateRating",
        ratingValue: tool.aggregateRating.ratingValue,
        ratingCount: tool.aggregateRating.ratingCount,
        bestRating: tool.aggregateRating.bestRating ?? 5,
      },
    }),
  };
}

/**
 * Build JSON-LD for ItemList (tool listing pages).
 */
export function buildItemListJsonLd(options: {
  name: string;
  url: string;
  items: { name: string; url: string; position: number }[];
}): object {
  return {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "ItemList",
    name: options.name,
    url: options.url,
    numberOfItems: options.items.length,
    itemListElement: options.items.map((item) => ({
      "@type": "ListItem",
      position: item.position,
      name: item.name,
      url: item.url,
    })),
  };
}

/**
 * Build JSON-LD for BreadcrumbList.
 * Use on every page except homepage.
 */
export function buildBreadcrumbJsonLd(items: BreadcrumbItem[]): object {
  return {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
    itemListElement: items.map((item, index) => ({
      "@type": "ListItem",
      position: index + 1,
      name: item.name,
      item: item.url,
    })),
  };
}

/**
 * Build JSON-LD for FAQPage.
 * Use on tool pages that have FAQ sections.
 */
export function buildFaqJsonLd(faqs: FaqItem[]): object {
  return {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "FAQPage",
    mainEntity: faqs.map((faq) => ({
      "@type": "Question",
      name: faq.question,
      acceptedAnswer: {
        "@type": "Answer",
        text: faq.answer,
      },
    })),
  };
}

/**
 * Build JSON-LD for Organization (homepage only).
 */
export function buildOrganizationJsonLd(options: {
  name: string;
  url: string;
  logo: string;
  description: string;
  sameAs?: string[];
}): object {
  return {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "Organization",
    name: options.name,
    url: options.url,
    logo: options.logo,
    description: options.description,
    ...(options.sameAs && { sameAs: options.sameAs }),
  };
}

 * Build JSON-LD for BlogPosting.
 */
export function buildBlogPostingJsonLd(post: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  url: string;
  image?: string;
  author: { name: string; url?: string };
  publishedTime: string;
  modifiedTime: string;
}): object {
  return {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "BlogPosting",
    headline: post.title,
    description: post.description,
    url: post.url,
    ...(post.image && { image: post.image }),
    author: {
      "@type": "Person",
      name: post.author.name,
      ...(post.author.url && { url: post.author.url }),
    },
    datePublished: post.publishedTime,
    dateModified: post.modifiedTime,
    publisher: {
      "@type": "Organization",
      name: "ToolVerse",
      logo: {
        "@type": "ImageObject",
        url: "https://toolverse.dev/logo.png",
      },
    },
  };
}

import type { SeoMeta } from "./types.js";

const SITE_NAME = "ToolVerse";
const DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE = "/og-default.png";
const DEFAULT_TWITTER_HANDLE = "@toolverse";

/**
 * Build complete <head> meta tags for a page.
 * Returns an array of { property/content, value } pairs.
 * Framework-agnostic — adapt to your template system.
 */
export function buildMetaTags(meta: SeoMeta, siteUrl: string) {
  const tags: { attribute: string; key: string; value: string }[] = [];
  const canonical = meta.canonical || siteUrl;

  // ─── Core SEO ───────────────────────────────────────
  tags.push({ attribute: "name", key: "title", value: meta.title });
  tags.push({ attribute: "name", key: "description", value: meta.description });

  if (meta.keywords?.length) {
    tags.push({
      attribute: "name",
      key: "keywords",
      value: meta.keywords.join(", "),
    });
  }

  tags.push({ attribute: "rel", key: "canonical", value: canonical });

  // ─── Robots ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const robots: string[] = [];
  if (meta.noindex) robots.push("noindex");
  if (meta.nofollow) robots.push("nofollow");
  if (robots.length === 0) robots.push("index", "follow");
  tags.push({ attribute: "name", key: "robots", value: robots.join(", ") });

  // ─── Open Graph ─────────────────────────────────────
  const ogTitle = meta.title.includes(SITE_NAME)
    ? meta.title
    : `${meta.title} | ${SITE_NAME}`;
  const ogImage = meta.ogImage
    ? meta.ogImage.startsWith("http")
      ? meta.ogImage
      : `${siteUrl}${meta.ogImage}`
    : `${siteUrl}${DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE}`;

  tags.push({ attribute: "property", key: "og:title", value: ogTitle });
  tags.push({
    attribute: "property",
    key: "og:description",
    value: meta.description,
  });
  tags.push({ attribute: "property", key: "og:image", value: ogImage });
  tags.push({ attribute: "property", key: "og:url", value: canonical });
  tags.push({
    attribute: "property",
    key: "og:type",
    value: meta.ogType ?? "website",
  });
  tags.push({ attribute: "property", key: "og:site_name", value: SITE_NAME });
  tags.push({ attribute: "property", key: "og:image:width", value: "1200" });
  tags.push({ attribute: "property", key: "og:image:height", value: "630" });

  if (meta.publishedTime) {
    tags.push({
      attribute: "property",
      key: "article:published_time",
      value: meta.publishedTime,
    });
  }
  if (meta.modifiedTime) {
    tags.push({
      attribute: "property",
      key: "article:modified_time",
      value: meta.modifiedTime,
    });
  }
  if (meta.author) {
    tags.push({
      attribute: "property",
      key: "article:author",
      value: meta.author,
    });
  }

  // ─── Twitter Card ──────────────────────────────────
  tags.push({
    attribute: "name",
    key: "twitter:card",
    value: "summary_large_image",
  });
  tags.push({
    attribute: "name",
    key: "twitter:site",
    value: DEFAULT_TWITTER_HANDLE,
  });
  tags.push({ attribute: "name", key: "twitter:title", value: ogTitle });
  tags.push({
    attribute: "name",
    key: "twitter:description",
    value: meta.description,
  });
  tags.push({ attribute: "name", key: "twitter:image", value: ogImage });

  return tags;
}

/**
 * Generate meta tags specifically for a tool page.
 */
export function buildToolMeta(
  tool: {
    name: string;
    slug: string;
    description: string;
    category: string;
    author?: string;
    features?: string[];
    githubUrl?: string;
    createdAt: string;
    updatedAt: string;
  },
  siteUrl: string,
): SeoMeta {
  const title = `${tool.name} - ${tool.category} AI Tool | ToolVerse`;
  const description =
    tool.description.length > 160
      ? tool.description.slice(0, 157) + "..."
      : tool.description;

  return {
    title,
    description,
    canonical: `${siteUrl}/tools/${tool.slug}`,
    ogImage: `/api/og/tool/${tool.slug}`, // dynamic OG image endpoint
    ogType: "website",
    author: tool.author,
    publishedTime: tool.createdAt,
    modifiedTime: tool.updatedAt,
    keywords: [
      tool.name,
      tool.category,
      "AI tool",
      ...(tool.features?.slice(0, 5) ?? []),
    ],
  };
}

/**
 * Generate meta tags for a blog post.
 */
export function buildBlogMeta(
  post: {
    title: string;
    slug: string;
    excerpt?: string;
    author: string;
    coverImage?: string;
    publishedAt?: string;
    updatedAt: string;
  },
  siteUrl: string,
): SeoMeta {
  const description = post.excerpt?.length
    ? post.excerpt.length > 160
      ? post.excerpt.slice(0, 157) + "..."
      : post.excerpt
    : `Read "${post.title}" on ToolVerse — your directory of AI tools and resources.`;

  return {
    title: `${post.title} | ToolVerse Blog`,
    description,
    canonical: `${siteUrl}/blog/${post.slug}`,
    ogImage: post.coverImage || undefined,
    ogType: "article",
    author: post.author,
    publishedTime: post.publishedAt,
    modifiedTime: post.updatedAt,
    keywords: [post.title, "ToolVerse blog"],
  };
}

import type { RedirectRule } from "./types.js";

/**
 * Find a matching redirect for a given path.
 * Checks exact matches first, then pattern-based.
 */
export function findRedirect(
  path: string,
  rules: RedirectRule[],
): RedirectRule | null {
  // Exact match (fast path)
  const exact = rules.find((r) => r.enabled && r.from === path);
  if (exact) return exact;

  // Pattern match: support trailing slash normalization
  // e.g. "/tools/old/" matches rule for "/tools/old"
  const noTrailingSlash = path.replace(/\/+$/, "");
  const slashVariant = rules.find(
    (r) => r.enabled && r.from.replace(/\/+$/, "") === noTrailingSlash,
  );
  if (slashVariant) return slashVariant;

  // Prefix match: "/old-category/*" → "/new-category/*"
  const prefixRule = rules.find((r) => {
    if (!r.enabled || !r.from.endsWith("/*")) return false;
    const prefix = r.from.slice(0, -2); // remove "/*"
    return path.startsWith(prefix + "/");
  });
  if (prefixRule) return prefixRule;

  return null;
}

/**
 * Resolve the final destination URL for a path + redirect rule.
 * Handles prefix wildcards by replacing /* with the remaining path.
 */
export function resolveRedirect(path: string, rule: RedirectRule): string {
  if (rule.from.endsWith("/*")) {
    const prefix = rule.from.slice(0, -2);
    const remaining = path.slice(prefix.length);
    return rule.to.replace("/*", remaining);
  }
  return rule.to;
}

/**
 * Sort rules: exact matches first, then prefix patterns, longer prefixes first.
 */
export function sortRedirectRules(rules: RedirectRule[]): RedirectRule[] {
  return [...rules].sort((a, b) => {
    const aIsPrefix = a.from.endsWith("/*");
    const bIsPrefix = b.from.endsWith("/*");

    // Exact matches before prefix patterns
    if (!aIsPrefix && bIsPrefix) return -1;
    if (aIsPrefix && !bIsPrefix) return 1;

    // Both same type — sort by length descending (more specific first)
    return b.from.length - a.from.length;
  });
}

/**
 * Default redirects every project should have.
 */
export const defaultRedirects: Omit<RedirectRule, "id" | "createdAt">[] = [
  { from: "/home", to: "/", type: 301, enabled: true, note: "Homepage alias" },
  {
    from: "/tool",
    to: "/tools",
    type: 301,
    enabled: true,
    note: "Singular to plural",
  },
  {
    from: "/tool/*",
    to: "/tools/*",
    type: 301,
    enabled: true,
    note: "Singular to plural prefix",
  },
  {
    from: "/category",
    to: "/categories",
    type: 301,
    enabled: true,
    note: "Singular to plural",
  },
  {
    from: "/category/*",
    to: "/categories/*",
    type: 301,
    enabled: true,
    note: "Singular to plural prefix",
  },
  {
    from: "/post/*",

    type: 301,
    enabled: true,
    note: "Old blog URL structure",
  },

    from: "/articles/*",

    type: 301,

export interface RobotsTxtConfig {
  siteUrl: string;
  disallow?: string[];
  allow?: string[];
  sitemaps?: string[];
  additionalDirectives?: string[];
}

/**
 * Generate a robots.txt file content.
 */
export function buildRobotsTxt(config: RobotsTxtConfig): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];

  // User-agent blocks
  lines.push("User-agent: *");
  lines.push("");

  // Disallow paths
  if (config.disallow?.length) {
    for (const path of config.disallow) {
      lines.push(`Disallow: ${path}`);
    }
    lines.push("");
  }

  // Allow paths (override disallow for specific paths)
  if (config.allow?.length) {
    for (const path of config.allow) {
      lines.push(`Allow: ${path}`);
    }
    lines.push("");
  }

  // Sitemaps
  if (config.sitemaps?.length) {
    for (const sitemap of config.sitemaps) {
      lines.push(`Sitemap: ${sitemap}`);
    }
    lines.push("");
  }

  // Additional directives (Crawl-delay, etc.)
  if (config.additionalDirectives?.length) {
    lines.push(...config.additionalDirectives);
    lines.push("");
  }

  return lines.join("\n").trim() + "\n";
}

/**
 * Default production robots.txt config.
 */

===== FILE: packages\seo\src\sitemap.ts =====
import type { SitemapEntry } from "./types.js";

/**
 * Generate a complete XML sitemap string.
 */
export function buildSitemap(
  entries: SitemapEntry[],
  options?: {
    siteUrl?: string;
    additionalNamespaces?: Record<string, string>;
  },
): string {
  const siteUrl = options?.siteUrl ?? "https://toolverse.dev";

  const namespaces = [
    'xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9"',
    ...(options?.additionalNamespaces
      ? Object.entries(options.additionalNamespaces).map(
          ([prefix, uri]) => `xmlns:${prefix}="${uri}"`,
        )
      : []),
  ].join(" ");

  const urls = entries.map((entry) => {
    const loc = entry.loc.startsWith("http")
      ? entry.loc
      : `${siteUrl}${entry.loc}`;

    const parts = [`    <loc>${escapeXml(loc)}</loc>`];

    if (entry.lastmod) {
      parts.push(`    <lastmod>${entry.lastmod}</lastmod>`);
    }
    if (entry.changefreq) {
      parts.push(`    <changefreq>${entry.changefreq}</changefreq>`);
    }
    if (entry.priority !== undefined) {
      parts.push(`    <priority>${entry.priority.toFixed(1)}</priority>`);
    }

    return `  <url>\n${parts.join("\n")}\n  </url>`;
  });

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<urlset ${namespaces}>
 ${urls.join("\n")}
</urlset>`;
}

/**
 * Generate a sitemap index file for when you have multiple sitemaps.
 */
export function buildSitemapIndex(
  sitemaps: {
    path: string;
    lastmod?: string;
  }[],
  siteUrl?: string,
): string {
  const base = siteUrl ?? "https://toolverse.dev";

  const entries = sitemaps.map((s) => {
    const loc = s.path.startsWith("http") ? s.path : `${base}${s.path}`;
    const parts = [`    <loc>${escapeXml(loc)}</loc>`];
    if (s.lastmod) parts.push(`    <lastmod>${s.lastmod}</lastmod>`);
    return `  <sitemap>\n${parts.join("\n")}\n  </sitemap>`;
  });

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sitemapindex xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">
 ${entries.join("\n")}
</sitemapindex>`;
}

/**
 * Build tool entries from database rows.
 */
export function buildToolSitemapEntries(
  tools: {
    slug: string;
    updatedAt: string;
    status: string;
  }[],
): SitemapEntry[] {
  return tools
    .filter((t) => t.status === "PUBLISHED")
    .map((t) => ({
      loc: `/tools/${t.slug}`,
      lastmod: t.updatedAt.split("T")[0],
      changefreq: "weekly" as const,
      priority: 0.8,
    }));
}

/**
 * Build blog entries from database rows.
 */
export function buildBlogSitemapEntries(
  posts: {
    slug: string;
    publishedAt?: string;
    updatedAt: string;
    status: string;
  }[],
): SitemapEntry[] {
  return posts
    .filter((p) => p.status === "PUBLISHED")
    .map((p) => ({
      loc: `/blog/${p.slug}`,
      lastmod: (p.publishedAt ?? p.updatedAt).split("T")[0],
      changefreq: "monthly" as const,
      priority: 0.6,
    }));
}

/**
 * Static pages that should always be in the sitemap.
 */
export function buildStaticEntries(): SitemapEntry[] {
  return [
    { loc: "/", changefreq: "daily", priority: 1.0 },
    { loc: "/tools", changefreq: "daily", priority: 0.9 },
    { loc: "/categories", changefreq: "weekly", priority: 0.7 },
    { loc: "/blog", changefreq: "daily", priority: 0.7 },
    { loc: "/about", changefreq: "monthly", priority: 0.3 },
    { loc: "/contact", changefreq: "yearly", priority: 0.2 },
    { loc: "/privacy", changefreq: "yearly", priority: 0.1 },
    { loc: "/terms", changefreq: "yearly", priority: 0.1 },
  ];
}

function escapeXml(str: string): string {
  return str
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&apos;");
}

/**
 * SEO-friendly URL slug generator.
 * Handles Unicode, special characters, diacritics, and collisions.
 */

const STOP_WORDS = new Set([
  "a",
  "an",
  "the",
  "and",
  "or",
  "but",
  "in",
  "on",
  "at",
  "to",
  "for",
  "of",
  "with",
  "by",
  "is",
  "it",
  "as",
  "be",
  "was",
  "are",
  "been",
  "from",
  "has",
  "had",
  "not",
  "this",
  "that",
  "which",
  "who",
  "whom",
  "its",
  "their",
  "our",
  "your",
  "my",
]);

// Common replacements for tool/software names
const REPLACEMENTS: Record<string, string> = {
  "&": "and",
  "@": "at",
  "+": "plus",
  "#": "number",
  ".net": "-net",
  ".js": "-js",
  ".ts": "-ts",
  ".py": "-py",
  ".ai": "-ai",
  ".io": "-io",
  "c++": "cpp",
  "c#": "csharp",
  "f#": "fsharp",
  "node.js": "nodejs",
  "node.jsx": "nodejsx",
};

/**
 * Strip diacritics: café → cafe, naïve → naive
 */
function stripDiacritics(str: string): string {
  return str.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "");
}

/**
 * Generate a URL-safe slug from any string.
 */
export function generateSlug(
  input: string,
  options?: { maxLength?: number; separator?: string },
): string {
  const maxLength = options?.maxLength ?? 80;
  const separator = options?.separator ?? "-";

  let slug = input.trim().toLowerCase();

  // Apply known replacements first
  for (const [from, to] of Object.entries(REPLACEMENTS)) {
    slug = slug.replace(new RegExp(from, "gi"), to);
  }

  // Strip diacritics
  slug = stripDiacritics(slug);

  // Replace non-alphanumeric with separator
  slug = slug.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, separator);

  // Remove leading/trailing separators
  slug = slug.replace(new RegExp(`^\\${separator}+|\\${separator}+$`, "g"), "");

  // Collapse multiple separators
  slug = slug.replace(new RegExp(`\\${separator}{2,}`, "g"), separator);

  // Remove stop words from middle (not first/last word)
  const words = slug.split(separator);
  const filtered = words
    .map((word, i) => {
      if (i === 0 || i === words.length - 1) return word;
      return STOP_WORDS.has(word) ? undefined : word;
    })
    .filter(Boolean);

  slug = filtered.join(separator);

  // Truncate at word boundary
  if (slug.length > maxLength) {
    slug = slug.slice(0, maxLength);
    const lastSep = slug.lastIndexOf(separator);
    if (lastSep > 0) slug = slug.slice(0, lastSep);
  }

  // Remove trailing separator after truncation
  slug = slug.replace(new RegExp(`\\${separator}+$`, "g"), "");

  return slug || "untitled";
}

/**
 * Generate a slug and append a numeric suffix if needed for uniqueness.
 * Provide an `exists` function that checks the database.
 */
export async function generateUniqueSlug(
  input: string,
  exists: (slug: string) => Promise<boolean>,
  options?: { maxLength?: number; separator?: string },
): Promise<string> {
  let slug = generateSlug(input, options);

  if (!(await exists(slug))) return slug;

  let suffix = 2;
  let candidate: string;

  do {
    candidate = `${slug}${options?.separator ?? "-"}${suffix}`;
    suffix++;
  } while (await exists(candidate));

  return candidate;
}

/**
 * Validate a slug against SEO rules.
 */
export function validateSlug(slug: string): {
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
} {
  const errors: string[] = [];

  if (slug.length < 3) errors.push("Slug must be at least 3 characters");
  if (slug.length > 80) errors.push("Slug must be at most 80 characters");
  if (/^-|-$/.test(slug)) errors.push("Slug cannot start or end with a hyphen");
  if (/--/.test(slug)) errors.push("Slug cannot contain consecutive hyphens");
  if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(slug))
    errors.push(
      "Slug can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens",
    );
  if (STOP_WORDS.has(slug)) errors.push("Slug should not be a stop word");

  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

        componentStack: string;

===== FILE: packages\ui\src\components\feedback\empty-state.tsx =====
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

interface EmptyStateProps {
  icon?: ReactNode;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  action?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

export function EmptyState({
  icon,
  title,
  description,
  action,
  className,
}: EmptyStateProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 px-4 text-center animate-fade-in",
        className,
      )}
    >
      {icon && (
        <div
          className="mb-4 text-[var(--text-muted)] w-12 h-12 flex items-center justify-center"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          {icon}
        </div>
      )}
      <h3 className="font-display text-lg font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-2">
        {title}
      </h3>
      {description && (
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] max-w-sm mb-6 leading-relaxed">
          {description}
        </p>
      )}
      {action}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: packages\ui\src\components\feedback\error-boundary.tsx =====
import { Component, type ReactNode } from "react";

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error?: Error;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  constructor(props: Props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, info: { componentStack: string }) {
    console.error("[ErrorBoundary]", error, info);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      if (this.props.fallback) return this.props.fallback;
      return (
        <div className="card card-body text-center py-12 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="text-4xl mb-4">⚠️</div>
          <h3 className="font-display text-xl mb-2">Something went wrong</h3>
          <p className="text-secondary text-sm mb-6">
            An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
          </p>
          <button
            className="btn btn-primary mx-auto"
            onClick={() => this.setState({ hasError: false, error: undefined })}
          >
            Try again
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

interface SkeletonProps {
  className?: string;
  lines?: number;
  circle?: boolean;
}

export function Skeleton({ className, lines = 1, circle }: SkeletonProps) {
  if (circle) {
    return (
      <div
        className={cn("skeleton skeleton-avatar", className)}
        aria-hidden="true"
      />
    );
  }

  if (lines === 1) {
    return (
      <div
        className={cn("skeleton skeleton-text", className)}
        aria-hidden="true"
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2" aria-hidden="true">
      {Array.from({ length: lines }).map((_, i) => (
        <div
          key={i}
          className={cn(
            "skeleton skeleton-text",
            i === lines - 1 && "w-3/4",
            className,
          )}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: packages\ui\src\components\input\file-upload.tsx =====
import { useCallback, useRef, useState, type DragEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

interface FileUploadProps {
  label: string;
  accept?: string;
  maxSize?: number;
  multiple?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  onFiles: (files: File[]) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export function FileUpload({
  label,
  accept,
  maxSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024,
  multiple = false,
  error,
  onFiles,
  className,
}: FileUploadProps) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false);
  const [fileNames, setFileNames] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const processFiles = useCallback(
    (files: FileList | null) => {
      if (!files) return;
      const arr = Array.from(files);
      const valid = arr.filter((f) => {
        if (f.size > maxSize) return false;
        if (accept) {
          const types = accept.split(",").map((t) => t.trim());
          if (!types.some((t) => f.type === t || f.name.endsWith(t.replace("*.", "."))))
            return false;
        }
        return true;
      });
      setFileNames(valid.map((f) => f.name));
      onFiles(valid);
    },
    [accept, maxSize, onFiles],
  );

  const handleDrop = useCallback(
    (e: DragEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setDragOver(false);
      processFiles(e.dataTransfer.files);
    },
    [processFiles],
  );

  const inputId = `file-${label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-")}`;

  return (
    <div className={cn("space-y-1.5", className)}>
      <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
        {label}
      </label>
      <div
        role="button"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-label={`Upload ${label.toLowerCase()}`}
        aria-describedby={error ? `${inputId}-error` : undefined}
        className={cn(
          "relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed p-8 text-center cursor-pointer transition-colors",
          "focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2",
          dragOver
            ? "border-blue-400 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/10"
            : error
              ? "border-red-300 dark:border-red-700 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/10"
              : "border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900 hover:border-gray-400 dark:hover:border-gray-600",
        )}
        onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setDragOver(true); }}
        onDragLeave={() => setDragOver(false)}
        onDrop={handleDrop}
        onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
            e.preventDefault();
            inputRef.current?.click();
          }
        }}
      >
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          id={inputId}
          type="file"
          accept={accept}
          multiple={multiple}
          className="sr-only"
          onChange={(e) => processFiles(e.target.files)}
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
        <svg
          className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500"
          fill="none"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth={1.5}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            d="M12 16.5V9.75m0 0l3 3m-3-3l-3 3M6.75 19.5a4.5 4.5 0 01-1.41-8.775 5.25 5.25 0 0110.233-2.33 3 3 0 013.758 3.848A3.752 3.752 0 0118 19.5H6.75z"
          />
        </svg>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
          <span className="font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">Click to upload</span>{" "}
          or drag and drop
        </p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-500">
          {accept ? `Accepted: ${accept}` : "Any file"} · Max {(maxSize / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(0)}MB
        </p>
        {fileNames.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="mt-3 text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 space-y-0.5">
            {fileNames.map((n) => (
              <li key={n}>{n}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p id={`${inputId}-error`} role="alert" className="text-sm text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { forwardRef, type SelectHTMLAttributes } from "react";
import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

interface SelectOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

interface SelectInputProps extends Omit<
  SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement>,
  "children"
> {
  label: string;
  options: SelectOption[];
  placeholder?: string;
  error?: string;
}

export const SelectInput = forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement, SelectInputProps>(
  ({ label, options, placeholder, error, id, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const selectId = id ?? `select-${label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-")}`;

    return (
      <div className={cn("space-y-1.5", className)}>
        <label
          htmlFor={selectId}
          className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"
        >
          {label}
          {props.required && (
            <span className="text-red-500 ml-0.5" aria-hidden="true">
              *
            </span>
          )}
        </label>
        <select
          ref={ref}
          id={selectId}
          aria-invalid={error ? "true" : undefined}
          aria-describedby={error ? `${selectId}-error` : undefined}
          className={cn(
            "block w-full rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors",
            "focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-0",
            "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
            error
              ? "border-red-300 dark:border-red-700 focus:ring-red-500 focus:border-red-500 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/10"
              : "border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500",
          )}
          {...props}
        >
          {placeholder && (
            <option value="" disabled>
              {placeholder}
            </option>
          )}
          {options.map((opt) => (
            <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value} disabled={opt.disabled}>
              {opt.label}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {error && (
          <p
            id={`${selectId}-error`}
            role="alert"
            className="text-sm text-red-600 dark:text-red-400"
          >
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  },
);

SelectInput.displayName = "SelectInput";

import { forwardRef, type TextareaHTMLAttributes } from "react";
import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

interface TextareaInputProps extends TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement> {
  label: string;
  error?: string;
  hint?: string;
  showCount?: boolean;
}

export const TextareaInput = forwardRef<
  HTMLTextAreaElement,
  TextareaInputProps
>(
  (
    {
      label,
      error,
      hint,
      showCount,
      id,
      className,
      maxLength,
      value,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const textareaId =
      id ?? `textarea-${label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-")}`;
    const charCount = typeof value === "string" ? value.length : 0;

    return (
      <div className={cn("space-y-1.5", className)}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <label
            htmlFor={textareaId}

            <span
              className={cn(
                "text-xs",
                charCount > maxLength * 0.9
                  ? "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
                  : "text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500",

              aria-live="polite"
            >
              {charCount}/{maxLength}
            </span>
          )}

        <textarea
          ref={ref}

          aria-invalid={error ? "true" : undefined}

===== FILE: packages\ui\src\components\navigation\breadcrumb.tsx =====
import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  label: string;
  href?: string;
}

interface BreadcrumbProps {
  items: BreadcrumbItem[];
  className?: string;
}

export function Breadcrumb({ items, className }: BreadcrumbProps) {
  if (items.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" className={className}>
      <ol className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-sm">
        {items.map((item, i) => {
          const isLast = i === items.length - 1;
          return (
            <li key={i} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {i > 0 && (
                <svg
                  className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-300 dark:text-gray-600 shrink-0"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  aria-hidden="true"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    d="M8.25 4.5l7.5 7.5-7.5 7.5"
                  />
                </svg>
              )}
              {isLast || !item.href ? (
                <span
                  aria-current={isLast ? "page" : undefined}
                  className={cn(
                    isLast
                      ? "font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100"
                      : "text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400",
                  )}
                >
                  {item.label}
                </span>
              ) : (
                <a
                  href={item.href}
                  className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors"
                >
                  {item.label}
                </a>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  );
}

===== FILE: packages\ui\src\components\navigation\search-bar.tsx =====
'use client'
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

export interface SearchResult {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  url: string;
  category?: string;
}

interface SearchBarProps {
  onSearch: (query: string) => void;
  results?: SearchResult[];
  onSelect?: (result: SearchResult) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function SearchBar({
  onSearch,
  results = [],
  onSelect,
  placeholder = "Search tools...",
  className,
}: SearchBarProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);

  // Debounced search
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
  const handleChange = useCallback(
    (value: string) => {
      setQuery(value);
      setActiveIndex(-1);
      clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        if (value.trim()) {
          onSearch(value.trim());
          setOpen(true);
        } else {
          setOpen(false);
        }
      }, 250);
    },
    [onSearch],
  );

  // Keyboard navigation
  const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (!open || results.length === 0) return;

      switch (e.key) {
        case "ArrowDown":
          e.preventDefault();
          setActiveIndex((i) => (i < results.length - 1 ? i + 1 : 0));
          break;
        case "ArrowUp":
          e.preventDefault();
          setActiveIndex((i) => (i > 0 ? i - 1 : results.length - 1));
          break;
        case "Enter":
          e.preventDefault();
          if (activeIndex >= 0 && results[activeIndex]) {
            onSelect?.(results[activeIndex]);
            setOpen(false);
            inputRef.current?.blur();
          }
          break;
        case "Escape":
          setOpen(false);
          inputRef.current?.blur();
          break;
      }
    },
    [open, results, activeIndex, onSelect],
  );

  // Scroll active item into view
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeIndex < 0 || !listRef.current) return;
    const items = listRef.current.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]');
    items[activeIndex]?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }, [activeIndex]);

  // Close on click outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (
        !inputRef.current?.contains(e.target as Node) &&
        !listRef.current?.contains(e.target as Node)
      ) {
        setOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className={cn("relative", className)}>
      {/* Search icon */}
      <div
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3.5"
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <svg
          className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500"
          fill="none"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth={2}
        >
          <path
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            d="M21 21l-5.197-5.197m0 0A7.5 7.5 0 105.196 5.196a7.5 7.5 0 0010.607 10.607z"
          />
        </svg>
      </div>

      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        type="search"
        role="combobox"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls="search-results"
        aria-activedescendant={
          activeIndex >= 0 ? `search-result-${activeIndex}` : undefined
        }
        aria-autocomplete="list"
        value={query}
        onChange={(e) => handleChange(e.target.value)}
        onFocus={() => {
          if (query.trim() && results.length > 0) setOpen(true);
        }}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        className={cn(
          "block w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900",
          "pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100",
          "placeholder:text-gray-400 dark:placeholder:text-gray-500",
          "focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500",
          "transition-colors",
        )}
      />

      {/* Keyboard shortcut badge */}
      <div
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center pr-3"
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <kbd className="hidden sm:inline-flex h-5 items-center gap-1 rounded border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
          <span className="text-xs">⌘</span>K
        </kbd>
      </div>

      {/* Results dropdown */}
      {open && results.length > 0 && (
        <ul
          id="search-results"
          ref={listRef}
          role="listbox"
          className="absolute z-50 mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 shadow-lg max-h-80 overflow-y-auto"
        >
          {results.map((result, i) => (
            <li
              key={result.id}
              id={`search-result-${i}`}
              role="option"
              aria-selected={i === activeIndex}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer transition-colors",
                i === activeIndex
                  ? "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20"
                  : "hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800",
              )}
              onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(i)}
              onClick={() => {
                onSelect?.(result);
                setOpen(false);
                inputRef.current?.blur();
              }}
            >
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 truncate">
                  {result.title}
                </p>
                {result.description && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 truncate mt-0.5">
                    {result.description}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
              {result.category && (
                <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-semibold rounded-full bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 px-2 py-0.5">
                  {result.category}
                </span>
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {/* No results */}
      {open && query.trim() && results.length === 0 && (
        <div className="absolute z-50 mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 shadow-lg p-6 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            No results found for &ldquo;{query}&rdquo;
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useTheme } from "../../providers/theme";
import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

interface ThemeToggleProps {
  className?: string;
  showLabel?: boolean;
}

export function ThemeToggle({
  className,
  showLabel = false,
}: ThemeToggleProps) {
  const { resolved, toggle } = useTheme();

  return (
    <button
      onClick={toggle}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg p-2 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400",
        "hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors",
        "focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2 dark:focus:ring-offset-gray-950",
        className,
      )}
      aria-label={`Switch to ${resolved === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"} mode`}
    >
      {resolved === "dark" ? (
        <svg
          className="w-5 h-5"
          fill="none"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth={1.5}
        >
          <path
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            d="M12 3v2.25m6.364.386l-1.591 1.591M21 12h-2.25m-.386 6.364l-1.591-1.591M12 18.75V21m-4.773-4.227l-1.591 1.591M5.25 12H3m4.227-4.773L5.636 5.636M15.75 12a3.75 3.75 0 11-7.5 0 3.75 3.75 0 017.5 0z"
          />
        </svg>
      ) : (
        <svg
          className="w-5 h-5"
          fill="none"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth={1.5}
        >
          <path
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            d="M21.752 15.002A9.718 9.718 0 0118 15.75c-5.385 0-9.75-4.365-9.75-9.75 0-1.33.266-2.597.748-3.752A9.753 9.753 0 003 11.25C3 16.635 7.365 21 12.75 21a9.753 9.753 0 009.002-5.998z"
          />
        </svg>
      )}
      {showLabel && (
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">
          {resolved === "dark" ? "Light" : "Dark"}
        </span>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

import { useClipboard } from "../../hooks/use-clipboard";
import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

interface CodeOutputProps {
  code: string;
  language?: string;
  label?: string;
  showLineNumbers?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export function CodeOutput({
  code,
  language = "text",
  label,
  showLineNumbers = false,
  className,
}: CodeOutputProps) {
  const { copied, copy } = useClipboard();

  const lines = code.split("\n");

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 bg-gray-950 overflow-hidden",
        className,
      )}
      role="region"
      aria-label={label ?? "Code output"}
    >
      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2 bg-gray-900 border-b border-gray-800">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-400">{language}</span>
          {label && <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">— {label}</span>}
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => copy(code)}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-gray-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
          aria-label={copied ? "Copied to clipboard" : "Copy code to clipboard"}
        >
          {copied ? (
            <>
              <svg
                className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400"
                fill="none"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth={2}
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  d="M4.5 12.75l6 6 9-13.5"
                />
              </svg>
              Copied
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <svg
                className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
                fill="none"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth={2}
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  d="M15.666 3.888A2.25 2.25 0 0013.5 2.25h-3c-1.03 0-1.9.693-2.166 1.638m7.332 0c.055.194.084.4.084.612v0a.75.75 0 01-.75.75H9.75a.75.75 0 01-.75-.75v0c0-.212.03-.418.084-.612m7.332 0c.646.049 1.288.11 1.927.184 1.1.128 1.907 1.077 1.907 2.185V19.5a2.25 2.25 0 01-2.25 2.25H6.75A2.25 2.25 0 014.5 19.5V6.257c0-1.108.806-2.057 1.907-2.185a48.208 48.208 0 011.927-.184"
                />
              </svg>
              Copy
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Code */}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto p-4">
        <pre className="text-sm leading-relaxed">
          <code className="text-gray-300 font-mono">
            {showLineNumbers
              ? lines.map((line, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="flex">
                    <span
                      className="inline-block w-10 shrink-0 text-right pr-4 text-gray-600 select-none"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    >
                      {i + 1}
                    </span>
                    <span>{line || " "}</span>
                  </div>
                ))
              : code}
          </code>
        </pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

interface ResultCardProps {
  title?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  actions?: ReactNode;
  variant?: "default" | "success" | "warning" | "error";
  className?: string;
}

const variantStyles = {
  default: "border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900",
  success:
    "border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/10",
  warning:
    "border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/10",
  error: "border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/10",
};

export function ResultCard({
  title,
  children,
  actions,
  variant = "default",
  className,
}: ResultCardProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "rounded-xl border shadow-sm overflow-hidden",
        variantStyles[variant],
        className,
      )}
      role="region"
      aria-label={title ?? "Results"}
    >
      {(title || actions) && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3 border-b border-inherit">
          {title && (
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
              {title}
            </h3>
          )}
          {actions && <div className="flex items-center gap-2">{actions}</div>}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="p-5">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: packages\ui\src\components\output\table-output.tsx =====
import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

interface Column<T> {
  key: string;
  header: string;
  render?: (value: unknown, row: T) => React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

interface TableOutputProps<T> {
  columns: Column<T>[];
  data: T[];
  caption?: string;
  emptyMessage?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function TableOutput<T extends Record<string, unknown>>({
  columns,
  data,
  caption,
  emptyMessage = "No data to display",
  className,
}: TableOutputProps<T>) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 overflow-hidden",
        className,
      )}
      role="region"
    >
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          {caption && <caption className="sr-only">{caption}</caption>}
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900">
              {columns.map((col) => (
                <th
                  key={col.key}
                  scope="col"
                  className={cn(
                    "px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400",
                    col.className,
                  )}
                >
                  {col.header}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200 dark:divide-gray-800">
            {data.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td
                  colSpan={columns.length}
                  className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
                >
                  {emptyMessage}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              data.map((row, i) => (
                <tr
                  key={i}
                  className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-950 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-900 transition-colors"
                >
                  {columns.map((col) => (
                    <td
                      key={col.key}
                      className={cn(
                        "px-4 py-3 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300",
                        col.className,
                      )}
                    >
                      {col.render
                        ? col.render(row[col.key], row)
                        : String(row[col.key] ?? "")}
                    </td>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useFavorites } from "../../hooks/use-favorites";
import { cn } from "../../utils/cn";

interface FavoriteButtonProps {
  slug: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  className?: string;
}

const sizeMap = {
  sm: "w-8 h-8",
  md: "w-10 h-10",
  lg: "w-12 h-12",
};

const iconSizeMap = {
  sm: "w-4 h-4",
  md: "w-5 h-5",
  lg: "w-6 h-6",
};

export function FavoriteButton({
  slug,
  size = "md",
  className,
}: FavoriteButtonProps) {
  const { isFavorite, toggle, count } = useFavorites();
  const active = isFavorite(slug);

  return (
    <button
      onClick={() => toggle(slug)}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition-all",
        "focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2 dark:focus:ring-offset-gray-950",
        active
          ? "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-100 dark:hover:bg-red-900/30"
          : "bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700",
        sizeMap[size],
        className,
      )}
      aria-label={
        active ? `Remove ${slug} from favorites` : `Add ${slug} to favorites`
      }
      aria-pressed={active}
      title={
        active ? `Favorited (${count} total)` : `Favorite (${count} total)`
      }
    >
      {active ? (
        <svg
          className={iconSizeMap[size]}
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="currentColor"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d="M11.645 20.91l-.007-.003-.022-.012a15.247 15.247 0 01-.383-.218 25.18 25.18 0 01-4.244-3.17C4.688 15.36 2.25 12.174 2.25 8.25 2.25 5.322 4.714 3 7.688 3A5.5 5.5 0 0112 5.052 5.5 5.5 0 0116.313 3c2.973 0 5.437 2.322 5.437 5.25 0 3.925-2.438 7.111-4.739 9.256a25.175 25.175 0 01-4.244 3.17 15.247 15.247 0 01-.383.219l-.022.012-.007.004-.003.001a.752.752 0 01-.704 0l-.003-.001z" />
        </svg>
      ) : (
        <svg
          className={iconSizeMap[size]}
          fill="none"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth={1.5}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            d="M21 8.25c0-2.485-2.099-4.5-4.688-4.5-1.935 0-3.597 1.126-4.312 2.733-.715-1.607-2.377-2.733-4.313-2.733C5.1 3.75 3 5.765 3 8.25c0 7.22 9 12 9 12s9-4.78 9-12z"
          />
        </svg>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

        "rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 p-5",
        className,
      )}

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">

          Recently Used

          onClick={clearRecent}
          className="text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:text-red-400 transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:underline"

        {recent.map((tool) => (
          <li key={tool.slug}>

                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 truncate group-hover:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400">
                  {tool.name}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                  {tool.category}
                </p>
              </div>
            </a>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: packages\ui\src\components\Button.tsx =====
import React from 'react'

interface ButtonProps {
  children: React.ReactNode
  onClick?: () => void
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost'
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
  loading?: boolean
}

export default function Button({
  children,
  onClick,
  type = 'button',
  variant = 'primary',
  disabled = false,
  className = '',
  loading = false,
}: ButtonProps) {
  const base = 'inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-200 px-6 py-3 text-sm disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed'

  const variants = {
    primary:   'bg-brand-600 text-white hover:bg-brand-700 active:scale-95',
    secondary: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-200 active:scale-95',
    ghost:     'bg-transparent text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 active:scale-95',
  }

  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      className={`${base} ${variants[variant]} ${className}`}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <svg className="animate-spin h-4 w-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
            <circle className="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="4"/>
            <path className="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"/>
          </svg>
          Calculating...
        </span>
      ) : children}
    </button>
  )
}

import React from 'react'

interface InputProps {
  label: string
  value: string | number
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  type?: string
  placeholder?: string
  suffix?: string
  prefix?: string
  hint?: string
  error?: string
  required?: boolean
}

export default function Input({
  label, value, onChange, type = 'text',
  placeholder, suffix, prefix, hint, error, required,
}: InputProps) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
      <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
        {label}
        {required && <span className="text-red-500 ml-1">*</span>}
      </label>
      <div className="relative flex items-center">
        {prefix && (
          <span className="absolute left-3 text-gray-500 text-sm font-medium">{prefix}</span>
        )}
        <input
          type={type}
          value={value}
          onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          className={`
            w-full rounded-xl border bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm
            transition-colors duration-150 outline-none
            focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500 focus:border-brand-500
            ${error ? 'border-red-400 focus:ring-red-400' : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-300'}
            ${prefix ? 'pl-8' : ''}
            ${suffix ? 'pr-16' : ''}
          `}
        />
        {suffix && (
          <span className="absolute right-3 text-gray-500 text-sm font-medium">{suffix}</span>
        )}
      </div>
      {hint && !error && <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{hint}</p>}
      {error && <p className="text-xs text-red-500">{error}</p>}
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: packages\ui\src\hooks\use-clipboard.ts =====
'use client'
import { useCallback, useState } from "react";

interface UseClipboardReturn {
  copied: boolean;
  copy: (text: string) => Promise<boolean>;
}

export function useClipboard(resetDelay: number = 2000): UseClipboardReturn {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const copy = useCallback(
    async (text: string): Promise<boolean> => {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        setCopied(true);
        setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), resetDelay);
        return true;
      } catch {
        // Fallback for older browsers / insecure contexts
        try {
          const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
          ta.value = text;
          ta.style.position = "fixed";
          ta.style.left = "-9999px";
          document.body.appendChild(ta);
          ta.select();
          document.execCommand("copy");
          document.body.removeChild(ta);
          setCopied(true);
          setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), resetDelay);
          return true;
        } catch {
          return false;
        }
      }
    },
    [resetDelay],
  );

  return { copied, copy };
}

===== FILE: packages\ui\src\hooks\use-favorites.ts =====
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

const STORAGE_KEY = "toolverse-favorites";

export function useFavorites() {
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState<Set<string>>(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return new Set();
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      return raw ? new Set(JSON.parse(raw)) : new Set();
    } catch {
      return new Set();
    }
  });

  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLoaded(true);
  }, []);

  // Persist on change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loaded) return;
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(Array.from(favorites)));
  }, [favorites, loaded]);

  const toggle = useCallback((slug: string) => {
    setFavorites((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(slug)) next.delete(slug);
      else next.add(slug);
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const isFavorite = useCallback(
    (slug: string) => favorites.has(slug),
    [favorites],
  );

  const count = favorites.size;

  return { favorites: Array.from(favorites), isFavorite, toggle, count };
}

===== FILE: packages\ui\src\hooks\use-media-query.ts =====
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export function useMediaQuery(query: string): boolean {
  const [matches, setMatches] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return false;
    return window.matchMedia(query).matches;
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia(query);
    const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setMatches(e.matches);
    mq.addEventListener("change", handler);
    setMatches(mq.matches);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", handler);
  }, [query]);

  return matches;
}

// Pre-built breakpoints
export const useIsMobile = () => useMediaQuery("(max-width: 639px)");
export const useIsTablet = () =>
  useMediaQuery("(min-width: 640px) and (max-width: 1023px)");
export const useIsDesktop = () => useMediaQuery("(min-width: 1024px)");
export const usePrefersReducedMotion = () =>
  useMediaQuery("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");

===== FILE: packages\ui\src\hooks\use-recent-tools.ts =====
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

const STORAGE_KEY = "toolverse-recent-tools";
const MAX_ITEMS = 10;

export interface RecentTool {
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  visitedAt: string; // ISO
}

export function useRecentTools() {
  const [recent, setRecent] = useState<RecentTool[]>(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
    try {
      return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ?? "[]");
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  // Persist on change
  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(recent));
  }, [recent]);

  const addRecent = useCallback((tool: Omit<RecentTool, "visitedAt">) => {
    setRecent((prev) => {
      // Remove existing entry for this tool
      const filtered = prev.filter((t) => t.slug !== tool.slug);
      // Add to front
      return [
        { ...tool, visitedAt: new Date().toISOString() },
        ...filtered,
      ].slice(0, MAX_ITEMS);
    });
  }, []);

  const clearRecent = useCallback(() => {
    setRecent([]);
  }, []);

  return { recent, addRecent, clearRecent };
}

===== FILE: packages\ui\src\providers\theme.tsx =====
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";

type Theme = "light" | "dark" | "system";

interface ThemeContextValue {
  theme: Theme;
  resolved: "light" | "dark";
  setTheme: (t: Theme) => void;
  toggle: () => void;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue | null>(null);

const STORAGE_KEY = "toolverse-theme";

function getSystem(): "light" | "dark" {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "light";
  return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
    ? "dark"
    : "light";
}

function applyToDocument(resolved: "light" | "dark") {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  root.classList.remove("light", "dark");
  root.classList.add(resolved);
  root.style.colorScheme = resolved;
}

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState<Theme>(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return "system";
    return (localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) as Theme) ?? "system";
  });

  const resolved = theme === "system" ? getSystem() : theme;

  const setTheme = useCallback((t: Theme) => {
    setThemeState(t);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, t);
  }, []);

  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
    setTheme(resolved === "dark" ? "light" : "dark");
  }, [resolved, setTheme]);

  // Apply class to <html> on change
  useEffect(() => {
    applyToDocument(resolved);
  }, [resolved]);

  // Listen for system preference changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (theme !== "system") return;
    const mq = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
    const handler = () => applyToDocument(getSystem());
    mq.addEventListener("change", handler);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", handler);
  }, [theme]);

  // Prevent flash: apply immediately on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    applyToDocument(resolved);
  }, []);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, resolved, setTheme, toggle }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme(): ThemeContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useTheme must be used inside <ThemeProvider>");
  return ctx;
}

export function cn(...classes: (string | false | null | undefined)[]): string {

}

===== FILE: packages\utils\src\index.ts =====
// ============================================================
// @platform/utils — Shared utility functions
// ============================================================

// --- String Utilities ---

/**
 * Capitalize the first letter of a string
 */
export function capitalize(str: string): string {
  if (!str) return str;
  return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
}

/**
 * Convert a string to slug format (lowercase, hyphens, no special chars)
 */
export function slugify(str: string): string {
  return str
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '')
    .replace(/[\s_]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
}

/**
 * Truncate a string to a maximum length, adding ellipsis if truncated
 */
export function truncate(str: string, maxLength: number, suffix: string = '...'): string {
  if (!str || str.length <= maxLength) return str;
  return str.slice(0, maxLength - suffix.length) + suffix;
}

/**
 * Remove all non-alphanumeric characters from a string
 */
export function alphanumericOnly(str: string): string {
  return str.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '');
}

/**
 * Mask a string, showing only the first and last N characters
 * Useful for displaying API keys or emails partially
 */
export function maskString(str: string, visibleStart: number = 2, visibleEnd: number = 2): string {
  if (!str || str.length <= visibleStart + visibleEnd) return str;
  const start = str.slice(0, visibleStart);
  const end = str.slice(-visibleEnd);
  const maskedLength = str.length - visibleStart - visibleEnd;
  return `${start}${'*'.repeat(maskedLength)}${end}`;
}

// --- Number Utilities ---

/**
 * Clamp a number between a minimum and maximum value
 */
export function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
}

/**
 * Round a number to a specified number of decimal places
 */
export function roundTo(value: number, decimals: number): number {
  if (decimals < 0) decimals = 0;
  const factor = Math.pow(10, decimals);
  return Math.round(value * factor) / factor;
}

/**
 * Format a number as currency string
 */
export function formatCurrency(
  value: number,
  currency: string = 'USD',
  locale: string = 'en-US'
): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    style: 'currency',
    currency,
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(value);
}

/**
 * Format a number with commas for thousands separators
 */
export function formatNumber(value: number, locale: string = 'en-US'): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(value);
}

/**
 * Convert a number to a percentage string
 */
export function toPercentage(value: number, decimals: number = 1): string {
  return `${roundTo(value, decimals)}%`;
}

/**
 * Check if a value is a finite number (not NaN, not Infinity)
 */
export function isValidNumber(value: unknown): value is number {
  return typeof value === 'number' && isFinite(value);
}

/**
 * Safely parse a number from a string, returning a default on failure
 */
export function safeParseNumber(value: string, defaultValue: number = 0): number {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return isNaN(parsed) || !isFinite(parsed) ? defaultValue : parsed;
}

// --- Date Utilities ---

/**
 * Format a Date object to ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD)
 */
export function formatDateISO(date: Date): string {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

/**
 * Get the number of days between two dates
 */
export function daysBetween(dateA: Date, dateB: Date): number {
  const oneDayMs = 86400000; // 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
  const a = new Date(dateA.getFullYear(), dateA.getMonth(), dateA.getDate());
  const b = new Date(dateB.getFullYear(), dateB.getMonth(), dateB.getDate());
  const diffMs = Math.abs(a.getTime() - b.getTime());
  return Math.round(diffMs / oneDayMs);
}

/**
 * Check if a string is a valid ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)
 */
export function isValidDateString(str: string): boolean {
  const isoPattern = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
  if (!isoPattern.test(str)) return false;
  const date = new Date(str + 'T00:00:00Z');
  return !isNaN(date.getTime());
}

// --- Array Utilities ---

/**
 * Remove duplicate values from an array
 */
export function unique<T>(arr: T[]): T[] {
  return [...new Set(arr)];
}

/**
 * Chunk an array into smaller arrays of a specified size
 */
export function chunk<T>(arr: T[], size: number): T[][] {
  if (size < 1) throw new Error('Chunk size must be at least 1');
  const result: T[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += size) {
    result.push(arr.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return result;
}

/**
 * Shuffle an array (returns a new array, does not mutate original)
 */
export function shuffle<T>(arr: T[]): T[] {
  const result = [...arr];
  for (let i = result.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [result[i], result[j]] = [result[j], result[i]];
  }
  return result;
}

// --- Object Utilities ---

/**
 * Deep clone an object using structuredClone (available in Node 17+)
 * Falls back to JSON parse/stringify for older environments
 */
export function deepClone<T>(obj: T): T {
  if (typeof structuredClone === 'function') {
    return structuredClone(obj);
  }
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj));
}

/**
 * Pick specific keys from an object (type-safe)
 */
export function pick<T extends Record<string, unknown>, K extends keyof T>(
  obj: T,
  keys: K[]
): Pick<T, K> {
  const result = {} as Pick<T, K>;
  for (const key of keys) {
    if (key in obj) {
      result[key] = obj[key];
    }
  }
  return result;
}

/**
 * Omit specific keys from an object (type-safe)
 */
export function omit<T extends Record<string, unknown>, K extends keyof T>(
  obj: T,
  keys: K[]
): Omit<T, K> {
  const result = { ...obj };
  for (const key of keys) {
    delete result[key];
  }
  return result;
}

/**
 * Check if an object is empty (has no own enumerable properties)
 */
export function isEmptyObject(obj: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
  return Object.keys(obj).length === 0;
}

// --- Async Utilities ---

/**
 * Sleep for a specified number of milliseconds
 */
export function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

/**
 * Retry an async function with exponential backoff
 */
export async function retry<T>(
  fn: () => Promise<T>,
  maxRetries: number = 3,
  baseDelayMs: number = 1000
): Promise<T> {
  let lastError: unknown;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error;
      if (attempt < maxRetries) {
        const delay = baseDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt);
        await sleep(delay);
      }
    }
  }
  throw lastError;
}

// --- ID Generation ---

/**
 * Generate a simple unique ID (not cryptographically secure, for UI keys only)
 */
export function generateId(prefix: string = ''): string {
  const timestamp = Date.now().toString(36);
  const random = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
  return prefix ? `${prefix}_${timestamp}${random}` : `${timestamp}${random}`;
}

// --- Conditional Utility ---

/**
 * Type-safe version of cn/clsx for conditional class names
 * This is a minimal implementation — use clsx/tailwind-merge in the web app
 */
export function cn(...classes: (string | boolean | null | undefined)[]): string {
  return classes.filter(Boolean).join(' ');
}
