===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\calculators\gpa-calculator\page.tsx =====
'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'

const GRADE_POINTS: Record<string,number> = {'A+':4.0,'A':4.0,'A-':3.7,'B+':3.3,'B':3.0,'B-':2.7,'C+':2.3,'C':2.0,'C-':1.7,'D+':1.3,'D':1.0,'F':0}

export default function GPACalculator() {
  const [courses, setCourses] = useState([{name:'',grade:'A',credits:'3'}])
  const [result, setResult] = useState<null|{gpa:number;totalCredits:number;letter:string;color:string}>(null)

  const addCourse = () => setCourses([...courses,{name:'',grade:'A',credits:'3'}])
  const removeCourse = (i:number) => setCourses(courses.filter((_,idx)=>idx!==i))
  const update = (i:number,k:string,v:string) => setCourses(courses.map((c,idx)=>idx===i?{...c,[k]:v}:c))

  const calculate = () => {
    let totalPoints=0, totalCredits=0
    courses.forEach(c=>{
      const cr=parseFloat(c.credits)||0
      totalPoints+=GRADE_POINTS[c.grade]*cr
      totalCredits+=cr
    })
    const gpa=totalCredits>0?totalPoints/totalCredits:0
    const letter = gpa>=3.7?'A':gpa>=3.3?'A-':gpa>=3.0?'B+':gpa>=2.7?'B':gpa>=2.3?'B-':gpa>=2.0?'C+':'C'
    const color = gpa>=3.5?'text-green-600':gpa>=3.0?'text-blue-600':gpa>=2.0?'text-amber-600':'text-red-600'
    setResult({gpa:Math.round(gpa*100)/100,totalCredits,letter,color})
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-100">
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-4">
          <Link href="/" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600">← Back to Home</Link>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-12">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-4">🎓</div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">GPA Calculator</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500">Calculate your Grade Point Average by course</p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 p-8">
          <div className="space-y-3 mb-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 px-1">
              <span className="col-span-5">Course Name</span>
              <span className="col-span-4">Grade</span>
              <span className="col-span-2">Credits</span>
            </div>
            {courses.map((c,i)=>(
              <div key={i} className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-2 items-center">
                <input value={c.name} onChange={e=>update(i,'name',e.target.value)} placeholder={`Course ${i+1}`}
                  className="col-span-5 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"/>
                <select value={c.grade} onChange={e=>update(i,'grade',e.target.value)}
                  className="col-span-4 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                  {Object.keys(GRADE_POINTS).map(g=><option key={g}>{g}</option>)}
                </select>
                <input type="number" value={c.credits} onChange={e=>update(i,'credits',e.target.value)} min="1" max="6"
                  className="col-span-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"/>
                {courses.length>1&&<button onClick={()=>removeCourse(i)} className="col-span-1 text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 text-lg">×</button>}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <button onClick={addCourse} className="w-full py-2 border-2 border-dashed border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm text-gray-500 hover:border-blue-300 hover:text-blue-500 mb-6">+ Add Course</button>
          <button onClick={calculate} className="w-full bg-blue-600 text-white py-4 rounded-xl font-semibold text-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors">Calculate GPA</button>
          {result && (
            <div className="mt-8 space-y-4">
              <div className="bg-blue-50 rounded-2xl p-6 text-center border border-blue-100">
                <p className="text-sm text-blue-600 mb-1">Your GPA</p>
                <p className={`text-6xl font-bold ${result.color}`}>{result.gpa}</p>
                <p className="text-lg text-gray-600 mt-1">Letter Grade: <span className={`font-bold ${result.color}`}>{result.letter}</span></p>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Total Credits: {result.totalCredits}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-gray-100">
                <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-3">
                  <div className={`h-3 rounded-full ${result.gpa>=3.5?'bg-green-500':result.gpa>=3.0?'bg-blue-500':result.gpa>=2.0?'bg-amber-500':'bg-red-500'}`}
                    style={{width:`${(result.gpa/4)*100}%`}}/>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1"><span>0.0</span><span>4.0</span></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\calculators\investment-calculator\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function InvestmentCalculator() {
  const [initial, setInitial] = useState("");
  const [monthly, setMonthly] = useState("");
  const [years, setYears] = useState("");
  const [returnRate, setReturnRate] = useState("8");

  const p = parseFloat(initial) || 0;
  const m = parseFloat(monthly) || 0;
  const y = parseFloat(years) || 0;
  const r = (parseFloat(returnRate) || 0) / 100 / 12;
  const n = y * 12;

  let totalValue = 0;
  if (n > 0 && r > 0) {
    totalValue = p * Math.pow(1 + r, n) + m * ((Math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1) / r);
  } else if (n > 0) {
    totalValue = p + m * n;
  }

  const totalContributed = p + m * n;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Investment Calculator
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Initial Investment ($)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={initial}
              onChange={(e) => setInitial(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Monthly Contribution ($)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={monthly}
              onChange={(e) => setMonthly(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
                Time Period (Years)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={years}
                onChange={(e) => setYears(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
                Return Rate (%)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={returnRate}
                onChange={(e) => setReturnRate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {totalValue > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-6 p-6 bg-indigo-900/30 border border-indigo-700 rounded-lg text-center">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-sm">Future Value</p>
              <p className="text-4xl font-bold text-indigo-400 mt-1">
                $
                {totalValue.toLocaleString("en-US", {
                  maximumFractionDigits: 0,
                })}
              </p>
              <div className="flex justify-around mt-4 text-sm border-t border-indigo-800 pt-4">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-gray-400">Contributed</p>
                  <p className="font-bold text-white">
                    $
                    {totalContributed.toLocaleString("en-US", {
                      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
                    })}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-gray-400">Interest</p>
                  <p className="font-bold text-indigo-300">
                    $
                    {(totalValue - totalContributed).toLocaleString("en-US", {
                      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
                    })}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\calculators\loan-calculator\page.tsx =====
'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'

function fmt(n: number) { return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }).format(n) }

export default function LoanCalculatorPage() {
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('10000')
  const [rate, setRate] = useState('7.5')
  const [term, setTerm] = useState('36')
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ monthly: number; total: number; interest: number } | null>(null)

  const calculate = () => {
    const p = +amount, r = +rate / 100 / 12, n = +term
    if (!p || !n || isNaN(r)) return
    const monthly = r === 0 ? p / n : (p * r * Math.pow(1 + r, n)) / (Math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1)
    setResult({ monthly, total: monthly * n, interest: monthly * n - p })
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-100">
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-4">
          <Link href="/tools/calculators" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600">? Back to Calculators</Link>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-10">
        <div className="mb-8"><div className="text-4xl mb-3">??</div><h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Loan Calculator</h1><p className="text-gray-500 mt-1">Calculate your monthly loan payments instantly</p></div>
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6 mb-6 space-y-4">
          <div><label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Loan Amount ($)</label><input type="number" className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" value={amount} onChange={e => setAmount(e.target.value)} placeholder="10000" /></div>
          <div><label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Annual Interest Rate (%)</label><input type="number" className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" value={rate} onChange={e => setRate(e.target.value)} placeholder="7.5" step="0.1" /></div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Loan Term (months)</label>
            <div className="flex gap-2 mb-2">{[12,24,36,60].map(t => (<button key={t} type="button" onClick={() => setTerm(String(t))} className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-lg border transition-colors ${term === String(t) ? 'bg-blue-600 border-blue-600 text-white' : 'border-gray-200 text-gray-600 hover:border-blue-400'}`}>{t/12}yr</button>))}</div>
            <input type="number" className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" value={term} onChange={e => setTerm(e.target.value)} placeholder="36" />
          </div>
          <button onClick={calculate} className="w-full bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg py-2.5 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-blue-700">Calculate</button>
        </div>
        {result && (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="bg-blue-600 p-6 text-center text-white"><p className="text-sm opacity-80 mb-1">Monthly Payment</p><p className="text-4xl font-bold">{fmt(result.monthly)}</p></div>
            <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
              <div className="flex justify-between px-6 py-4"><span className="text-gray-500 text-sm">Loan Amount</span><span className="font-semibold text-sm">{fmt(+amount)}</span></div>
              <div className="flex justify-between px-6 py-4"><span className="text-gray-500 text-sm">Total Interest</span><span className="font-semibold text-sm text-amber-600">{fmt(result.interest)}</span></div>
              <div className="flex justify-between px-6 py-4"><span className="text-gray-500 text-sm">Total Cost</span><span className="font-bold text-sm">{fmt(result.total)}</span></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function MacroCalculator() {
  const [calories, setCalories] = useState("");
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState("maintain");

  const c = parseFloat(calories) || 0;

  let proteinPct = 0.3,
    carbsPct = 0.4,
    fatPct = 0.3;
  if (goal === "lose") {
    proteinPct = 0.4;
    carbsPct = 0.3;
    fatPct = 0.3;
  }
  if (goal === "gain") {
    proteinPct = 0.25;
    carbsPct = 0.5;
    fatPct = 0.25;
  }

  const proteinG = (c * proteinPct) / 4;
  const carbsG = (c * carbsPct) / 4;
  const fatG = (c * fatPct) / 9;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Macro Calculator
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Daily Calories (Use Calorie Calc if unknown)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={calories}
              onChange={(e) => setCalories(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Fitness Goal
            </label>
            <select
              value={goal}
              onChange={(e) => setGoal(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            >
              <option value="lose">Lose Weight (High Protein)</option>
              <option value="maintain">Maintain Weight (Balanced)</option>
              <option value="gain">Gain Muscle (High Carb)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {c > 0 && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mt-6">
              <div className="bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 rounded-lg p-4 text-center">
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-300">Protein</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-400 mt-1">
                  {Math.round(proteinG)}g
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                  {Math.round(proteinPct * 100)}% of calories
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-yellow-900/30 border border-yellow-700 rounded-lg p-4 text-center">
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-300">Carbs</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-400 mt-1">
                  {Math.round(carbsG)}g
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                  {Math.round(carbsPct * 100)}% of calories
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-blue-900/30 border border-blue-700 rounded-lg p-4 text-center">
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-300">Fat</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-400 mt-1">
                  {Math.round(fatG)}g
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                  {Math.round(fatPct * 100)}% of calories
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\calculators\mortgage-calculator\page.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useState, useCallback } from "react";

interface MortgageResult {
  monthlyPayment: number;
  totalPayment: number;
  totalInterest: number;
  principal: number;
  schedule: AmortizationRow[];
}

interface AmortizationRow {
  month: number;
  payment: number;
  principal: number;
  interest: number;
  balance: number;
}

function formatCurrency(value: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "USD",
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(value);
}

function calculateMortgage(
  principal: number,
  annualRate: number,
  termYears: number
): MortgageResult {
  const monthlyRate = annualRate / 100 / 12;
  const numPayments = termYears * 12;

  const monthlyPayment =
    monthlyRate === 0
      ? principal / numPayments
      : (principal * (monthlyRate * Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, numPayments))) /
        (Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, numPayments) - 1);

  const totalPayment = monthlyPayment * numPayments;
  const totalInterest = totalPayment - principal;

  const schedule: AmortizationRow[] = [];
  let balance = principal;

  for (let month = 1; month <= numPayments; month++) {
    const interestPayment = balance * monthlyRate;
    const principalPayment = monthlyPayment - interestPayment;
    balance -= principalPayment;

    schedule.push({
      month,
      payment: monthlyPayment,
      principal: principalPayment,
      interest: interestPayment,
      balance: Math.max(0, balance),
    });
  }

  return {
    monthlyPayment,
    totalPayment,
    totalInterest,
    principal,
    schedule,
  };
}

export default function MortgageCalculatorPage() {
  const [loanAmount, setLoanAmount] = useState("300000");
  const [interestRate, setInterestRate] = useState("6.5");
  const [loanTerm, setLoanTerm] = useState("30");
  const [result, setResult] = useState<MortgageResult | null>(null);
  const [showSchedule, setShowSchedule] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  const validate = useCallback(() => {
    const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    const amount = parseFloat(loanAmount);
    const rate = parseFloat(interestRate);
    const term = parseInt(loanTerm);

    if (!loanAmount || isNaN(amount) || amount <= 0)
      newErrors.loanAmount = "Enter a valid loan amount greater than 0";
    if (!interestRate || isNaN(rate) || rate < 0 || rate > 30)
      newErrors.interestRate = "Enter a rate between 0% and 30%";
    if (!loanTerm || isNaN(term) || term < 1 || term > 50)
      newErrors.loanTerm = "Enter a term between 1 and 50 years";

    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  }, [loanAmount, interestRate, loanTerm]);

  const handleCalculate = useCallback(() => {
    if (!validate()) return;
    const res = calculateMortgage(
      parseFloat(loanAmount),
      parseFloat(interestRate),
      parseInt(loanTerm)
    );
    setResult(res);
    setShowSchedule(false);
  }, [loanAmount, interestRate, loanTerm, validate]);

  const handleReset = () => {
    setLoanAmount("300000");
    setInterestRate("6.5");
    setLoanTerm("30");
    setResult(null);
    setErrors({});
    setShowSchedule(false);
  };

  const principalPercent = result
    ? (result.principal / result.totalPayment) * 100
    : 0;
  const interestPercent = result ? 100 - principalPercent : 0;

  return (
    <main className="mortgage-page">
      <div className="mortgage-container">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mortgage-header">
          <div className="mortgage-badge">
            <span className="badge badge-brand">Calculator</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="mortgage-title">Mortgage Calculator</h1>
          <p className="mortgage-subtitle">
            Estimate your monthly payments and view a full amortization
            schedule.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mortgage-grid">
          {/* Input Card */}
          <div className="card mortgage-inputs">
            <div className="mortgage-inputs-header">
              <h2 className="mortgage-section-title">Loan Details</h2>
            </div>

            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label" htmlFor="loanAmount">
                Home Price / Loan Amount
              </label>
              <div className="input-prefix-wrap">
                <span className="input-prefix">$</span>
                <input
                  id="loanAmount"
                  type="number"
                  className={`form-input input-prefixed${errors.loanAmount ? " input-error" : ""}`}
                  value={loanAmount}
                  onChange={(e) => setLoanAmount(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="300000"
                  min="0"
                />
              </div>
              {errors.loanAmount && (
                <p className="form-error">{errors.loanAmount}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label" htmlFor="interestRate">
                Annual Interest Rate
              </label>
              <div className="input-prefix-wrap">
                <input
                  id="interestRate"
                  type="number"
                  className={`form-input input-suffixed${errors.interestRate ? " input-error" : ""}`}
                  value={interestRate}
                  onChange={(e) => setInterestRate(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="6.5"
                  step="0.1"
                  min="0"
                  max="30"
                />
                <span className="input-suffix">%</span>
              </div>
              {errors.interestRate && (
                <p className="form-error">{errors.interestRate}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label" htmlFor="loanTerm">
                Loan Term
              </label>
              <div className="term-options">
                {["10", "15", "20", "30"].map((t) => (
                  <button
                    key={t}
                    type="button"
                    className={`term-btn${loanTerm === t ? " term-btn-active" : ""}`}
                    onClick={() => setLoanTerm(t)}
                  >
                    {t} yr
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="input-prefix-wrap" style={{ marginTop: "0.5rem" }}>
                <input

                  className={`form-input input-suffixed${errors.loanTerm ? " input-error" : ""}`}

                />
                <span className="input-suffix">years</span>

                <p className="form-error">{errors.loanTerm}</p>
              )}
            </div>

              >
                Calculate
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn btn-ghost btn-lg"
                onClick={handleReset}
              >
                Reset
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Results */}
          {result ? (

                </p>

              {/* Breakdown */}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\calculators\retirement-calculator\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function RetirementCalculator() {
  const [currentAge, setCurrentAge] = useState("");
  const [retirementAge, setRetirementAge] = useState("");
  const [currentSavings, setCurrentSavings] = useState("");
  const [monthly, setMonthly] = useState("");
  const [returnRate, setReturnRate] = useState("7"); // Avg S&P 500

  const ca = parseInt(currentAge) || 0;
  const ra = parseInt(retirementAge) || 0;
  const cs = parseFloat(currentSavings) || 0;
  const m = parseFloat(monthly) || 0;
  const r = (parseFloat(returnRate) || 0) / 100 / 12;
  const years = ra - ca;
  const months = years * 12;

  let futureValue = 0;
  if (months > 0 && r > 0) {
    futureValue =
      cs * Math.pow(1 + r, months) + m * ((Math.pow(1 + r, months) - 1) / r);
  } else if (months > 0) {
    futureValue = cs + m * months;
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Retirement Calculator
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
                Current Age
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={currentAge}
                onChange={(e) => setCurrentAge(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
                Retirement Age
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={retirementAge}
                onChange={(e) => setRetirementAge(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Current Savings ($)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={currentSavings}
              onChange={(e) => setCurrentSavings(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Monthly Contribution ($)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={monthly}
              onChange={(e) => setMonthly(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Expected Return (% annual)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={returnRate}
              onChange={(e) => setReturnRate(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {futureValue > 0 && ca > 0 && ra > ca && (
            <div className="mt-6 p-4 bg-yellow-900/30 border border-yellow-700 rounded-lg text-center">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-sm">
                Estimated Savings at Age {ra}
              </p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-yellow-400 mt-1">
                $
                {futureValue.toLocaleString("en-US", {
                  maximumFractionDigits: 0,
                })}
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-2">
                Total Contributions: $
                {(cs + m * months).toLocaleString("en-US", {
                  maximumFractionDigits: 0,
                })}{" "}
                | Interest Earned: $
                {(futureValue - (cs + m * months)).toLocaleString("en-US", {
                  maximumFractionDigits: 0,
                })}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function SavingsGoalCalculator() {
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState("");
  const [currentSavings, setCurrentSavings] = useState("");
  const [months, setMonths] = useState("");
  const [returnRate, setReturnRate] = useState("4");

  const g = parseFloat(goal) || 0;
  const cs = parseFloat(currentSavings) || 0;
  const m = parseFloat(months) || 0;
  const r = (parseFloat(returnRate) || 0) / 100 / 12;

  let monthlyNeeded = 0;
  if (m > 0 && g > cs) {
    const target = g - cs;
    if (r > 0) {
      monthlyNeeded = (target * r) / (Math.pow(1 + r, m) - 1);
    } else {
      monthlyNeeded = target / m;
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">

          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Savings Goal ($)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={goal}
              onChange={(e) => setGoal(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">

              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\calculators\sleep-calculator\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

const CYCLE_MINUTES = 90;
const FALL_ASLEEP_MINUTES = 15;

export default function SleepCalculator() {
  const [wakeHour, setWakeHour] = useState("7");
  const [wakeMinute, setWakeMinute] = useState("0");
  const [wakeAmPm, setWakeAmPm] = useState("AM");

  const [sleepTimes, setSleepTimes] = useState<string[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let hour24 = parseInt(wakeHour);
    if (wakeAmPm === "AM" && hour24 === 12) hour24 = 0;
    if (wakeAmPm === "PM" && hour24 !== 12) hour24 += 12;

    let totalWakeMinutes = hour24 * 60 + parseInt(wakeMinute);

    const times: string[] = [];
    // 6 cycles (optimal), 5 cycles, 4 cycles (minimum)
    for (let cycles = 6; cycles >= 4; cycles--) {
      let sleepMinutes =
        totalWakeMinutes - cycles * CYCLE_MINUTES - FALL_ASLEEP_MINUTES;
      if (sleepMinutes < 0) sleepMinutes += 1440; // Handle crossing midnight

      let h = Math.floor(sleepMinutes / 60) % 24;
      let m = sleepMinutes % 60;
      let ampm = h >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
      let h12 = h % 12;
      if (h12 === 0) h12 = 12;

      times.push(
        `${h12}:${m.toString().padStart(2, "0")} ${ampm} (${cycles} cycles - ${cycles * 1.5} hrs)`,
      );
    }

    setSleepTimes(times);
  }, [wakeHour, wakeMinute, wakeAmPm]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Sleep Calculator
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg">
          <p className="text-gray-300 mb-6 text-center">
            Find out when to go to sleep to wake up feeling refreshed.

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\calculators\unit-converter\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

const LENGTH_UNITS: Record<string, number> = {
  Meters: 1,
  Kilometers: 0.001,
  Centimeters: 100,
  Millimeters: 1000,
  Inches: 39.3701,
  Feet: 3.28084,
  Miles: 0.000621371,
};

export default function UnitConverter() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState("");
  const [from, setFrom] = useState("Meters");
  const [to, setTo] = useState("Feet");

  const valNum = parseFloat(value) || 0;
  const inMeters = valNum / LENGTH_UNITS[from];
  const result = inMeters * LENGTH_UNITS[to];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Length Unit Converter
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Value
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={value}
              onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
              placeholder="Enter length"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
                From
              </label>
              <select
                value={from}
                onChange={(e) => setFrom(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
              >
                {Object.keys(LENGTH_UNITS).map((u) => (
                  <option key={u} value={u}>
                    {u}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
                To
              </label>
              <select
                value={to}
                onChange={(e) => setTo(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
              >
                {Object.keys(LENGTH_UNITS).map((u) => (
                  <option key={u} value={u}>
                    {u}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          {valNum > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-6 p-4 bg-green-900/30 border border-green-700 rounded-lg text-center">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-sm">Result</p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-400 mt-1">
                {result.toFixed(4)} {to}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'

const VAT_RATES = [{country:'UK',rate:20},{country:'Germany',rate:19},{country:'France',rate:20},{country:'UAE',rate:5},{country:'Pakistan',rate:17},{country:'India (GST)',rate:18},{country:'Australia',rate:10},{country:'Custom',rate:0}]

export default function VATCalculator() {
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('')
  const [rate, setRate] = useState('20')
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'add'|'remove'>('add')

  const val = parseFloat(amount)||0
  const r = parseFloat(rate)||0
  const vatAmt = mode==='add' ? val*(r/100) : val-(val/(1+r/100))
  const result = mode==='add' ? val+vatAmt : val/(1+r/100)

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-100">
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-4">
          <Link href="/" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600">← Back to Home</Link>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-12">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-4">🧾</div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">VAT Calculator</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500">Add or remove VAT/GST for any country instantly</p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 p-8">
          <div className="flex bg-gray-100 rounded-xl p-1 mb-6">
            {([{v:'add',l:'Add VAT'},{v:'remove',l:'Remove VAT'}] as const).map(m=>(
              <button key={m.v} onClick={()=>setMode(m.v as any)}
                className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all ${mode===m.v?'bg-white shadow text-gray-900':'text-gray-500'}`}>{m.l}</button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-6">
            {VAT_RATES.map(v=>(
              <button key={v.country} onClick={()=>v.rate>0&&setRate(String(v.rate))}
                className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full border transition-all ${rate===String(v.rate)?'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600':'border-gray-200 text-gray-600 hover:border-blue-300'}`}>
                {v.country} {v.rate>0?`${v.rate}%`:''}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-5 mb-8">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">{mode==='add'?'Price before VAT ($)':'Price including VAT ($)'}</label>
              <input type="number" value={amount} onChange={e=>setAmount(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 100"
                className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-2xl font-bold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"/>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">VAT Rate (%)</label>
              <input type="number" value={rate} onChange={e=>setRate(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 20"
                className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"/>
            </div>
          </div>
          {amount && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {[{label:mode==='add'?'Pre-VAT':'Pre-VAT',val:`$${mode==='add'?val.toFixed(2):result.toFixed(2)}`,color:'text-gray-800',bg:'bg-gray-50'},{label:'VAT Amount',val:`$${vatAmt.toFixed(2)}`,color:'text-amber-600',bg:'bg-amber-50'},{label:mode==='add'?'Total Inc. VAT':'Original Price',val:`$${mode==='add'?result.toFixed(2):val.toFixed(2)}`,color:'text-green-600',bg:'bg-green-50'}].map(s=>(
                <div key={s.label} className={`${s.bg} rounded-2xl p-5 text-center border border-gray-100`}>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">{s.label}</p>
                  <p className={`text-2xl font-bold ${s.color}`}>{s.val}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\add-page-numbers\page.tsx =====
"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
// 1. Import the types (Fixes Error 2307)
import { PDFDocument, PDFPage, rgb, degrees } from "pdf-lib";

export default function AddPageNumbers() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [downloadUrl, setDownloadUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      setFile(e.target.files[0]);
      setDownloadUrl(null);
    }
  };

  const handleProcess = async () => {
    if (!file) return;

    setProcessing(true);

    try {
      // Read the file
      const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();

      // Load the PDF
      const pdfDoc = await PDFDocument.load(arrayBuffer);
      const pages = pdfDoc.getPages();

      // 2. Fix the forEach loop (Fixes Error 7006)
      pages.forEach((page: PDFPage, index: number) => {
        const { width, height } = page.getSize();

        // Draw the page number at the bottom center
        page.drawText(`Page ${index + 1}`, {
          x: width / 2 - 20,
          y: height / 2, // Just for demonstration, usually 30-50px from bottom
          size: 12,
          color: rgb(0, 0, 0),
        });
      });

      // Serialize the PDFDocument to bytes (a Uint8Array)
      const pdfBytes = await pdfDoc.save();

      // Create a blob and download link
      const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as unknown as ArrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      setDownloadUrl(url);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error processing PDF:", error);
      alert("Failed to process PDF");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-8 max-w-xl mx-auto">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Add Page Numbers</h1>

      <div className="mb-4">
        <input
          type="file"
          accept="application/pdf"
          onChange={handleFileChange}
          className="block w-full text-sm text-gray-500
            file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4
            file:rounded-full file:border-0
            file:text-sm file:font-semibold
            file:bg-blue-50 file:text-blue-700
            hover:file:bg-blue-100"
        />
      </div>

      <button
        onClick={handleProcess}
        disabled={!file || processing}
        className="bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded disabled:opacity-50"
      >
        {processing ? "Processing..." : "Add Numbers & Download"}
      </button>

      {downloadUrl && (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <a
            href={downloadUrl}
            download="numbered-document.pdf"
            className="text-blue-600 underline"
          >
            Click here to download your file
          </a>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\add-watermark\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { PDFDocument, rgb, StandardFonts } from "pdf-lib";

export default function AddWatermark() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [text, setText] = useState("CONFIDENTIAL");
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);

  const addWatermark = async () => {
    if (!file || !text) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const pdfDoc = await PDFDocument.load(arrayBuffer);
      const font = await pdfDoc.embedFont(StandardFonts.HelveticaBold);
      const pages = pdfDoc.getPages();

      pages.forEach((page) => {
        const { width, height } = page.getSize();
        const textWidth = font.widthOfTextAtSize(text, 50);
        page.drawText(text, {
          x: (width - textWidth) / 2,
          y: height / 2,
          size: 50,
          font,
          color: rgb(0.75, 0.75, 0.75),
          opacity: 0.3,
          rotate: { type: "degrees" as any, angle: -45 },
        });
      });

      const pdfBytes = await pdfDoc.save();
      const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as unknown as ArrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = "watermarked.pdf";
      a.click();
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Error adding watermark.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">Add Watermark</h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <input
            type="file"
            accept=".pdf"
            onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
            className="w-full text-sm text-gray-400 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-blue-700 cursor-pointer"
          />
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Watermark Text
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={text}
              onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
              placeholder="e.g. CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={addWatermark}
            disabled={!file || !text || processing}
            className="w-full bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
          >
            {processing ? "Processing..." : "Add Watermark & Download"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const buildPrompt = (vals: Record<string, string>) =>
  `Write a professional business letter from "${vals.sender}" to "${vals.recipient}". Subject: ${vals.subject}. Details: ${vals.details}. Format with date, addresses, salutation, 3 paragraphs, and closing.`

export default function DocumentTool() {
  const [vals, setVals] = useState<Record<string, string>>(Object.fromEntries(FIELDS.map(f => [f.key, ''])))
  const [result, setResult] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const set = (k: string, v: string) => setVals(p => ({ ...p, [k]: v }))
  const generate = async () => {
    setLoading(true); setResult('')
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/ai', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: buildPrompt(vals) }) })
      const data = await res.json()
      setResult(data.text || 'Error generating')
    } catch { setResult('Error. Please try again.') }
    setLoading(false)
  }
  const printResult = () => {
    const win = window.open('', '_blank')
    if (!win) return
    win.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>${TOOL_TITLE}</title><style>body{font-family:Georgia,serif;max-width:750px;margin:60px auto;padding:40px;line-height:1.9;white-space:pre-wrap;}</style></head><body>${result}</body></html>`)
    win.document.close(); win.print()
  }
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-100">
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-4">
          <Link href="/tools/document-tools" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600">? Back</Link>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-10">
        <div className="mb-8"><div className="text-4xl mb-3">{TOOL_EMOJI}</div><h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{TOOL_TITLE}</h1><p className="text-gray-500 mt-1">{TOOL_DESC}</p></div>
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6 mb-6 space-y-4">
          {FIELDS.map(f => (
            <div key={f.key}>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">{f.label}</label>
              <input className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" placeholder={f.placeholder} value={vals[f.key]} onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)} />
            </div>
          ))}
          <button onClick={generate} disabled={loading} className="w-full bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg py-2.5 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50">{loading ? 'Generating...' : `Generate ${TOOL_TITLE}`}</button>
        </div>
        {result && (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6">
            <div className="flex justify-between mb-4">
              <h2 className="font-semibold text-gray-900">Result</h2>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(result)} className="text-xs border border-gray-200 rounded px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-gray-50">Copy</button>
                <button onClick={printResult} className="text-xs border border-gray-200 rounded px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-gray-50">Print</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-gray-800 leading-relaxed font-serif">{result}</pre>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\compare-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

const TITLE = "Compare PDF";
const ENDPOINT = "/api/tools/compare-pdf";
const ACCEPT_TYPES = ".pdf";
const OUTPUT_EXT = "comparison_report.pdf";

export default function ComparePDF() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const processFile = async () => {
    if (files.length < 2) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file1", files[0]);
      formData.append("file2", files[1]);
      const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Comparison failed on the server.");
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = OUTPUT_EXT;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">{TITLE}</h1>
        <p className="text-center text-gray-400 mb-6 text-sm">
          Side-by-side diff checker for two documents.
        </p>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-8 text-center rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT_TYPES}
              multiple
              onChange={(e) =>
                setFiles(e.target.files ? Array.from(e.target.files) : [])
              }
              className="hidden"
              id="file-upload"
            />
            <label htmlFor="file-upload" className="cursor-pointer block">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-lg">
                {files.length > 0
                  ? `${files.length} files selected`
                  : "Click to upload 2 PDFs"}
              </p>
              {files.length > 0 && (
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">
                  {files.map((f) => f.name).join(", ")}
                </p>
              )}
            </label>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={processFile}
            disabled={files.length < 2 || processing}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-lg text-lg transition-colors"
          >
            {processing ? (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <svg
                  className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-white"
                  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <circle
                    className="opacity-25"
                    cx="12"
                    cy="12"
                    r="10"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="4"
                  ></circle>
                  <path
                    className="opacity-75"
                    fill="currentColor"
                    d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"
                  ></path>
                </svg>
                Comparing...
              </span>
            ) : (
              `Compare Documents`
            )}
          </button>
          {error && (
            <div className="bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm text-red-400">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\crop-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

const TITLE = "Crop PDF";
const ENDPOINT = "/api/tools/crop-pdf";
const ACCEPT_TYPES = ".pdf";
const OUTPUT_EXT = "cropped.pdf";

export default function CropPDF() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const processFile = async () => {
    if (!file) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file);
      const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Cropping failed on the server.");
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = OUTPUT_EXT;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">{TITLE}</h1>
        <p className="text-center text-gray-400 mb-6 text-sm">
          Trim margins or select specific areas to keep.
        </p>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-8 text-center rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT_TYPES}
              onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
              className="hidden"
              id="file-upload"
            />
            <label htmlFor="file-upload" className="cursor-pointer block">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-lg">
                {file ? file.name : "Click to upload PDF to Crop"}
              </p>
              {file && (
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">
                  {(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB
                </p>
              )}
            </label>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={processFile}
            disabled={!file || processing}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-lg text-lg transition-colors"
          >
            {processing ? (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <svg
                  className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-white"
                  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <circle
                    className="opacity-25"
                    cx="12"
                    cy="12"
                    r="10"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="4"
                  ></circle>
                  <path
                    className="opacity-75"
                    fill="currentColor"
                    d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"
                  ></path>
                </svg>
                Cropping...
              </span>
            ) : (
              `Crop & Download`
            )}
          </button>
          {error && (
            <div className="bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm text-red-400">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'

// ─── TOOL CONFIG ───
const TOOL_TITLE = 'Expense Report'
const TOOL_EMOJI = '💰'
const TOOL_DESC = 'Generate professional expense reports instantly'

const FIELDS = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Employee Name', placeholder: 'John Smith' },
  { key: 'department', label: 'Department', placeholder: 'Sales' },
  { key: 'period', label: 'Report Period', placeholder: 'April 2026' },
  { key: 'expenses', label: 'Expenses (item, amount, date)', placeholder: 'Flight to NYC $450 Apr 10, Hotel $320 Apr 10-12, Meals $85...' },
]

const buildPrompt = (vals: Record<string, string>) =>
  `Create a professional expense report for ${vals.name} from ${vals.department} department.
Period: ${vals.period}. Expenses: ${vals.expenses}.
Format as a structured report with: header, expense table with dates/categories/amounts, subtotals by category, grand total, and signature line.`
// ───────────────────

export default function DocumentTool() {
  const [vals, setVals] = useState<Record<string, string>>(
    Object.fromEntries(FIELDS.map(f => [f.key, '']))
  )
  const [result, setResult] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const set = (k: string, v: string) =>
    setVals(p => ({ ...p, [k]: v }))

  const generate = async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    setResult('')
    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          // ⚠️ Add your API key here
          'x-api-key': process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY || '',
          'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
          max_tokens: 1000,
          messages: [{ role: 'user', content: buildPrompt(vals) }]
        })
      })

      const data = await res.json()
      setResult(data.content?.[0]?.text || 'Error generating')
    } catch {
      setResult('Error. Please try again.')
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }

  const print = () => {
    const win = window.open('', '_blank')
    if (!win) return
    win.document.write(`
      <html>
        <head>
          <title>${TOOL_TITLE}</title>
          <style>
            body {
              font-family: Georgia, serif;
              max-width: 750px;
              margin: 60px auto;
              padding: 40px;
              line-height: 1.9;
              white-space: pre-wrap;
            }
          </style>
        </head>
        <body>${result}</body>
      </html>
    `)
    win.document.close()
    win.print()
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-100">
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-4">
          <Link href="/tools/document-tools" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600">
            ← Document Tools
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-12">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-4">{TOOL_EMOJI}</div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">{TOOL_TITLE}</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500">{TOOL_DESC}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-8 space-y-5">
          {FIELDS.map(f => (
            <div key={f.key}>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                {f.label}
              </label>

              {f.key === 'expenses' ? (
                <textarea
                  value={vals[f.key]}
                  onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)}
                  rows={4}
                  placeholder={f.placeholder}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 resize-none"
                />
              ) : (
                <input
                  value={vals[f.key]}
                  onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={f.placeholder}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"
                />
              )}

          ))}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\extract-pdf-pages\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { PDFDocument } from "pdf-lib";

export default function ExtractPDFPages() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [pageCount, setPageCount] = useState(0);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadCount = async () => {
      if (!file) return;
      const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const pdf = await PDFDocument.load(buffer);
      setPageCount(pdf.getPageCount());
      setSelected(new Set());
    };
    loadCount();
  }, [file]);

  const togglePage = (num: number) => {
    const newSet = new Set(selected);
    if (newSet.has(num)) newSet.delete(num);
    else newSet.add(num);
    setSelected(newSet);
  };

  const extractPages = async () => {
    if (!file || selected.size === 0) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const pdf = await PDFDocument.load(buffer);
      const indicesToExtract = Array.from(selected)
        .map((n) => n - 1)
        .sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const newPdf = await PDFDocument.create();
      const copiedPages = await newPdf.copyPages(pdf, indicesToExtract);
      copiedPages.forEach((p) => newPdf.addPage(p));

      const pdfBytes = await newPdf.save();
      const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as unknown as ArrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = "extracted_pages.pdf";
      a.click();
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Error extracting pages.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Extract PDF Pages
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <input
            type="file"
            accept=".pdf"
            onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
            className="w-full text-sm text-gray-400 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-blue-700 cursor-pointer"
          />

          {pageCount > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-gray-900 p-4 rounded-lg">
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-300 mb-3">
                Select pages to{" "}
                <span className="text-green-400 font-bold">EXTRACT</span>:
              </p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-6 sm:grid-cols-10 gap-2">
                {Array.from({ length: pageCount }, (_, i) => i + 1).map(
                  (num) => (
                    <button
                      key={num}
                      onClick={() => togglePage(num)}
                      className={`p-2 rounded text-sm font-bold transition-colors ${selected.has(num) ? "bg-green-600 text-white" : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-600"}`}
                    >
                      {num}
                    </button>
                  ),
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={extractPages}
            disabled={!file || selected.size === 0 || processing}
            className="w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
          >
            {processing
              ? "Extracting..."
              : `Extract ${selected.size} Page(s) & Download`}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\html-to-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

const TITLE = "HTML to PDF";
const ENDPOINT = "/api/tools/html-to-pdf";
const ACCEPT_TYPES = ".html,.htm";
const OUTPUT_EXT = "webpage.pdf";

export default function HtmlToPDF() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const processFile = async () => {
    if (!file) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file);
      const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Conversion failed on the server.");
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = OUTPUT_EXT;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">{TITLE}</h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-8 text-center rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT_TYPES}
              onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
              className="hidden"
              id="file-upload"
            />
            <label htmlFor="file-upload" className="cursor-pointer block">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-lg">
                {file ? file.name : "Click to upload HTML File"}
              </p>
              {file && (
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">
                  {(file.size / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB
                </p>
              )}
            </label>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={processFile}
            disabled={!file || processing}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-lg text-lg transition-colors"
          >
            {processing ? (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <svg
                  className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-white"
                  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <circle
                    className="opacity-25"
                    cx="12"
                    cy="12"
                    r="10"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="4"
                  ></circle>
                  <path
                    className="opacity-75"
                    fill="currentColor"
                    d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"
                  ></path>
                </svg>
                Converting...
              </span>
            ) : (
              `Convert to PDF`
            )}
          </button>
          {error && (
            <div className="bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm text-red-400">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'

export default function InvoiceGenerator() {
  const [from, setFrom] = useState({ name:'', email:'', address:'' })
  const [to, setTo] = useState({ name:'', email:'', address:'' })
  const [invoice, setInvoice] = useState({ number:'INV-001', date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0], due:'' })
  const [items, setItems] = useState([{ desc:'', qty:'1', price:'' }])
  const [tax, setTax] = useState('0')
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('')

  const subtotal = items.reduce((s,i)=>(s+(parseFloat(i.qty)||0)*(parseFloat(i.price)||0)),0)
  const taxAmt = subtotal*(parseFloat(tax)||0)/100
  const total = subtotal+taxAmt

  const addItem = () => setItems([...items,{desc:'',qty:'1',price:''}])
  const updItem = (i:number,k:string,v:string) => setItems(p=>p.map((item,idx)=>idx===i?{...item,[k]:v}:item))
  const removeItem = (i:number) => setItems(items.filter((_,idx)=>idx!==i))

  const print = () => {
    const win = window.open('','_blank')
    if (!win) return
    win.document.write(`<html><head><title>Invoice ${invoice.number}</title>
    <style>
      *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
      body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:40px;color:#1a1a1a;font-size:13px;}
      .header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:40px;}
      h1{font-size:36px;color:#2952ff;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-1px;}
      .label{font-size:11px;color:#888;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:2px;}
      table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:20px 0;}
      th{background:#f5f5f5;padding:10px;text-align:left;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;}
      td{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;}
      .totals{margin-left:auto;width:280px;}
      .total-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;}
      .grand{font-weight:700;font-size:16px;color:#2952ff;}
    </style></head><body>
    <div class="header">
      <div><h1>INVOICE</h1><p style="color:#888;margin-top:4px">#${invoice.number}</p></div>
      <div style="text-align:right">
        <div class="label">Date</div><div>${invoice.date}</div>
        ${invoice.due?`<div class="label" style="margin-top:8px">Due Date</div><div>${invoice.due}</div>`:''}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px;margin-bottom:30px">
      <div><div class="label">From</div><strong>${from.name}</strong><br>${from.email}<br>${from.address}</div>
      <div><div class="label">Bill To</div><strong>${to.name}</strong><br>${to.email}<br>${to.address}</div>

      <tr><th>Description</th><th>Qty</th><th>Unit Price</th><th style="text-align:right">Amount</th></tr>
      ${items.filter(i=>i.desc).map(i=>`<tr><td>${i.desc}</td><td>${i.qty}</td><td>$${parseFloat(i.price||'0').toFixed(2)}</td><td style="text-align:right">$${((parseFloat(i.qty)||0)*(parseFloat(i.price)||0)).toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`).join('')}
    </table>
    <div class="totals">
      <div class="total-row"><span>Subtotal</span><span>$${subtotal.toFixed(2)}</span></div>
      ${parseFloat(tax)>0?`<div class="total-row"><span>Tax (${tax}%)</span><span>$${taxAmt.toFixed(2)}</span></div>`:''}
      <div class="total-row grand"><span>Total</span><span>$${total.toFixed(2)}</span></div>
    </div>

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\jpg-to-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { PDFDocument } from "pdf-lib";

export default function JpgToPdf() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);

  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files)
      setFiles(
        Array.from(e.target.files).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)),
      );
  };

  const convert = async () => {
    if (files.length === 0) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const pdfDoc = await PDFDocument.create();
      for (const file of files) {
        const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
        const image =
          file.type === "image/png"
            ? await pdfDoc.embedPng(bytes)
            : await pdfDoc.embedJpg(bytes);
        const page = pdfDoc.addPage([image.width, image.height]);
        page.drawImage(image, {
          x: 0,
          y: 0,
          width: image.width,
          height: image.height,
        });
      }
      const pdfBytes = await pdfDoc.save();
      const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as unknown as ArrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = "images.pdf";
      a.click();
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Error converting images.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">JPG to PDF</h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <input
            type="file"
            accept="image/jpeg, image/png"
            multiple
            onChange={handleUpload}
            className="w-full text-sm text-gray-400 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-blue-700 cursor-pointer"
          />
          {files.length > 0 && (
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">
              {files.length} images selected.
            </p>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={convert}
            disabled={files.length === 0 || processing}
            className="w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
          >
            {processing ? "Converting..." : "Convert to PDF"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\merge-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { PDFDocument } from "pdf-lib";

export default function MergePDF() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);

  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files) setFiles(Array.from(e.target.files));
  };

  const mergePdfs = async () => {
    if (files.length < 2) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const mergedPdf = await PDFDocument.create();
      for (const file of files) {
        const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
        const pdf = await PDFDocument.load(arrayBuffer);
        const copiedPages = await mergedPdf.copyPages(
          pdf,
          pdf.getPageIndices(),
        );
        copiedPages.forEach((page) => mergedPdf.addPage(page));
      }
      const pdfBytes = await mergedPdf.save();
      const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as unknown as ArrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = "merged.pdf";
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Error merging PDFs. Ensure they are valid.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">Merge PDF</h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <input
            type="file"
            accept=".pdf"
            multiple
            onChange={handleUpload}
            className="w-full text-sm text-gray-400 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-blue-700 cursor-pointer"
          />

          {files.length > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-gray-900 p-4 rounded-lg space-y-2 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-300">
                {files.length} files selected (Order matters):
              </p>
              {files.map((f, i) => (
                <p key={i} className="text-sm text-gray-400">
                  {i + 1}. {f.name}
                </p>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={mergePdfs}
            disabled={files.length < 2 || processing}
            className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
          >
            {processing ? "Merging..." : "Merge & Download"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
