===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\ocr-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

const TITLE = "OCR PDF";
const ENDPOINT = "/api/tools/ocr-pdf";
const ACCEPT_TYPES = ".pdf,.jpg,.jpeg,.png";
const OUTPUT_EXT = "ocr_result.pdf";

export default function OcrPDF() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const processFile = async () => {
    if (!file) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file);
      const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("OCR failed on the server.");
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = OUTPUT_EXT;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">{TITLE}</h1>
        <p className="text-center text-gray-400 mb-6 text-sm">
          Convert scanned PDFs or images into searchable, selectable text.
        </p>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-8 text-center rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT_TYPES}
              onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
              className="hidden"
              id="file-upload"
            />
            <label htmlFor="file-upload" className="cursor-pointer block">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-lg">
                {file ? file.name : "Click to upload PDF or Image"}
              </p>
              {file && (
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">
                  {(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB
                </p>
              )}
            </label>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={processFile}
            disabled={!file || processing}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-lg text-lg transition-colors"
          >
            {processing ? (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <svg
                  className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-white"
                  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <circle
                    className="opacity-25"
                    cx="12"
                    cy="12"
                    r="10"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="4"
                  ></circle>
                  <path
                    className="opacity-75"
                    fill="currentColor"
                    d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"
                  ></path>
                </svg>
                Running OCR...
              </span>
            ) : (
              `Extract Text & Download`
            )}
          </button>
          {error && (
            <div className="bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm text-red-400">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\organize-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { PDFDocument } from "pdf-lib";

export default function OrganizePDF() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [pageCount, setPageCount] = useState(0);
  const [orderInput, setOrderInput] = useState("");
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadCount = async () => {
      if (!file) return;
      const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const pdf = await PDFDocument.load(buffer);
      const count = pdf.getPageCount();
      setPageCount(count);
      setOrderInput(Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => i + 1).join(", "));
    };
    loadCount();
  }, [file]);

  const reorganize = async () => {
    if (!file) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const newOrder = orderInput
        .split(",")
        .map((n) => parseInt(n.trim()))
        .filter((n) => !isNaN(n) && n > 0 && n <= pageCount);
      if (newOrder.length === 0) {
        alert("Invalid page order");
        setProcessing(false);
        return;
      }

      const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const pdf = await PDFDocument.load(buffer);
      const newPdf = await PDFDocument.create();

      const indicesToCopy = newOrder.map((n) => n - 1);
      const copiedPages = await newPdf.copyPages(pdf, indicesToCopy);
      copiedPages.forEach((p) => newPdf.addPage(p));

      const pdfBytes = await newPdf.save();
      const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as unknown as ArrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = "organized.pdf";
      a.click();
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Error reorganizing PDF.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">Organize PDF</h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <input
            type="file"
            accept=".pdf"
            onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
            className="w-full text-sm text-gray-400 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-blue-700 cursor-pointer"
          />

          {pageCount > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300">
                New Page Order (Total: {pageCount} pages)
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={orderInput}
                onChange={(e) => setOrderInput(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 font-mono text-sm"
                placeholder="e.g. 3, 1, 2, 4"
              />
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                Enter comma-separated page numbers to reorder.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={reorganize}
            disabled={!file || processing}
            className="w-full bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
          >
            {processing ? "Reorganizing..." : "Apply Order & Download"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'

export default function PDFConverter() {
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('')
  const [converted, setConverted] = useState(false)

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (!text) return
    const win = window.open('', '_blank')
    if (!win) return
    win.document.write(`
      <html><head><title>${title||'Document'}</title>
      <style>body{font-family:Georgia,serif;max-width:800px;margin:40px auto;padding:40px;line-height:1.8;font-size:14px;}h1{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:24px;}</style>
      </head><body>
      ${title?`<h1>${title}</h1>`:''}
      ${text.replace(/\n/g,'<br/>')}
      </body></html>
    `)
    win.document.close()
    win.print()
    setConverted(true)
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-100">
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-4">
          <Link href="/tools/document-tools" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600">← Document Tools</Link>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-12">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-4">📄</div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">PDF Converter</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500">Type or paste your content and convert it to a printable PDF</p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 p-8">
          <div className="space-y-5 mb-6">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Document Title (optional)</label>
              <input value={title} onChange={e=>setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Project Report"
                className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"/>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Document Content</label>
              <textarea value={text} onChange={e=>setText(e.target.value)} rows={14}
                placeholder="Paste or type your document content here..."
                className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 resize-none"/>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={handlePrint}
            className="w-full bg-purple-600 text-white py-4 rounded-xl font-semibold text-lg hover:bg-purple-700 transition-colors">
            Convert to PDF & Print
          </button>
          {converted && (
            <p className="text-center text-sm text-green-600 mt-4">✅ Print dialog opened — choose "Save as PDF" in your browser</p>
          )}
          <div className="mt-6 bg-purple-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-purple-100">
            <p className="text-xs text-purple-700 font-medium mb-1">💡 How to save as PDF:</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-purple-600">When the print dialog opens, change the destination to <strong>"Save as PDF"</strong> instead of a printer.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

let pdfjsLib: PDFJSLib | null = null;
let PDFLib: PDFLibModule | null = null;
let fabricLib: FabricModule | null = null;

async function loadLibs(): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  if (!pdfjsLib) {
    pdfjsLib = await import("pdfjs-dist") as PDFJSLib;
    pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/${pdfjsLib.version}/pdf.worker.min.js`;
  }
  if (!PDFLib) PDFLib = await import("pdf-lib") as PDFLibModule;
  if (!fabricLib) fabricLib = await import("fabric") as FabricModule;
}

  const handleCanvasClick = useCallback((e: MouseEvent) => {
    const fc = fabricRef.current;
    if (!fc || !fabricLib || !overlayRef.current) return;
    const rect = overlayRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const f = (fabricLib as any).fabric;

    if (activeTool === TOOLS.TEXT) {
      const txt = new f.IText("Click to edit", {
        left: x, top: y,
        fontFamily: "Helvetica",
        fontSize,
        fill: color,
        editable: true,
        borderColor: "#3B82F6",
        cornerColor: "#3B82F6",
        cornerSize: 7,
        transparentCorners: false,
      });
      (fc as any).add(txt);
      (fc as any).setActiveObject(txt);
      txt.enterEditing();
      setActiveTool(TOOLS.SELECT);
    }

    if (activeTool === TOOLS.SHAPE) {
      const rect2 = new f.Rect({
        left: x, top: y, width: 120, height: 80,
        fill: "transparent", stroke: color, strokeWidth: 2, rx: 4,
      });
      (fc as any).add(rect2);
      (fc as any).setActiveObject(rect2);
      setActiveTool(TOOLS.SELECT);
    }

    if (activeTool === TOOLS.SIGN) {
      openSignaturePad(x, y);
    }
  }, [activeTool, color, fontSize]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = overlayRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.addEventListener("click", handleCanvasClick as EventListener);
    return () => el.removeEventListener("click", handleCanvasClick as EventListener);
  }, [handleCanvasClick]);

  async function loadPDF(file: File): Promise<void> {
    setLoading(true);
    setLoadMsg("Loading PDF...");
    await loadLibs();
    if (!pdfjsLib || !PDFLib) return;

    const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const uint8 = new Uint8Array(bytes);

    const libDoc = await PDFLib.PDFDocument.load(bytes);
    setPdfLibDoc(libDoc);

    const loadingTask = pdfjsLib.getDocument({ data: uint8.slice() });
    const doc = await loadingTask.promise;
    setPdfDoc(doc);
    setPageCount(doc.numPages);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    setAnnotations({});
    setLoading(false);
    setLoadMsg("");
    generateThumbnails(doc);
  }

  async function generateThumbnails(doc: PDFJSType.PDFDocumentProxy): Promise<void> {
    const thumbs: Thumbnails = {};
    const count = Math.min(doc.numPages, 20);
    for (let i = 1; i <= count; i++) {
      const page = await doc.getPage(i);
      const vp   = page.getViewport({ scale: 0.2 });
      const cvs  = document.createElement("canvas");
      cvs.width  = vp.width;
      cvs.height = vp.height;
      const ctx  = cvs.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) continue;
      await page.render({ canvasContext: ctx, viewport: vp } as any).promise;
      thumbs[i] = cvs.toDataURL("image/jpeg", 0.7);
    }
    setThumbnails(thumbs);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDoc || !canvasRef.current || !fabricRef.current) return;
    const fc = fabricRef.current;

    (async () => {
      // Save annotations for the page we're leaving
      setAnnotations(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        [currentPage]: (fc as any).toJSON(),
      }));

      renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();

      const page = await pdfDoc.getPage(currentPage);
      const vp   = page.getViewport({ scale });
      const cvs  = canvasRef.current!;
      const ctx  = cvs.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) return;
      cvs.width  = vp.width;
      cvs.height = vp.height;

      (fc as any).setWidth(vp.width);
      (fc as any).setHeight(vp.height);
      if (overlayRef.current) {
        overlayRef.current.style.width  = vp.width + "px";
        overlayRef.current.style.height = vp.height + "px";
      }

      const renderTask = page.render({ canvasContext: ctx, viewport: vp } as any);
      renderTaskRef.current = renderTask;
      await renderTask.promise;

      (fc as any).clear();
      (fc as any).backgroundColor = "transparent";
      if (annotations[currentPage]) {
        (fc as any).loadFromJSON(annotations[currentPage], () => (fc as any).renderAll());
      }
    })();
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [pdfDoc, currentPage, scale]);

  function deleteSelected(): void {
    const fc = fabricRef.current;
    if (!fc) return;
    const obj = (fc as any).getActiveObject();
    if (obj) {
      (fc as any).remove(obj);
      (fc as any).discardActiveObject();
      (fc as any).renderAll();
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
      const tag = (document.activeElement as HTMLElement)?.tagName;
      if ((e.key === "Delete" || e.key === "Backspace") && tag !== "INPUT") {
        deleteSelected();
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  });

  async function exportPDF(): Promise<void> {
    if (!pdfLibDoc || !fabricRef.current || !fabricLib) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setLoadMsg("Baking annotations into PDF...");

    const fc = fabricRef.current;
    const allAnnotations: Annotations = {
      ...annotations,
      [currentPage]: (fc as any).toJSON(),
    };

    const pages = pdfLibDoc.getPages();

    for (let i = 1; i <= pageCount; i++) {
      const ann = allAnnotations[i] as any;
      if (!ann?.objects?.length) continue;

      const page = pages[i - 1];
      const { width: pW, height: pH } = page.getSize();

      const tmpCvs = document.createElement("canvas");
      tmpCvs.width  = (fc as any).width  ?? pW;
      tmpCvs.height = (fc as any).height ?? pH;
      const f = (fabricLib as any).fabric;
      const tmpFc: FabricStaticCanvas = new f.StaticCanvas(tmpCvs);
      await new Promise<void>(res => (tmpFc as any).loadFromJSON(ann, res));
      (tmpFc as any).renderAll();

      const imgData  = (tmpCvs as HTMLCanvasElement).toDataURL("image/png");
      const pngBytes = await fetch(imgData).then(r => r.arrayBuffer());
      const embImg   = await pdfLibDoc.embedPng(pngBytes);

      page.drawImage(embImg, { x: 0, y: 0, width: pW, height: pH, opacity: 1 });
    }

    const outBytes = await pdfLibDoc.save();
    const blob = new Blob([outBytes as unknown as ArrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
    const url  = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a    = document.createElement("a");
    a.href     = url;
    a.download = "edited-document.pdf";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  function openSignaturePad(x: number, y: number): void {
    setSigModal({ x, y });
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (!sigCanvasRef.current || !fabricLib) return;
      const f = (fabricLib as any).fabric;
      const sf: FabricCanvas = new f.Canvas(sigCanvasRef.current, {
        isDrawingMode: true,
        backgroundColor: "#fff",
      });
      (sf as any).freeDrawingBrush.color = "#000";
      (sf as any).freeDrawingBrush.width = 2;
      sigFabricRef.current = sf;
    }, 100);
  }

  function confirmSignature(): void {
    if (!sigFabricRef.current || !fabricRef.current || !sigModal || !fabricLib) return;
    const dataUrl = (sigFabricRef.current as any).toDataURL({ format: "png", multiplier: 1 }) as string;
    const f = (fabricLib as any).fabric;
    const fc = fabricRef.current;
    const modal = sigModal;
    f.Image.fromURL(dataUrl, (img: any) => {
      img.set({ left: modal.x, top: modal.y, scaleX: 0.5, scaleY: 0.5 });
      (fc as any).add(img);
      (fc as any).renderAll();
    });
    sigFabricRef.current?.dispose();
    setSigModal(null);
  }

  function onDrop(e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void {

const toolBtnStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  padding:"6px 10px", borderRadius:6, cursor:"pointer", fontSize:14,
  fontFamily:"inherit", transition:"all .15s",
};

const navBtn: React.CSSProperties = {
  background:"transparent", border:"none", color:"#a0a0c0",
  cursor:"pointer", fontSize:16, padding:"2px 8px",
};

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontSize:10, color:"#6b6b8a", letterSpacing:".06em",
  fontWeight:600, display:"block", marginBottom:4,
};

const selectStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  background:"#0f3460", border:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)",
  color:"#e8e6f0", borderRadius:6, padding:"4px 8px",
  fontSize:12, fontFamily:"inherit",
};

function btnStyle(bg: string, _hov: string): React.CSSProperties {
  return {
    background: bg, border:"none", color:"#fff", borderRadius:6,
    padding:"6px 12px", cursor:"pointer", fontSize:12, fontWeight:500,
    fontFamily:"inherit", whiteSpace:"nowrap", transition:"background .15s",
  };
}

function toolCursor(tool: ToolType): string {
  const map: Record<ToolType, string> = {
    [TOOLS.SELECT]:    "default",
    [TOOLS.TEXT]:      "text",
    [TOOLS.DRAW]:      "crosshair",
    [TOOLS.HIGHLIGHT]: "crosshair",
    [TOOLS.SHAPE]:     "crosshair",
    [TOOLS.SIGN]:      "pointer",
    [TOOLS.ERASE]:     "cell",
  };
  return map[tool] ?? "default";
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\pdf-to-excel\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

const TITLE = "PDF to Excel";
const ENDPOINT = "/api/tools/pdf-to-excel";
const ACCEPT_TYPES = ".pdf";
const OUTPUT_EXT = "spreadsheet.xlsx";

export default function PDFToExcel() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const processFile = async () => {
    if (!file) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file);
      const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Conversion failed on the server.");
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = OUTPUT_EXT;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">{TITLE}</h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-8 text-center rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT_TYPES}
              onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
              className="hidden"
              id="file-upload"
            />
            <label htmlFor="file-upload" className="cursor-pointer block">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-lg">
                {file ? file.name : "Click to upload PDF"}
              </p>
              {file && (
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">
                  {(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB
                </p>
              )}
            </label>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={processFile}
            disabled={!file || processing}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-lg text-lg transition-colors"
          >
            {processing ? (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <svg
                  className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-white"
                  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <circle
                    className="opacity-25"
                    cx="12"
                    cy="12"
                    r="10"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="4"
                  ></circle>
                  <path
                    className="opacity-75"
                    fill="currentColor"
                    d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"
                  ></path>
                </svg>
                Extracting Data...
              </span>
            ) : (
              `Convert to XLSX`
            )}
          </button>
          {error && (
            <div className="bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm text-red-400">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const processFile = async () => {
    if (!file) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file);
      const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Conversion failed on the server.");
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = OUTPUT_EXT;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">{TITLE}</h1>
        <p className="text-center text-gray-400 mb-6 text-sm">
          Convert PDF pages into high-quality JPG images.
        </p>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-8 text-center rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT_TYPES}
              onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
              className="hidden"
              id="file-upload"

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\pdf-to-pdfa\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

const TITLE = "PDF to PDF/A";
const ENDPOINT = "/api/tools/pdf-to-pdfa";
const ACCEPT_TYPES = ".pdf";
const OUTPUT_EXT = "document_archived.pdf";

export default function PDFToPDFA() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const processFile = async () => {
    if (!file) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file);
      const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Conversion failed on the server.");
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = OUTPUT_EXT;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">{TITLE}</h1>
        <p className="text-center text-gray-400 mb-6 text-sm">
          Transform your PDF into an ISO-standardized archival format.
        </p>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-8 text-center rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT_TYPES}
              onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
              className="hidden"
              id="file-upload"
            />
            <label htmlFor="file-upload" className="cursor-pointer block">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-lg">
                {file ? file.name : "Click to upload PDF"}
              </p>
              {file && (
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">
                  {(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB
                </p>
              )}
            </label>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={processFile}
            disabled={!file || processing}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-lg text-lg transition-colors"
          >
            {processing ? (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <svg
                  className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-white"

                    cx="12"
                    cy="12"
                    r="10"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="4"
                  ></circle>
                  <path
                    className="opacity-75"
                    fill="currentColor"
                    d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"
                  ></path>
                </svg>
                Standardizing...
              </span>
            ) : (

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\proposal-generator\page.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'

// ─── TOOL CONFIG ───
const TOOL_TITLE = 'Proposal Generator'
const TOOL_EMOJI = '💼'
const TOOL_DESC = 'Create winning business proposals with AI'

const FIELDS = [
  { key: 'company', label: 'Your Company', placeholder: 'Creative Agency Co' },
  { key: 'client', label: 'Client Name', placeholder: 'TechStart Inc' },
  { key: 'project', label: 'Project / Service', placeholder: 'Brand redesign and website' },
  { key: 'details', label: 'Key Details (budget, timeline, goals)', placeholder: '$15,000 budget, 8 weeks, increase conversions by 30%' },
]

const buildPrompt = (vals: Record<string, string>) =>
  `Write a professional business proposal from "${vals.company}" to "${vals.client}".
Project: ${vals.project}. Details: ${vals.details}.
Include: executive summary, problem statement, proposed solution, deliverables, timeline, investment/pricing, why us, call to action.`
// ───────────────────

export default function DocumentTool() {
  const [vals, setVals] = useState<Record<string, string>>(
    Object.fromEntries(FIELDS.map(f => [f.key, '']))
  )
  const [result, setResult] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const set = (k: string, v: string) =>
    setVals(p => ({ ...p, [k]: v }))

  const generate = async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    setResult('')
    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'x-api-key': process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY || '',
          'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
          max_tokens: 1000,
          messages: [{ role: 'user', content: buildPrompt(vals) }]
        })
      })

      const data = await res.json()
      setResult(data.content?.[0]?.text || 'Error generating')
    } catch {
      setResult('Error. Please try again.')
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }

  const print = () => {
    const win = window.open('', '_blank')
    if (!win) return
    win.document.write(`
      <html>
        <head>
          <title>${TOOL_TITLE}</title>
          <style>
            body {
              font-family: Georgia, serif;
              max-width: 750px;
              margin: 60px auto;
              padding: 40px;
              line-height: 1.9;
              white-space: pre-wrap;
            }
          </style>
        </head>
        <body>${result}</body>
      </html>
    `)
    win.document.close()
    win.print()
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-100">
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-4">
          <Link href="/tools/document-tools" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600">
            ← Document Tools
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-12">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-4">{TOOL_EMOJI}</div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">{TOOL_TITLE}</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500">{TOOL_DESC}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-8 space-y-5">
          {FIELDS.map(f => (
            <div key={f.key}>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                {f.label}
              </label>

              {f.key === 'details' ? (
                <textarea
                  value={vals[f.key]}
                  onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)}
                  rows={4}
                  placeholder={f.placeholder}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 resize-none"
                />
              ) : (
                <input
                  value={vals[f.key]}
                  onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={f.placeholder}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"
                />
              )}
            </div>
          ))}

          <button
            onClick={generate}
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full bg-purple-600 text-white py-4 rounded-xl font-semibold text-lg hover:bg-purple-700 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {loading ? `Generating ${TOOL_TITLE}...` : `Generate with AI`}
          </button>

          {result && (
            <div>
              <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-6 border border-gray-200 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-gray-700 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                {result}
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-3 mt-3">
                <button
                  onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(result)}
                  className="flex-1 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold hover:bg-gray-200"
                >
                  Copy Text
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={print}
                  className="flex-1 bg-gray-800 text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold hover:bg-gray-900"
                >
                  Save as PDF
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\protect-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function ProtectPDF() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);

  const protectFile = async () => {
    if (!file || !password) return;
    setProcessing(true);

    /* --- FRONTEND LIMITATION WORKAROUND ---
       In a real app, you would send this to your Express API:
       const formData = new FormData();
       formData.append('file', file);
       formData.append('password', password);
       fetch('/api/protect-pdf', { method: 'POST', body: formData })
    */
    await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 1500)); // Simulate API call

    alert(
      "PDF Protection requires a backend connection. Please set up your /api/protect-pdf endpoint.",
    );
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">Protect PDF</h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <input
            type="file"
            accept=".pdf"
            onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
            className="w-full text-sm text-gray-400 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-blue-700 cursor-pointer"
          />
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Set Password
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500"
              placeholder="Enter strong password"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={protectFile}
            disabled={!file || !password || processing}
            className="w-full bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
          >
            {processing ? "Encrypting..." : "Encrypt & Download"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'

// ─── TOOL CONFIG ───
const TOOL_TITLE = 'Reference Letter'
const TOOL_EMOJI = '🎓'
const TOOL_DESC = 'Write professional reference letters with AI'

const FIELDS = [
  { key: 'writer', label: 'Your Name & Title', placeholder: 'Dr. Sarah Johnson, Professor' },
  { key: 'candidate', label: 'Candidate Name', placeholder: 'Alex Chen' },
  { key: 'relationship', label: 'Your Relationship', placeholder: 'Supervised for 2 years at MIT' },
  { key: 'qualities', label: 'Key Qualities & Achievements', placeholder: 'Exceptional problem solver, led 3 research projects, published 2 papers' },
]

const buildPrompt = (vals: Record<string, string>) =>
  `Write a strong professional reference letter from "${vals.writer}" for "${vals.candidate}".
Relationship: ${vals.relationship}. Key qualities: ${vals.qualities}.
Include: formal opening, how you know the candidate, specific achievements and qualities, strong recommendation, closing with contact offer.`
// ───────────────────

export default function DocumentTool() {
  const [vals, setVals] = useState<Record<string, string>>(
    Object.fromEntries(FIELDS.map(f => [f.key, '']))
  )
  const [result, setResult] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const set = (k: string, v: string) =>
    setVals(p => ({ ...p, [k]: v }))

  const generate = async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    setResult('')
    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'x-api-key': process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY || '',
          'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
          max_tokens: 1000,
          messages: [{ role: 'user', content: buildPrompt(vals) }]
        })
      })

      const data = await res.json()
      setResult(data.content?.[0]?.text || 'Error generating')
    } catch {
      setResult('Error. Please try again.')
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }

  const print = () => {
    const win = window.open('', '_blank')
    if (!win) return
    win.document.write(`
      <html>
        <head>
          <title>${TOOL_TITLE}</title>
          <style>
            body {
              font-family: Georgia, serif;
              max-width: 750px;
              margin: 60px auto;
              padding: 40px;
              line-height: 1.9;
              white-space: pre-wrap;
            }
          </style>
        </head>
        <body>${result}</body>
      </html>
    `)
    win.document.close()
    win.print()
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-100">
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-4">
          <Link href="/tools/document-tools" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600">
            ← Document Tools
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-12">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-4">{TOOL_EMOJI}</div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">{TOOL_TITLE}</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500">{TOOL_DESC}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-8 space-y-5">
          {FIELDS.map(f => (
            <div key={f.key}>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                {f.label}
              </label>

              {f.key === 'qualities' ? (
                <textarea
                  value={vals[f.key]}
                  onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)}
                  rows={4}
                  placeholder={f.placeholder}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 resize-none"
                />
              ) : (
                <input
                  value={vals[f.key]}
                  onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={f.placeholder}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"
                />
              )}
            </div>
          ))}

          <button
            onClick={generate}
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full bg-purple-600 text-white py-4 rounded-xl font-semibold text-lg hover:bg-purple-700 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {loading ? `Generating ${TOOL_TITLE}...` : `Generate with AI`}
          </button>

          {result && (
            <div>
              <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-6 border border-gray-200 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-gray-700 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                {result}
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-3 mt-3">
                <button

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\remove-pdf-pages\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { PDFDocument } from "pdf-lib";

export default function RemovePDFPages() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [pageCount, setPageCount] = useState(0);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadCount = async () => {
      if (!file) return;
      const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const pdf = await PDFDocument.load(buffer);
      setPageCount(pdf.getPageCount());
      setSelected(new Set());
    };
    loadCount();
  }, [file]);

  const togglePage = (num: number) => {
    const newSet = new Set(selected);
    if (newSet.has(num)) newSet.delete(num);
    else newSet.add(num);
    setSelected(newSet);
  };

  const removePages = async () => {
    if (!file || selected.size === 0) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const pdf = await PDFDocument.load(buffer);
      // Filter out selected pages (convert 1-based user input to 0-based index)
      const indicesToKeep = pdf
        .getPageIndices()
        .filter((i) => !selected.has(i + 1));
      const newPdf = await PDFDocument.create();
      const copiedPages = await newPdf.copyPages(pdf, indicesToKeep);
      copiedPages.forEach((p) => newPdf.addPage(p));

      const pdfBytes = await newPdf.save();
      const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as unknown as ArrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = "removed_pages.pdf";
      a.click();
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Error removing pages.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Remove PDF Pages
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <input
            type="file"
            accept=".pdf"
            onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
            className="w-full text-sm text-gray-400 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-blue-700 cursor-pointer"
          />

          {pageCount > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-gray-900 p-4 rounded-lg">
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-300 mb-3">
                Select pages to{" "}
                <span className="text-red-400 font-bold">REMOVE</span>:
              </p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-6 sm:grid-cols-10 gap-2">
                {Array.from({ length: pageCount }, (_, i) => i + 1).map(
                  (num) => (
                    <button
                      key={num}
                      onClick={() => togglePage(num)}
                      className={`p-2 rounded text-sm font-bold transition-colors ${selected.has(num) ? "bg-red-600 text-white" : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-600"}`}
                    >
                      {num}
                    </button>
                  ),
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={removePages}
            disabled={!file || selected.size === 0 || processing}
            className="w-full bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
          >
            {processing
              ? "Processing..."
              : `Remove ${selected.size} Page(s) & Download`}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\repair-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

const TITLE = "Repair PDF";
const ENDPOINT = "/api/tools/repair-pdf";
const ACCEPT_TYPES = ".pdf";
const OUTPUT_EXT = "repaired.pdf";

export default function RepairPDF() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const processFile = async () => {
    if (!file) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file);
      const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Repair failed on the server.");
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = OUTPUT_EXT;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">{TITLE}</h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-8 text-center rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT_TYPES}
              onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
              className="hidden"
              id="file-upload"
            />
            <label htmlFor="file-upload" className="cursor-pointer block">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-lg">
                {file ? file.name : "Click to upload your corrupted file"}
              </p>
              {file && (
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">
                  {(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB
                </p>
              )}
            </label>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={processFile}
            disabled={!file || processing}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-lg text-lg transition-colors"
          >
            {processing ? (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <svg
                  className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-white"
                  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <circle
                    className="opacity-25"
                    cx="12"
                    cy="12"
                    r="10"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="4"
                  ></circle>
                  <path
                    className="opacity-75"
                    fill="currentColor"
                    d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"
                  ></path>
                </svg>
                Repairing...
              </span>
            ) : (
              `Repair & Download`
            )}
          </button>
          {error && (
            <div className="bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm text-red-400">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { PDFDocument, degrees } from "pdf-lib";

export default function RotatePDF() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [rotation, setRotation] = useState(90);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);

  const rotatePdf = async () => {
    if (!file) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const pdfDoc = await PDFDocument.load(arrayBuffer);
      const pages = pdfDoc.getPages();
      pages.forEach((page) => page.setRotation(degrees(rotation)));
      const pdfBytes = await pdfDoc.save();
      const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as unknown as ArrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `rotated_${rotation}.pdf`;
      a.click();
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Error rotating PDF.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">Rotate PDF</h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <input
            type="file"
            accept=".pdf"
            onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
            className="w-full text-sm text-gray-400 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-blue-700 cursor-pointer"
          />

          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Rotation Angle
            </label>
            <select
              value={rotation}
              onChange={(e) => setRotation(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            >
              <option value={90}>90Â° (Right)</option>
              <option value={180}>180Â° (Upside Down)</option>
              <option value={270}>270Â° (Left)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={rotatePdf}
            disabled={!file || processing}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
          >
            {processing ? "Rotating..." : "Rotate & Download"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\scan-to-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { PDFDocument } from "pdf-lib";

export default function ScanToPDF() {
  const [images, setImages] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);

  const handleImages = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files) return;
    const newImages: string[] = [];
    Array.from(files).forEach((file) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (ev) => {
        if (ev.target?.result) {
          newImages.push(ev.target.result as string);
          if (newImages.length === files.length)
            setImages((prev) => [...prev, ...newImages]);
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  };

  const removeImage = (index: number) => {
    setImages(images.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const convertToPdf = async () => {
    if (images.length === 0) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const pdfDoc = await PDFDocument.create();

      for (const imgData of images) {
        let image;
        // Check if jpeg or png
        if (imgData.includes("image/png")) {
          image = await pdfDoc.embedPng(imgData);
        } else {
          image = await pdfDoc.embedJpg(imgData);
        }

        // Standard US Letter size
        const page = pdfDoc.addPage([612, 792]);
        const { width, height } = image.scale(1);

        // Scale image to fit page while maintaining aspect ratio
        const scale = Math.min(612 / width, 792 / height);
        const scaledWidth = width * scale;
        const scaledHeight = height * scale;

        page.drawImage(image, {
          x: (612 - scaledWidth) / 2,
          y: (792 - scaledHeight) / 2,
          width: scaledWidth,
          height: scaledHeight,
        });
      }

      const pdfBytes = await pdfDoc.save();
      const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as unknown as ArrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = "scan.pdf";
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Error creating PDF. Ensure images are JPG or PNG.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">Scan to PDF</h1>
        <p className="text-center text-gray-400 mb-6 text-sm">
          Upload scanned images or use your mobile camera. They will be
          converted into a single PDF.
        </p>

        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <input
            type="file"
            accept="image/png, image/jpeg, image/jpg"
            multiple
            capture="environment"
            onChange={handleImages}
            className="w-full text-sm text-gray-400 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-blue-700 cursor-pointer"
          />

          {images.length > 0 && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
              {images.map((img, i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  className="relative group aspect-square bg-gray-900 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-gray-700"
                >
                  <img
                    src={img}
                    alt={`Scan ${i + 1}`}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={() => removeImage(i)}
                    className="absolute top-1 right-1 bg-red-600 text-white text-xs rounded-full w-5 h-5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                  >
                    X
                  </button>
                  <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 bg-black/70 text-white text-xs px-2 py-1">
                    {i + 1}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={convertToPdf}
            disabled={images.length === 0 || processing}
            className="w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
          >
            {processing
              ? "Creating PDF..."
              : `Convert ${images.length} Images to PDF`}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\sign-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

const TITLE = "Sign PDF";
const ENDPOINT = "/api/tools/sign-pdf";
const ACCEPT_TYPES = ".pdf";
const OUTPUT_EXT = "signed.pdf";

export default function SignPDF() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const processFile = async () => {
    if (!file) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file);
      const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Signing failed on the server.");
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = OUTPUT_EXT;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">{TITLE}</h1>
        <p className="text-center text-gray-400 mb-6 text-sm">
          E-sign documents securely and legally.
        </p>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-8 text-center rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT_TYPES}
              onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
              className="hidden"
              id="file-upload"
            />
            <label htmlFor="file-upload" className="cursor-pointer block">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-lg">
                {file ? file.name : "Click to upload PDF to Sign"}
              </p>
              {file && (
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">
                  {(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB
                </p>
              )}
            </label>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={processFile}
            disabled={!file || processing}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-lg text-lg transition-colors"
          >
            {processing ? (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <svg
                  className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-white"
                  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <circle
                    className="opacity-25"
                    cx="12"
                    cy="12"
                    r="10"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="4"
                  ></circle>
                  <path
                    className="opacity-75"
                    fill="currentColor"
                    d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"
                  ></path>
                </svg>
                Applying Signature...
              </span>
            ) : (
              `Sign & Download`
            )}
          </button>
          {error && (
            <div className="bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm text-red-400">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\split-pdf\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { PDFDocument } from "pdf-lib";

export default function SplitPDF() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);

  const splitPdf = async () => {
    if (!file) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const pdf = await PDFDocument.load(arrayBuffer);
      const totalPages = pdf.getPageCount();

      for (let i = 0; i < totalPages; i++) {
        const newPdf = await PDFDocument.create();
        const [copiedPage] = await newPdf.copyPages(pdf, [i]);
        newPdf.addPage(copiedPage);
        const pdfBytes = await newPdf.save();
        const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as unknown as ArrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = url;
        a.download = `page_${i + 1}.pdf`;
        a.click();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        // Small delay so browser doesn't block multiple downloads
        await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 500));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Error splitting PDF.");
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">Split PDF</h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <input
            type="file"
            accept=".pdf"
            onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
            className="w-full text-sm text-gray-400 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-blue-700 cursor-pointer"
          />

          {file && (
            <div className="bg-gray-900 p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
              Ready to split:{" "}
              <span className="text-white font-bold">{file.name}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={splitPdf}
            disabled={!file || processing}
            className="w-full bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
          >
            {processing
              ? "Splitting..."
              : "Split into Individual Pages (Downloads each)"}
          </button>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 text-center">
            * Allow pop-ups/downloads for this site to get all pages.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\document-tools\terms-of-service\page.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'

// ─── TOOL CONFIG ───
const TOOL_TITLE = 'Terms of Service Generator'
const TOOL_EMOJI = '⚖️'
const TOOL_DESC = 'Generate Terms of Service for your website or app'

const FIELDS = [
  { key: 'company', label: 'Company / App Name', placeholder: 'My SaaS App' },
  { key: 'website', label: 'Website URL', placeholder: 'https://myapp.com' },
  { key: 'type', label: 'Type of Service', placeholder: 'SaaS platform for project management' },
  { key: 'details', label: 'Special Terms (optional)', placeholder: 'No refunds, users must be 18+' },
]

const buildPrompt = (vals: Record<string, string>) =>
  `Generate comprehensive Terms of Service for "${vals.company}" (${vals.website}).
Service type: ${vals.type}. Special terms: ${vals.details || 'Standard'}.
Include: acceptance of terms, use of service, user accounts, prohibited uses, IP rights, disclaimers, limitation of liability, governing law, contact info.`
// ───────────────────

export default function DocumentTool() {
  const [vals, setVals] = useState<Record<string, string>>(
    Object.fromEntries(FIELDS.map(f => [f.key, '']))
  )
  const [result, setResult] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const set = (k: string, v: string) =>
    setVals(p => ({ ...p, [k]: v }))

  const generate = async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    setResult('')
    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'x-api-key': process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY || '',
          'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
          max_tokens: 1000,
          messages: [{ role: 'user', content: buildPrompt(vals) }]
        })
      })

      const data = await res.json()
      setResult(data.content?.[0]?.text || 'Error generating')
    } catch {
      setResult('Error. Please try again.')
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }

  const print = () => {
    const win = window.open('', '_blank')
    if (!win) return
    win.document.write(`
      <html>
        <head>
          <title>${TOOL_TITLE}</title>
          <style>
            body {
              font-family: Georgia, serif;
              max-width: 750px;
              margin: 60px auto;
              padding: 40px;
              line-height: 1.9;
              white-space: pre-wrap;
            }
          </style>
        </head>
        <body>${result}</body>
      </html>
    `)
    win.document.close()
    win.print()
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-100">
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-4">
          <Link href="/tools/document-tools" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600">
            ← Document Tools
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-12">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-4">{TOOL_EMOJI}</div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">{TOOL_TITLE}</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500">{TOOL_DESC}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-8 space-y-5">
          {FIELDS.map(f => (
            <div key={f.key}>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                {f.label}
              </label>

              {f.key === 'details' ? (
                <textarea
                  value={vals[f.key]}
                  onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)}
                  rows={4}
                  placeholder={f.placeholder}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 resize-none"
                />
              ) : (
                <input
                  value={vals[f.key]}
                  onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={f.placeholder}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"
                />
              )}
            </div>
          ))}

          <button
            onClick={generate}
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full bg-purple-600 text-white py-4 rounded-xl font-semibold text-lg hover:bg-purple-700 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {loading ? `Generating ${TOOL_TITLE}...` : `Generate with AI`}
          </button>

          {result && (
            <div>
              <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-6 border border-gray-200 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-gray-700 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                {result}
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-3 mt-3">
                <button
                  onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(result)}
                  className="flex-1 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold hover:bg-gray-200"
                >
                  Copy Text
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={print}
                  className="flex-1 bg-gray-800 text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold hover:bg-gray-900"
                >
                  Save as PDF
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

              </p>
              {file && (
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">
                  {(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB
                </p>
              )}
            </label>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={processFile}
            disabled={!file || processing}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-lg text-lg transition-colors"
          >
            {processing ? (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <svg
                  className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-white"
                  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <circle
                    className="opacity-25"
                    cx="12"
                    cy="12"
                    r="10"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="4"
                  ></circle>
                  <path
                    className="opacity-75"
                    fill="currentColor"
                    d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"
                  ></path>
                </svg>
                Converting...
              </span>
            ) : (
              `Convert to PDF`
            )}
          </button>
          {error && (
            <div className="bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm text-red-400">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
