===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\legal-tools\core-tools\citation-generator\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
export default function CitationGenerator() {
  const [author, setAuthor] = useState("");
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [year, setYear] = useState("");
  const [publisher, setPublisher] = useState("");
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  const [format, setFormat] = useState("APA");
  const generate = () => {
    if (!author || !title || !year) return "";
    if (format === "APA")
      return `${author} (${year}). ${title}. ${publisher}. ${url}`;
    if (format === "MLA")
      return `${author}. "${title}." ${publisher}, ${year}. ${url}`;
    return `${author}. "${title}." ${publisher}, ${year}. ${url}`;
  };
  const citation = generate();
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Citation Generator
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <div className="flex gap-4">
            {["APA", "MLA", "Chicago"].map((f) => (
              <button
                key={f}
                onClick={() => setFormat(f)}
                className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold transition ${format === f ? "bg-blue-600" : "bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600"}`}
              >
                {f}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={author}
            onChange={(e) => setAuthor(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Author(s)"
            className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
          />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={title}
            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Title of Work"
            className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
          />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={year}
              onChange={(e) => setYear(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Year"
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={publisher}
              onChange={(e) => setPublisher(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Publisher"
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={url}
            onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="URL (optional)"
            className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
          />
          {citation && (
            <div className="mt-4 p-4 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg break-words">
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">{format} Format</p>
              <p className="text-blue-400 font-mono">{citation}</p>
              <button
                onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(citation)}
                className="mt-3 text-sm bg-blue-600 px-4 py-1 rounded"
              >
                Copy
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\legal-tools\core-tools\contract-generator\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
const TEMPLATES: Record<string, string> = {
  NDA: `NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT\n\nBetween: {A} ("Disclosing Party")\nAnd: {B} ("Receiving Party")\nDate: {D}\n\nThe Receiving Party agrees to hold and maintain the confidential information in strict confidence...`,
  Lease: `RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT\n\nLandlord: {A}\nTenant: {B}\nDate: {D}\n\nThe Landlord agrees to lease to the Tenant the property located at [INSERT ADDRESS]...`,
  Contractor: `INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR AGREEMENT\n\nClient: {A}\nContractor: {B}\nDate: {D}\n\nThe Client hereby engages the Contractor to perform the following services: [INSERT SERVICES]...`,
};
export default function ContractGenerator() {
  const [type, setType] = useState("NDA");
  const [partyA, setPartyA] = useState("");
  const [partyB, setPartyB] = useState("");
  const [date, setDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]);
  const contract = TEMPLATES[type]
    .replace("{A}", partyA || "[Party A]")
    .replace("{B}", partyB || "[Party B]")
    .replace("{D}", date);
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-4 text-center">
          Contract Generator
        </h1>
        <p className="text-center text-gray-400 mb-8 text-xs">
          *For educational purposes only. Consult an attorney.
        </p>
        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <select
              value={type}
              onChange={(e) => setType(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            >
              {Object.keys(TEMPLATES).map((t) => (
                <option key={t} value={t}>
                  {t}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={partyA}
              onChange={(e) => setPartyA(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Party A"
              className="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={partyB}
              onChange={(e) => setPartyB(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Party B"
              className="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            />
            <input
              type="date"
              value={date}
              onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="md:col-span-2 bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-700">
            <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap font-sans text-sm text-gray-300 h-96 overflow-y-auto">
              {contract}
            </pre>
            <button
              onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(contract)}
              className="mt-4 w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold py-2 rounded-lg"
            >
              Copy Contract Text
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\legal-tools\core-tools\document-comparison\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
export default function DocumentComparison() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const processFiles = async () => {
    if (files.length < 2) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const f = new FormData();
      f.append("file1", files[0]);
      f.append("file2", files[1]);
      const r = await fetch("/api/tools/legal-compare", {
        method: "POST",
        body: f,
      });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("Failed");
      const b = await r.blob();
      const u = URL.createObjectURL(b);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = u;
      a.download = "diff.pdf";
      a.click();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    }
    setProcessing(false);
  };
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Document Comparison
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-8 text-center rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              accept=".pdf,.docx"
              multiple
              onChange={(e) =>
                setFiles(e.target.files ? Array.from(e.target.files) : [])
              }
              className="hidden"
              id="f"
            />
            <label htmlFor="f" className="cursor-pointer block">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-lg">
                {files.length > 0
                  ? `${files.length} files selected`
                  : "Upload 2 Documents"}
              </p>
            </label>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={processFiles}
            disabled={files.length < 2 || processing}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-lg text-lg"
          >
            {processing ? "Comparing..." : "Generate Redline"}
          </button>
          {error && (
            <div className="bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm text-red-400">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\legal-tools\core-tools\e-signature-tool\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
export default function ESignatureTool() {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [isDrawing, setIsDrawing] = useState(false);
  const [signed, setSigned] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const c = canvasRef.current;
    if (!c) return;
    const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#000000";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  }, []);
  const start = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const ctx = canvasRef.current?.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    const r = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(e.clientX - (r?.left || 0), e.clientY - (r?.top || 0));
    setIsDrawing(true);
  };
  const draw = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!isDrawing) return;
    const ctx = canvasRef.current?.getContext("2d");
    const r = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    ctx?.lineTo(e.clientX - (r?.left || 0), e.clientY - (r?.top || 0));
    ctx?.stroke();
  };
  const stop = () => {
    setIsDrawing(false);
    setSigned(true);
  };
  const clear = () => {
    const ctx = canvasRef.current?.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx || !canvasRef.current) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasRef.current.width, canvasRef.current.height);
    setSigned(false);
  };
  const download = () => {
    const c = canvasRef.current;
    if (!c) return;
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.download = "signature.png";
    a.href = c.toDataURL();
    a.click();
  };
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          E-Signature Tool
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
            <canvas
              ref={canvasRef}
              width={500}
              height={200}
              className="w-full cursor-crosshair bg-white"
              onMouseDown={start}
              onMouseMove={draw}
              onMouseUp={stop}
              onMouseLeave={stop}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-4">
            <button
              onClick={clear}
              className="flex-1 bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-white py-2 rounded-lg"
            >
              Clear
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={download}
              disabled={!signed}
              className="flex-1 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white py-2 rounded-lg"
            >
              Download PNG
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\real-estate\calculators\amortization-schedule\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
export default function Page() {
  const [loan, setLoan] = useState("");
  const [rate, setRate] = useState("6.5");
  const [term, setTerm] = useState("30");
  const l = parseFloat(loan) || 0;
  const r = parseFloat(rate) / 100 / 12;
  const t = parseInt(term) * 12;
  const m =
    l > 0 && r > 0
      ? l * ((Math.pow(1 + r, t) - 1) / (r * Math.pow(1 + r, t)))
      : 0;
  const schedule = [];
  let bal = l;
  for (let i = 1; i <= t && i <= 12; i++) {
    const intP = bal * r;
    const prinP = m - intP;
    bal -= prinP;
    schedule.push({ m: i, p: prinP, i: intP, b: bal });
  }
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Amortization Schedule
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
              Loan Amount ($)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={loan}
              onChange={(e) => setLoan(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
                Interest Rate (%)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={rate}
                onChange={(e) => setRate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
                Term (Years)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={term}
                onChange={(e) => setTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          {l > 0 && (
            <>
              <div className="p-3 bg-blue-900/30 border border-blue-700 rounded-lg text-center text-2xl font-bold text-blue-400">
                Monthly Payment: ${Math.round(m).toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm text-left mt-2">
                  <thead className="text-xs text-gray-400 uppercase border-b border-gray-700">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="p-2">Month</th>
                      <th className="p-2">Principal</th>
                      <th className="p-2">Interest</th>
                      <th className="p-2">Balance</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {schedule.map((s) => (
                      <tr
                        key={s.m}
                        className="border-b border-gray-800 text-gray-300"
                      >
                        <td className="p-2">{s.m}</td>
                        <td className="p-2 text-green-400">
                          ${Math.round(s.p).toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2 text-red-400">
                          ${Math.round(s.i).toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2">
                          ${Math.round(s.b).toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 text-center">
                Showing first 12 months
              </p>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\real-estate\calculators\down-payment-planner\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
export default function Page() {
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState("");
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState("");
  const [months, setMonths] = useState("36");
  const [rate, setRate] = useState("4.5");
  const g = parseFloat(goal) || 0;
  const s = parseFloat(saved) || 0;
  const m = parseInt(months) || 0;
  const r = (parseFloat(rate) || 0) / 100 / 12;
  const target = g - s;
  const monthly =
    m > 0 && r > 0
      ? (target * r) / (Math.pow(1 + r, m) - 1)
      : m > 0
        ? target / m
        : 0;
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Down Payment Planner
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
              Down Payment Goal ($)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={goal}
              onChange={(e) => setGoal(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
              Already Saved ($)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={saved}
              onChange={(e) => setSaved(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
                Months to Save
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={months}
                onChange={(e) => setMonths(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
                Savings APR (%)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={rate}
                onChange={(e) => setRate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          {target > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-4 p-4 bg-teal-900/30 border border-teal-700 rounded-lg text-center">

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\real-estate\calculators\home-affordability-calculator\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
export default function Page() {
  const [income, setIncome] = useState("");
  const [debts, setDebts] = useState("");
  const [down, setDown] = useState("50000");
  const [rate, setRate] = useState("6.5");
  const [taxes, setTaxes] = useState("300");
  const inc = parseFloat(income) || 0;
  const dbt = parseFloat(debts) || 0;
  const dp = parseFloat(down) || 0;
  const r = parseFloat(rate) / 100 / 12;
  const tx = parseFloat(taxes) || 0;
  const maxMortgage = (inc / 12) * 0.28 - dbt - tx;
  const t = 30 * 12;
  const maxLoan =
    maxMortgage > 0 && r > 0
      ? maxMortgage * ((Math.pow(1 + r, t) - 1) / (r * Math.pow(1 + r, t)))
      : 0;
  const maxPrice = maxLoan + dp;
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">

              <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">

                type="number"
                value={income}

                className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
                Down Payment ($)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={down}
                onChange={(e) => setDown(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
                Monthly Rent ($)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={rent}
                onChange={(e) => setRent(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
                Monthly Expenses ($)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={expenses}
                onChange={(e) => setExpenses(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          {p > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="p-4 bg-blue-900/30 border border-blue-700 rounded-lg text-center">
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-300">Annual NOI</p>
                <p className="text-xl font-bold text-blue-400 mt-1">
                  ${Math.round(noi).toLocaleString()}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="p-4 bg-green-900/30 border border-green-700 rounded-lg text-center">
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-300">Cap Rate</p>
                <p className="text-xl font-bold text-green-400 mt-1">
                  {capRate.toFixed(1)}%
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="p-4 bg-purple-900/30 border border-purple-700 rounded-lg text-center">
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-300">Cash on Cash ROI</p>
                <p className="text-xl font-bold text-purple-400 mt-1">
                  {cocRoi.toFixed(1)}%
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\real-estate\calculators\rent-vs-buy-calculator\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
export default function Page() {
  const [rent, setRent] = useState("");
  const [homePrice, setHomePrice] = useState("");
  const [down, setDown] = useState("20");
  const [rate, setRate] = useState("6.5");
  const [years, setYears] = useState("10");
  const r = parseFloat(rent) || 0;
  const p = parseFloat(homePrice) || 0;
  const dp = p * (parseFloat(down) / 100);
  const loan = p - dp;
  const rt = parseFloat(rate) / 100 / 12;
  const y = parseInt(years);
  const m = y * 12;
  const mortgage =
    loan > 0 && rt > 0
      ? loan * ((Math.pow(1 + rt, m) - 1) / (rt * Math.pow(1 + rt, m)))
      : 0;
  const totalRent = r * 12 * y;
  const totalBuy = mortgage * m + dp;
  const diff = totalRent - totalBuy;
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Rent vs. Buy Calculator
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
              Monthly Rent ($)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={rent}
              onChange={(e) => setRent(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
              Home Price ($)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={homePrice}
              onChange={(e) => setHomePrice(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
                Down (%)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={down}
                onChange={(e) => setDown(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">
                Rate (%)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={rate}
                onChange={(e) => setRate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Years</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={years}
                onChange={(e) => setYears(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          {p > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="p-4 bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 rounded-lg text-center">
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-300">Cost of Renting</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-400 mt-1">
                  ${Math.round(totalRent).toLocaleString()}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="p-4 bg-blue-900/30 border border-blue-700 rounded-lg text-center">
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-300">Cost of Buying</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-400 mt-1">
                  ${Math.round(totalBuy).toLocaleString()}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div
                className={`col-span-2 p-3 rounded-lg text-center ${diff > 0 ? "bg-green-900/30 border border-green-700 text-green-400" : "bg-red-900/30 border border-red-700 text-red-400"}`}
              >
                <p className="font-bold">
                  {diff > 0
                    ? `Buying saves you $${Math.abs(Math.round(diff)).toLocaleString()}`
                    : `Renting saves you $${Math.abs(Math.round(diff)).toLocaleString()}`}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">
                  Over {years} years (excludes taxes/maintenance)
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\security\file-encryptor\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function FileEncryptor() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");

  const handleEncrypt = async () => {
    if (!file || !password) return;
    setStatus("Encrypting...");

    try {
      const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const pwdKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
        "raw",
        new TextEncoder().encode(password),
        "PBKDF2",
        false,
        ["deriveKey"],
      );

      const salt = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
      const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
      const key = await crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
        { name: "PBKDF2", salt, iterations: 100000, hash: "SHA-256" },
        pwdKey,
        { name: "AES-GCM", length: 256 },
        false,
        ["encrypt"],
      );

      const encrypted = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
        { name: "AES-GCM", iv },
        key,
        arrayBuffer,
      );

      // Combine salt + iv + encrypted data
      const blob = new Blob([salt, iv, encrypted as unknown as ArrayBuffer], {
        type: "application/octet-stream",
      });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `${file.name}.encrypted`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      setStatus("Encryption Successful! File downloaded.");
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus("Error encrypting file.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Secure File Encryptor
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-6 text-center rounded-lg cursor-pointer hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              className="hidden"
              id="fileUpload"
              onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
            />
            <label htmlFor="fileUpload" className="cursor-pointer block">
              <p className="text-gray-300">
                {file ? file.name : "Click to upload a file"}
              </p>
              {file && (
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                  {(file.size / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB
                </p>
              )}
            </label>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Encryption Password
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
              placeholder="Enter strong password"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={handleEncrypt}
            disabled={!file || !password}
            className="w-full bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 disabled:bg-gray-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg transition-colors"
          >
            Encrypt & Download
          </button>

          {status && (
            <div
              className={`p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm ${status.includes("Successful") ? "bg-green-900/30 text-green-400 border border-green-700" : "bg-gray-900/50 text-gray-300 border border-gray-700"}`}
            >
              {status}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\security\metadata-remover\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState, useRef } from "react";

export default function MetadataRemover() {
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [cleanBlob, setCleanBlob] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleFile = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (ev) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        const canvas = canvasRef.current;
        if (!canvas) return;
        canvas.width = img.width;
        canvas.height = img.height;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        ctx?.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

        // Display preview
        setPreview(canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg"));

        // Create clean blob (Canvas natively strips EXIF/Metadata)
        canvas.toBlob(
          (blob) => {
            setCleanBlob(blob);
          },
          "image/jpeg",
          0.95,
        );
      };
      img.src = ev.target?.result as string;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const downloadClean = () => {
    if (!cleanBlob) return;
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(cleanBlob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "clean_image.jpg";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Image Metadata Remover
        </h1>
        <p className="text-center text-gray-400 mb-6">
          Strips GPS location, camera model, and all EXIF data.
        </p>

        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 p-6 text-center rounded-lg cursor-pointer hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors">
            <input
              type="file"
              accept="image/*"
              className="hidden"
              id="metaUpload"
              onChange={handleFile}
            />
            <label
              htmlFor="metaUpload"
              className="cursor-pointer block text-gray-300"
            >
              Upload Image to Strip Metadata
            </label>
          </div>

          <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="hidden"></canvas>

          {preview && (
            <div className="mt-6 space-y-4">
              <div className="bg-gray-900 p-4 rounded-lg flex justify-center">
                <img
                  src={preview}
                  alt="Clean preview"
                  className="max-h-64 object-contain rounded"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="bg-green-900/30 border border-green-700 p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm text-green-400">
                ✅ Metadata stripped successfully. Ready to download.
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={downloadClean}
                className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
              >
                Download Clean Image
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\security\password-generator\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState, useCallback } from "react";

export default function PasswordGenerator() {
  const [length, setLength] = useState(16);
  const [uppercase, setUppercase] = useState(true);
  const [lowercase, setLowercase] = useState(true);
  const [numbers, setNumbers] = useState(true);
  const [symbols, setSymbols] = useState(false);
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");

  const generatePassword = useCallback(() => {
    let chars = "";
    if (uppercase) chars += "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";
    if (lowercase) chars += "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";
    if (numbers) chars += "0123456789";
    if (symbols) chars += "!@#$%^&*()_+~`|}{[]:;?><,./-=";
    if (!chars) return;

    let pwd = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      pwd += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }
    setPassword(pwd);
  }, [length, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols]);

  // Generate automatically when options change
  useState(() => {
    generatePassword();
  });

  const copyToClipboard = () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(password);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">
          Password Generator
        </h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-gray-900 p-4 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <p className="font-mono text-lg text-green-400 break-all">
              {password || "Click Generate"}
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={copyToClipboard}
              className="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shrink-0"
            >
              Copy
            </button>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Length: {length}
            </label>
            <input
              type="range"
              min="4"
              max="64"
              value={length}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setLength(parseInt(e.target.value));
                generatePassword();
              }}
              className="w-full accent-blue-500"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {[
              [uppercase, setUppercase, "Uppercase (A-Z)"],
              [lowercase, setLowercase, "Lowercase (a-z)"],
              [numbers, setNumbers, "Numbers (0-9)"],
              [symbols, setSymbols, "Symbols (!@#$)"],
            ].map(([val, setVal, label]: any) => (
              <label
                key={label}
                className="flex items-center space-x-2 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={val}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setVal(e.target.checked);
                    generatePassword();
                  }}
                  className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-500"
                />
                <span className="text-sm text-gray-300">{label}</span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={generatePassword}
            className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg"
          >
            Regenerate Password
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\app\tools\security\url-shortener\page.tsx =====
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function URLShortener() {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");

  // Simple frontend hash to simulate shortening without a backend DB
  const generateShortCode = (str: string) => {
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
      const char = str.charCodeAt(i);
      hash = (hash << 5) - hash + char;
      hash = hash & hash;
    }
    return Math.abs(hash).toString(36).substring(0, 6);
  };

  const shortCode = url ? generateShortCode(url) : "";
  const shortUrl = shortCode ? `https://short.url/${shortCode}` : "";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white py-10 px-4">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-8 text-center">URL Shortener</h1>
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Long URL
            </label>
            <input
              type="url"
              value={url}
              onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg p-3 text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
              placeholder="https://example.com/my-very-long-url"
            />
          </div>

          {shortUrl && (
            <div className="mt-6 p-4 bg-cyan-900/30 border border-cyan-700 rounded-lg text-center">
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-sm">Shortened URL</p>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400 mt-1 break-all">
                {shortUrl}
              </p>
              <button
                onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(shortUrl)}
                className="mt-3 bg-cyan-700 hover:bg-cyan-800 text-white px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm"
              >
                Copy to Clipboard
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\components\analytics\AdSense.tsx =====
/**
 * AdSense.tsx
 * Google AdSense script loader + responsive ad unit component with
 * impression / click tracking wired to GA4.
 */

"use client";

import Script from "next/script";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { trackAdSenseEvent } from "@/lib/analytics";

const ADSENSE_CLIENT = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_CLIENT ?? ""; // ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXX

// ─── Script Loader ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Load the AdSense script once.  Place <AdSenseScript /> in root layout.
 */
export function AdSenseScript() {
  if (!ADSENSE_CLIENT || process.env.NODE_ENV === "development") return null;

  return (
    <Script
      id="adsense-script"
      src={`https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=${ADSENSE_CLIENT}`}
      strategy="afterInteractive"
      crossOrigin="anonymous"
    />
  );
}

// ─── Ad Unit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface AdUnitProps {
  /** AdSense ad-slot ID (the numeric part from your AdSense dashboard) */
  slot: string;
  /** Ad format — defaults to 'auto' (responsive) */
  format?: "auto" | "fluid" | "rectangle" | "vertical" | "horizontal";
  /** Width × height override for fixed-size ads */
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  /** GA4 label for this ad position, e.g. "sidebar-top" */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Renders a single responsive AdSense ad unit and tracks impressions/clicks.
 */
export function AdUnit({
  slot,
  format = "auto",
  style,
  label,
  className,
}: AdUnitProps) {
  const adRef = useRef<HTMLModElement>(null);
  const tracked = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined" || !ADSENSE_CLIENT) return;

    try {
      (window.adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    } catch {
      // adsbygoogle not ready yet — will retry on next render
    }
  }, []);

  // Intersection Observer for viewable impression tracking
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!adRef.current || tracked.current) return;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting && !tracked.current) {
            tracked.current = true;
            trackAdSenseEvent({
              adUnit: slot,
              adFormat: format,
              action: "viewable",
            });
          }
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.5 },
    );

    observer.observe(adRef.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [slot, format]);

  if (!ADSENSE_CLIENT) return null;

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <ins
        ref={adRef}
        className="adsbygoogle"
        style={{ display: "block", ...style }}
        data-ad-client={ADSENSE_CLIENT}
        data-ad-slot={slot}
        data-ad-format={format}
        data-full-width-responsive="true"
        onClick={() =>
          trackAdSenseEvent({
            adUnit: slot,
            adFormat: format,
            action: "click",
          })
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * GoogleAnalytics.tsx
 * Injects GA4 script tags into <head> and initialises default consent mode (GDPR-safe).
 * Place this inside <RootLayout> alongside other head-level providers.
 */

import Script from "next/script";
import { GA_MEASUREMENT_ID } from "@/lib/analytics";

interface GoogleAnalyticsProps {
  /** Override measurement ID (defaults to NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID) */
  measurementId?: string;
}

export default function GoogleAnalytics({
  measurementId,
}: GoogleAnalyticsProps) {
  const id = measurementId ?? GA_MEASUREMENT_ID;

  if (!id || process.env.NODE_ENV === "development") return null;

  return (
    <>
      {/* Load gtag.js */}
      <Script
        src={`https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=${id}`}
        strategy="afterInteractive"
      />

      {/* Initialise GA4 with consent defaults (GDPR-compliant) */}
      <Script
        id="ga4-init"
        strategy="afterInteractive"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
          __html: `
            window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
            function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}

            // Default consent â€” update once user accepts cookie banner
            gtag('consent', 'default', {
              analytics_storage: 'denied',
              ad_storage: 'denied',
              ad_user_data: 'denied',
              ad_personalization: 'denied',
              wait_for_update: 500
            });

            gtag('js', new Date());
            gtag('config', '${id}', {
              send_page_view: false,     // Manual page views via usePageTracking hook
              cookie_flags: 'SameSite=None;Secure',
              transport_url: 'https://www.google-analytics.com',
              first_party_collection: true
            });
          `,
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

import Script from "next/script";

export default function MicrosoftClarity() {
  if (!CLARITY_PROJECT_ID || process.env.NODE_ENV === "development")
    return null;

  return (
    <Script
      id="microsoft-clarity"
      strategy="afterInteractive"
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: `
          (function(c,l,a,r,i,t,y){
            c[a]=c[a]||function(){(c[a].q=c[a].q||[]).push(arguments)};
            t=l.createElement(r);t.async=1;t.src="https://www.clarity.ms/tag/"+i;
            y=l.getElementsByTagName(r)[0];y.parentNode.insertBefore(t,y);
          })(window, document, "clarity", "script", "${CLARITY_PROJECT_ID}");
        `,
      }}
    />
  );
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\components\analytics\SearchConsoleVerification.tsx =====
/**
 * SearchConsoleVerification.tsx
 * Renders the Google Search Console HTML-tag verification meta element.
 * Add this to your root layout's <head> via Next.js metadata API or directly.
 *
 * Preferred: use Next.js metadata export in layout.tsx (shown in comments below).
 * Fallback:  render <SearchConsoleMeta /> inside a custom <Head> component.
 */

// ─── Option A: Next.js Metadata API (recommended) ────────────────────────────
// In apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx, add to your metadata export:
//
// export const metadata: Metadata = {
//   ...
//   verification: {
//     google: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GSC_VERIFICATION_TOKEN,
//   },
// };
//
// That single line makes Next.js emit:
//   <meta name="google-site-verification" content="<token>" />
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ─── Option B: Manual component (legacy Pages Router or custom _document) ────

interface SearchConsoleMetaProps {
  token?: string;
}

/**
 * Drop-in <meta> tag for Google Search Console HTML-tag verification.
 * Place inside a Next.js <Head> or equivalent.
 */
export function SearchConsoleMeta({ token }: SearchConsoleMetaProps) {
  const verificationToken =
    token ?? process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GSC_VERIFICATION_TOKEN;
  if (!verificationToken) return null;

  return <meta name="google-site-verification" content={verificationToken} />;
}

// ─── generateMetadata helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Helper to merge GSC verification into any Next.js metadata object.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   export const metadata = withGSCVerification({ title: 'Home', ... });
 */
export function withGSCVerification<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  meta: T,
): T {
  const token = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GSC_VERIFICATION_TOKEN;
  if (!token) return meta;

  return {
    ...meta,
    verification: {
      // @ts-expect-error — merging into caller's metadata shape
      ...(meta.verification ?? {}),
      google: token,
    },
  };
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\components\analytics\WebVitals.tsx =====
/**
 * WebVitals.tsx
 * Client component that registers web-vitals observers (LCP, CLS, FID/INP, FCP, TTFB)
 * and pipes results to GA4 via reportWebVital().
 *
 * Usage: add <WebVitals /> anywhere inside a client boundary (e.g. root layout).
 */

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { reportWebVital, type WebVitalMetric } from "@/lib/analytics";

export default function WebVitals() {
  useEffect(() => {
    // Dynamically import web-vitals to avoid SSR issues and keep it out of the
    // critical bundle path.
    import("web-vitals").then(
      ({ onCLS, onFCP, onLCP, onTTFB, onINP }) => {
        const handler = (metric: WebVitalMetric) => reportWebVital(metric);

        onCLS(handler); // Cumulative Layout Shift        onINP(handler); // Interaction to Next Paint (Core Web Vital since 2024)
        onFCP(handler); // First Contentful Paint
        onLCP(handler); // Largest Contentful Paint
        onTTFB(handler); // Time to First Byte
      },
    );
  }, []);

  return null; // No rendered output
}

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import type { AgeCalculatorOutput } from '@platform/calculators-core'

export default function AgeCalculator() {
  const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]

  const [birthDate, setBirthDate] = useState('')
  const [toDate,    setToDate]    = useState(today)
  const [result,    setResult]    = useState<AgeCalculatorOutput | null>(null)
  const [error,     setError]     = useState<string | null>(null)

  async function handleCalculate() {
    setError(null)
    const res = await fetch('/api/tools/age-calculator', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ birthDate, toDate }),
    })

    if (!res.ok) {
      setError('Invalid input. Please check your dates.')
      return
    }

    setResult(await res.json())
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow p-6 space-y-5">

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
            Date of Birth
          </label>
          <input
            type="date"
            value={birthDate}
            onChange={e => { setBirthDate(e.target.value); setResult(null) }}
            className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm
                       focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
          />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
            Age At Date
          </label>
          <input
            type="date"
            value={toDate}
            onChange={e => { setToDate(e.target.value); setResult(null) }}
            className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm
                       focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        onClick={handleCalculate}
        className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-semibold
                   py-2.5 rounded-lg transition"
      >
        Calculate Age
      </button>

      {error && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm">{error}</p>}

      {result && (
        <div className="space-y-3">

          <div className="bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-100 rounded-xl p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-sm text-indigo-500 mb-1">Your Age</p>
            <p className="text-4xl font-bold text-indigo-600">
              {result.years} <span className="text-2xl">years</span>
            </p>
            <p className="text-gray-500 mt-1">
              {result.months} months and {result.days} days
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            {[
              { label: 'Total Days',       value: result.totalDays.toLocaleString()   },
              { label: 'Total Months',     value: result.totalMonths.toLocaleString() },
              { label: 'Next Birthday In', value: `${result.nextBirthday} days`       },
            ].map(({ label, value }) => (
              <div key={label} className="border border-gray-100 rounded-xl p-3 bg-gray-50 text-center">
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">{label}</p>
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800">{value}</p>
              </div>
            ))}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\components\tools\BMICalculator.tsx =====
'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'

export default function BMICalculator() {
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState<'metric' | 'imperial'>('metric')
  const [weight, setWeight] = useState('')
  const [height, setHeight] = useState('')
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ bmi: number; category: string; color: string; min: number; max: number } | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')

  function calculate() {
    setError('')
    const w = parseFloat(weight)
    const h = parseFloat(height)
    if (!w || !h || w <= 0 || h <= 0) { setError('Please enter valid values.'); return }

    let weightKg = w
    let heightM = h

    if (unit === 'imperial') {
      weightKg = w * 0.453592
      heightM = h * 0.0254
    } else {
      heightM = h / 100
    }

    const bmi = Math.round((weightKg / (heightM * heightM)) * 10) / 10
    const minKg = 18.5 * heightM * heightM
    const maxKg = 24.9 * heightM * heightM
    const min = Math.round((unit === 'imperial' ? minKg / 0.453592 : minKg) * 10) / 10
    const max = Math.round((unit === 'imperial' ? maxKg / 0.453592 : maxKg) * 10) / 10

    let category = ''
    let color = ''
    if (bmi < 18.5) { category = 'Underweight'; color = '#6c9cff' }
    else if (bmi < 25) { category = 'Normal weight'; color = '#00d4aa' }
    else if (bmi < 30) { category = 'Overweight'; color = '#f5c842' }
    else { category = 'Obese'; color = '#ff6b6b' }

    setResult({ bmi, category, color, min, max })
  }

  const weightLabel = unit === 'metric' ? 'Weight (kg)' : 'Weight (lbs)'
  const heightLabel = unit === 'metric' ? 'Height (cm)' : 'Height (inches)'

  return (
    <div className="tool-page">
      <h1>BMI Calculator</h1>
      <p>Calculate your Body Mass Index. Supports metric and imperial units.</p>

      <div className="card space-y-4">
        {/* Unit toggle */}
        <div className="toggle-group">
          {(['metric', 'imperial'] as const).map(u => (
            <button key={u} className={`toggle-btn ${unit === u ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => { setUnit(u); setResult(null) }}>
              {u.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + u.slice(1)}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Inputs */}
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 16 }}>
          <div>
            <label>{weightLabel}</label>
            <input type="number" value={weight} onChange={e => { setWeight(e.target.value); setResult(null) }} placeholder="0" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label>{heightLabel}</label>
            <input type="number" value={height} onChange={e => { setHeight(e.target.value); setResult(null) }} placeholder="0" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && <p className="error-msg">{error}</p>}

        <button className="btn-primary" onClick={calculate}>Calculate BMI</button>

        {result && (
          <>
            <div className="result-hero">
              <div className="result-hero-number" style={{ color: result.color }}>{result.bmi}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, color: result.color, marginTop: 8 }}>{result.category}</div>
              <div className="result-hero-label">
                Healthy range: {result.min}–{result.max} {unit === 'metric' ? 'kg' : 'lbs'}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* BMI Scale */}
            <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 11, color: '#7777aa', marginBottom: 6 }}>
                <span>Underweight</span><span>Normal</span><span>Overweight</span><span>Obese</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ height: 8, borderRadius: 4, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #6c9cff 0%, #00d4aa 25%, #f5c842 60%, #ff6b6b 100%)', position: 'relative' }}>
                <div style={{
                  position: 'absolute', top: '50%', transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                  left: `${Math.min(Math.max(((result.bmi - 10) / 30) * 100, 2), 98)}%`,
                  width: 14, height: 14, borderRadius: '50%',
                  background: '#fff', border: '2px solid #060608', boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'
                }} />
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

const modes = [

export default function PercentageCalculator() {

  const [valueA, setValueA] = useState('')
  const [valueB, setValueB] = useState('')
  const [result, setResult] = useState<PercentageOutput | null>(null)
  const [error,  setError]  = useState<string | null>(null)

  async function handleCalculate() {
    setError(null)
    const res = await fetch('/api/tools/percentage', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        mode,
        valueA: parseFloat(valueA),
        valueB: parseFloat(valueB),
      }),
    })

    if (!res.ok) {
      setError('Invalid input. Please check your values.')
      return
    }

    setResult(await res.json())
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow p-6 space-y-5">

      {/* Mode selector */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {modes.map(m => (
          <button
            key={m.value}
            onClick={() => { setMode(m.value); setResult(null) }}
            className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg border text-sm transition
              ${mode === m.value
                ? 'bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-400 text-indigo-700 font-medium'
                : 'border-gray-200 text-gray-600 hover:border-indigo-300'}`}
          >
            {m.hint}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Inputs */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
            {selectedMode.labelA}
          </label>
          <input
            type="number"
            value={valueA}
            onChange={e => { setValueA(e.target.value); setResult(null) }}
            className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm
                       focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
            placeholder="0"
          />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
            {selectedMode.labelB}
          </label>
          <input
            type="number"
            value={valueB}
            onChange={e => { setValueB(e.target.value); setResult(null) }}
            className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm
                       focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"

import { useState } from 'react'
import type { MortgageOutput } from '@platform/calculators-core'

export default function MortgageCalculator() {
  const [homePrice,    setHomePrice]    = useState('')
  const [downPayment,  setDownPayment]  = useState('')
  const [interestRate, setInterestRate] = useState('')
  const [loanTerm,     setLoanTerm]     = useState('30')
  const [result,       setResult]       = useState<MortgageOutput | null>(null)
  const [error,        setError]        = useState<string | null>(null)

  async function handleCalculate() {
    setError(null)
    const res = await fetch('/api/tools/mortgage', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        homePrice:    parseFloat(homePrice),
        downPayment:  parseFloat(downPayment),
        interestRate: parseFloat(interestRate),
        loanTerm:     parseFloat(loanTerm),
      }),
    })

    if (!res.ok) {
      setError('Invalid input. Please check your values.')
      return
    }

    setResult(await res.json())
  }

  const fields = [
    { label: 'Home Price ($)',      value: homePrice,    set: setHomePrice },
    { label: 'Down Payment ($)',    value: downPayment,  set: setDownPayment },
    { label: 'Interest Rate (%)',   value: interestRate, set: setInterestRate },
    { label: 'Loan Term (years)',   value: loanTerm,     set: setLoanTerm },

          <div key={label}>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
              {label}
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={value}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\components\tools\RoiCalculator.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'

export default function RoiCalculator() {
  const [investment, setInvestment] = useState('')
  const [returns, setReturns] = useState('')
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{
    roi: number
    profit: number
    multiple: number
  } | null>(null)

  const calculate = () => {
    const inv = parseFloat(investment)
    const ret = parseFloat(returns)
    if (!inv || !ret || inv <= 0) return
    const profit = ret - inv
    const roi = (profit / inv) * 100
    const multiple = ret / inv
    setResult({ roi, profit, multiple })
  }

  const reset = () => {
    setInvestment('')
    setReturns('')
    setResult(null)
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">
            Initial Investment ($)
          </label>
          <input
            type="number"
            min="0"
            placeholder="e.g. 10000"
            value={investment}
            onChange={(e) => setInvestment(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full border rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">
            Total Return ($)
          </label>
          <input
            type="number"
            min="0"
            placeholder="e.g. 15000"
            value={returns}
            onChange={(e) => setReturns(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full border rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={calculate}
            className="flex-1 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg transition-colors"
          >
            Calculate ROI
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={reset}
            className="px-4 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
          >
            Reset
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {result && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 pt-4 border-t">
          <div className="text-center p-4 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg">
            <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${result.roi >= 0 ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-600'}`}>
              {result.roi >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{result.roi.toFixed(2)}%
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">ROI</div>
          </div>

          <div className="text-center p-4 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg">
            <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${result.profit >= 0 ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-600'}`}>
              {result.profit >= 0 ? '+' : '-'}${Math.abs(result.profit).toLocaleString(undefined, {
                minimumFractionDigits: 2,
                maximumFractionDigits: 2,
              })}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">Net Profit</div>
          </div>

          <div className="text-center p-4 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg">
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">
              {result.multiple.toFixed(2)}x
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">Return Multiple</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

              width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%',
              background: accentColor, display: 'block',
              animation: 'pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite',
            }} />
            {tools.length} free tools
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--gray)' }}>No signup required</span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--gray)' }}>Updated 2026</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tool grid */}
      <div style={{ padding: '40px 60px 80px' }}>
        <div style={{
          display: 'grid',
          gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))',
          gap: 12,
        }}>
          {tools.map((tool, i) => (
            <ToolCard key={i} tool={tool} accentColor={accentColor} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <style>{`
        @keyframes pulse {
          0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
          50% { transform: scale(1.4); opacity: 0.5; }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  )
}

function ToolCard({ tool, accentColor }: { tool: Tool; accentColor: string }) {
  const priorityColors: Record<string, string> = {
    Critical: 'var(--accent)',
    High: 'var(--text2)',
    Medium: 'var(--gray2)',
  }

  return (
    <Link
      href={tool.href}
      style={{ textDecoration: 'none' }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          background: 'var(--bg2)',
          border: `1px solid var(--border)`,
          borderRadius: 18,
          padding: 24,
          cursor: 'pointer',
          display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column',
          transition: 'all 0.2s',
          height: '100%',
          position: 'relative', overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
        onMouseEnter={e => {
          const el = e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
          el.style.background = 'var(--bg3)'
          el.style.borderColor = 'var(--border2)'
          el.style.transform = 'translateY(-3px)'
          el.style.boxShadow = '0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)'
        }}
        onMouseLeave={e => {
          const el = e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
          el.style.background = 'var(--bg2)'
          el.style.borderColor = 'var(--border)'
          el.style.transform = 'translateY(0)'
          el.style.boxShadow = 'none'
        }}
      >
        {/* Top row */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <div style={{
            width: 48, height: 48, borderRadius: 12,
            background: `${accentColor}15`,
            border: `1px solid ${accentColor}25`,
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
            fontSize: 24,
          }}>
            {tool.icon}
          </div>
          {tool.priority && (
            <span style={{
              fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: 1.5,
              textTransform: 'uppercase', padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: 100,
              background: `${priorityColors[tool.priority]}20`,
              color: priorityColors[tool.priority],
              border: `1px solid ${priorityColors[tool.priority]}30`,
            }}>
              {tool.priority}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Name */}
        <div style={{
          fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 800, color: 'var(--white)',
          marginBottom: 6, lineHeight: 1.2,
        }}>
          {tool.name}
        </div>

        {/* Description */}
        <div style={{
          fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--gray)', lineHeight: 1.65, flex: 1,
        }}>
          {tool.description}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div style={{
          marginTop: 16, paddingTop: 14,
          borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
          display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
        }}>
          <span style={{
            fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 11,
            color: accentColor,

            {tool.mono || 'Free'}
          </span>

}

'use client'
// apps/web/src/components/ui/CustomCursor.tsx

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'

export default function CustomCursor() {
  const cursorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const trailRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const pos = useRef({ mx: 0, my: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0 })

  useEffect(() => {
    const cursor = cursorRef.current
    const trail = trailRef.current
    if (!cursor || !trail) return

    const onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      pos.current.mx = e.clientX
      pos.current.my = e.clientY
      cursor.style.left = e.clientX - 6 + 'px'
      cursor.style.top = e.clientY - 6 + 'px'
    }

    const animate = () => {
      pos.current.tx += (pos.current.mx - pos.current.tx) * 0.14
      pos.current.ty += (pos.current.my - pos.current.ty) * 0.14
      trail.style.left = pos.current.tx - 20 + 'px'
      trail.style.top = pos.current.ty - 20 + 'px'
      requestAnimationFrame(animate)
    }

    const interactiveEls = document.querySelectorAll(
      'a, button, .tool-card, .calc-card, .cat-card, .fpill, .hv-tool, .kw-card, .phase-card, .sidebar-item'
    )
    const onEnter = () => {
      trail.style.width = '56px'
      trail.style.height = '56px'
      trail.style.borderColor = 'rgba(108,99,255,0.7)'
    }
    const onLeave = () => {
      trail.style.width = '40px'
      trail.style.height = '40px'
      trail.style.borderColor = 'rgba(108,99,255,0.4)'
    }

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove)
    interactiveEls.forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener('mouseenter', onEnter)
      el.addEventListener('mouseleave', onLeave)
    })
    const raf = requestAnimationFrame(animate)

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove)
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
    }
  }, [])

  return (
    <>
      <div
        ref={cursorRef}
        style={{
          position: 'fixed', width: 12, height: 12,
          background: 'var(--accent)', borderRadius: '50%',
          pointerEvents: 'none', zIndex: 9999,
          transition: 'transform 0.1s, background 0.2s',
          mixBlendMode: 'screen',
        }}
      />
      <div
        ref={trailRef}
        style={{
          position: 'fixed', width: 40, height: 40,
          border: '1.5px solid rgba(108,99,255,0.4)',
          borderRadius: '50%', pointerEvents: 'none', zIndex: 9998,
          transition: 'all 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)',
        }}
      />
    </>
  )
}

===== FILE: apps\web\src\components\ThemeProvider.tsx =====
'use client'
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
type Theme = 'light' | 'dark'
const ThemeContext = createContext<{ theme: Theme; toggle: () => void }>({ theme: 'light', toggle: () => {} })
export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<Theme>('light')
  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme)
  }, [theme])
  const toggle = () => setTheme(t => t === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light')
  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, toggle }}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>
}
export const useTheme = () => useContext(ThemeContext)
